# SRD 5.2.1 coverage (generated, do not edit by hand)

This page lists every record in the SRD 5.2.1 content and says what the app does with it. Each record is in
one of three states:

- **Enforced:** the server applies it in play. The GM may still supply a fact the map can't see, such as a
  creature's line of sight or its degree of cover, and a note names any narrative part left to the table.
- **Guided:** the app tracks it or applies part of it, and a person applies the rest. It may count a use, open a
  prompt, roll a check or post a reminder. The note says which part is the table's.
- **Reference:** the app shows the text and applies nothing beyond carrying an item (its weight in its bearer's
  load). The note says why the rest is the table's.

A note names the module that applies a record, so it can be checked in the code. Enforcement follows the
table's rules policy: under advise the server warns where it would refuse, and under off it says nothing.

Regenerate this page with `npm run map`. A test (`apps/server/test/srd-coverage.test.ts`) fails when the page
is stale, when a record is missing from the page or listed twice, when a guided or reference row has no note,
when a curated row is missing, names a record that no longer exists or differs from the computed state without
saying so (`CURATED_OVER_COMPUTED`), and when a sampled claim stops matching the engine. Known gaps in enforced
records are GitHub issues.

## How records are classified

Most records are classified from the mechanics their content bundle carries, because the engine is data-driven
(`apps/server/src/srd-coverage.ts`); the rest are curated (`apps/server/src/srd-coverage-curated.ts`).

- **Spells:** a cast resolves in `action-resolution.ts` and the steps in `resolution/`, at the caster's own
  numbers. A spell is enforced when its cast applies its attack, save, damage, healing or lasting effect, ends
  spells or curses (`resolution/dispel.ts`), or when the area it leaves applies them as creatures enter it or
  start or end a turn there (`spell-zones.ts`), or when it raises, cuts or breaks the map's walls or works its
  doors (`spell-walls.ts`).
  Guided when the app spends the slot and holds the Concentration, the area or a save while a person applies
  what the spell does. A spell whose cast leaves a rider to the table (Storm of Vengeance's later turns) is
  curated as guided, with a note.
- **Monster actions:** enforced when the attack, damage, healing or effect resolves, a save's failure leaves
  something, or the server offers the action as the generic action it names (Nimble Escape's Disengage or Hide).
  An action that casts one spell takes that spell's state; a list takes the least of the spells it casts whose
  outcome isn't the story's (what Detect Magic senses), each a cast action at the stat block's numbers. Guided when
  the server resolves it and reminds the GM of the rest (a hit's rider the build doesn't read), whose reminder is
  the note, rolls a save whose failure is the GM's, or only counts a use, a legendary cost or a recharge. A hit
  rider that carries only a reminder applies nothing.
- **Class features, species traits and feats:** enforced when their riders (an action that resolves, an
  effect, a modifier the engine reads, a grant) or the builder's picks apply them. Guided when the app counts
  their uses or offers an action that only spends a use, even beside riders that apply, or when part of what
  they do is left to a person.
- **Magic items and gear:** enforced for weapons, armor, ammunition, Spell Scrolls and items whose riders
  apply. An item that casts spells takes the state of the spells it casts, and one with an action that only
  spends a use is guided however much else it applies. Guided when the app only tracks Attunement, charges or
  a curse, or binds the item to a base weapon or armor without its magic. Tools are guided too: the server
  rolls their checks, and the GM sets what they achieve.
- **Backgrounds, weapons and armor:** enforced. The builder applies a background, and every weapon and armor
  statistic reaches the rolls.
- **Monster traits, conditions, the rules glossary, the Gameplay Toolbox, the rules chapters' sections and the
  weapon properties and masteries:** curated by hand, each with a note.
- **Skills and damage types:** enforced, each with the module that reads it. **Languages:** reference; the builder
  records them and speaking them is the table's.

Records the data can't classify, because the engine handles them in code or their data applies only part of
what they do, are curated too (`RECORD_OVERRIDES`). Each group lists their notes after its records.

The next spell of level 5 or lower with a casting time of an action that can target its caster, cast within the minute, is held for the 10 days at its slot and its caster's numbers, both slots spent (stored-casts.ts); casting Contingency again replaces it. When the trigger happens its sheet releases it on the caster alone with no action, which ends Contingency, and the release is refused once the statuette isn't carried. Judging whether the described trigger has happened is the caster's player's or the GM's. |
| Continual Flame | enforced | The object touched, held by the caster or a creature on its side, sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 feet more until dispelled, and moves with its holder (vision/cast-sight.ts); an enemy's object is refused (resolution/spell-targets.ts). It consumes 50 GP of ruby dust (resolution/components.ts). An object no one holds, and covering the flame, are the table's. |
| Control Water | guided | The cast offers its four effects as options. The Whirlpool leaves its vortex on the map (spell-zones.ts): as its turn starts, a creature in the painted water within 25 feet is pulled 10 feet toward it, and a creature entering it or ending its turn there makes the Strength save against 2d8 Bludgeoning damage, half on a success, once a turn. Flood, Part Water and Redirect Flow are drawn as the Cube, and the GM repaints the water. Swimming away (an action and a Strength (Athletics) check) and choosing another effect on a later turn are the GM's. |
| Control Weather | guided | The cast takes 10 minutes (resolution/long-casting.ts) and holds Concentration for 8 hours. The GM sets the weather it brings on the encounter, which the server then applies (environment.ts); each stage it moves, the 1d4 x 10 minutes a change takes and the 5 miles it reaches are the GM's. |
| Counterspell | enforced | resolution/counter.ts holds a cast with components while each creature that sees its caster within 60 feet and has Counterspell, a slot and its Reaction answers: a Spell Scroll's (a cast from another item needs no components), a spell readied with the Ready action as it is cast, and a long casting as it begins. counter-answers.ts rolls the caster's Constitution save against the reactor's DC: a failure ends the spell with no effect and leaves its slot unspent, and a success lets it go ahead. The caster's own allies aren't asked. |
| Create Food and Water | guided | The cast says what appears, and the characters eat and drink from it with the GM's meal and fill (actor.nourish, survival.ts). Where the food and water lie, and the food spoiling after 24 hours, are the GM's. |
| Create or Destroy Water | enforced | The cast picks Create Water or Destroy Water over its 30-foot Cube, 5 feet bigger a slot level. Rain puts out the fire on a creature in it and the open flames carried there (zone-outcomes.ts, item-light.ts), and Destroy Water ends the fog in the Cube (vision/cast-sight.ts). Water in a container is the GM's. |
| Create Undead | enforced | Up to three Ghouls rise from dead Humanoid corpses within 10 feet, more from higher slots, or Ghasts, Wights or Mummies from levels 8 and 9 (summons.ts). A Bonus Action commands them within 120 feet (summon-orders.ts); uncommanded, they take the Dodge action. After 24 hours they obey no one, and casting it again renews that. |
| Creation | guided | The cast takes its minute (resolution/long-casting.ts) and places its 5-foot Cube. The object it makes, and how long it lasts by its material, are the GM's. |
| Darkness | enforced | Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot Sphere at a point, or cast on a creature an Emanation round the object it carries that moves with it, which Darkvision can't see through and nonmagical light can't brighten, and it dispels spell light of level 2 or lower it overlaps (vision/cast-sight.ts). An object covered by a bowl or helm is the table's to say. |
| Death Ward | enforced | hit-points.ts leaves the target at 1 Hit Point the first time it would drop to 0, and ends the spell. An effect that would kill it outright without dealing damage (Power Word Kill, Divine Word, a Slaying Bow) ends the spell instead (hit-points.ts, fatal-saves.ts). |
| Delayed Blast Fireball | enforced | The bead waits at its point, in an encounter or out of one, and spell-zones.ts explodes it when the spell ends, Concentration broken included: the Dexterity save and 12d6 Fire damage, 1d6 more a slot level, plus 1d6 for each of the caster's turns that ended while it waited. A creature within 5 feet can Touch the Bead (zone-touch.ts): its Dexterity save sets it off on a failure, and on a success it throws the bead up to 40 feet at a creature, where it explodes. Flammable objects that catch are the GM's. |
| Demiplane | guided | The cast lasts the hour, and the table is told. The door, the room beyond it and the creatures shunted out when the spell ends are the GM's to run. |
| Detect Magic | enforced | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. For the duration the caster senses magic within 30 feet, blocked by walls (vision/detect.ts); its later Magic action shows its player a faint aura on each creature in sight bearing a magic item or a spell's effect, with those spells' schools. Magic in scenery that isn't a game piece (a warded wall, a hidden glyph) is the GM's to describe. |
| Detect Poison and Disease | enforced | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. For the duration its player is shown, within 30 feet and not through a wall, each creature carrying a poison, each poisonous or venomous creature and each with a magical contagion, with the kind (vision/detect.ts). Poisons in scenery and food that aren't game pieces are the GM's. |
| Detect Thoughts | guided | The cast holds Concentration and opens no save; its player is shown the minds (Intelligence 4 or more) within 30 feet, not through a wall (vision/detect.ts). On a later turn a Magic action probes the target's mind: it makes the Wisdom save, and a success ends the spell; on a failure it may take an action for an Intelligence (Arcana) check against the spell save DC, which ends the spell (lasting-spells.ts, ending-actions.ts, spell-endings.ts). What the caster reads in a mind is the GM's. |
| Dimension Door | enforced | granted-moves.ts gives the caster a 500-foot teleport for the turn to any space, seen or not, and one willing creature within 5 feet named at the cast goes too, arriving in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the caster's (teleport-company.ts). Arriving where a creature stands, or with no space for the passenger, fails for both and deals each 4d6 Force damage. A destination off this map is the GM's to place. |
| Disguise Self | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The disguise is an effect on the caster for the hour. How it looks, and who sees through it with a Study action, are the GM's. |
| Disintegrate | enforced | The save and its Force damage are applied, and a target it drops to 0 Hit Points dies with nothing left of its body (hit-points.ts): only True Resurrection or Wish brings it back (resolution/revival.ts). Aimed at a door, a wall that is an object or a wall of force on the map, it destroys it (spell-walls.ts): Wall of Force and Forcecage whole, ending the spell, and a larger wall in a 10-foot gap. Aimed at a creature in a sphere of force, it destroys the sphere and harms nothing inside (enclosures.ts). The gear it leaves is the GM's. |
| Dispel Evil and Good | enforced | Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the caster (resolution/attack.ts). Break Enchantment, a Magic action touching a creature, ends the Charmed, Frightened and possession those types gave it (resolution/break-enchantment.ts). Dismissal makes one the caster sees within 5 feet succeed on a Charisma save or leave the map for its home plane for good (fatal-saves.ts). Either ends the spell. |
| Dispel Magic | enforced | resolution/dispel.ts ends each spell on the target creature of the slot's level or lower, and for each higher one rolls the caster's spellcasting ability check against DC 10 plus its level. The GM can aim it at a spell's area on the map instead. A spell on an object the app doesn't track is the GM's. |
| Dissonant Whispers | enforced | The save and its Psychic damage are applied. On a failure the target spends its Reaction, when it can take one, on a move of its Speed that must end farther from the caster (granted-moves.ts), provoking as any move does; the route is the mover's. |
| Divination | guided | Each cast after the first before a Long Rest rolls the d100 against a 25 percent chance of no answer for each earlier cast (resolution/divinations.ts). The truthful reply is the GM's. |
| Divine Word | enforced | A failed Charisma save acts by the target's Hit Points (fatal-saves.ts): 20 or fewer dies, 30 or fewer is Blinded, Deafened and Stunned for 1 hour, 40 or fewer Blinded and Deafened for 10 minutes, and 50 or fewer Deafened for 1 minute. A Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey or a Fiend that fails leaves the map for 24 hours (off-plane.ts). |
| Dominate Beast | enforced | Only a Beast can be the target. A failed save imposes Charmed for the spell's duration, longer from a higher slot (resolution/concentration.ts), with Advantage on the save while its side is fighting the caster's, and a repeat save each time the target takes damage (save-stages.ts). It puts the target under the caster's command and on its side while it lasts (summons.ts): the caster's player acts for it on its turns, and its Reaction is offered only while the caster has one, spending both (commanded-reactions.ts). What the orders say, and how it carries them out when left alone, are the table's. |
| Dominate Monster | enforced | Any creature can be the target. A failed save imposes Charmed for the spell's duration, longer from a level 9 slot (resolution/concentration.ts), with Advantage on the save while its side is fighting the caster's, and a repeat save each time the target takes damage (save-stages.ts). It puts the target under the caster's command and on its side while it lasts (summons.ts): the caster's player acts for it on its turns, and its Reaction is offered only while the caster has one, spending both (commanded-reactions.ts). What the orders say, and how it acts when left alone, are the table's. |
| Dominate Person | enforced | Only a Humanoid can be the target. A failed save imposes Charmed for the spell's duration, longer from a higher slot (resolution/concentration.ts), with Advantage on the save while its side is fighting the caster's, and a repeat save each time the target takes damage (save-stages.ts). It puts the target under the caster's command and on its side while it lasts (summons.ts): the caster's player acts for it on its turns, and its Reaction is offered only while the caster has one, spending both (commanded-reactions.ts). What the orders say, and how it acts when left alone, are the table's. |
| Dragon's Breath | enforced | The touched creature gains an action to exhale the 15-foot Cone at the cast's level, save DC and the damage type picked when it was cast, while the caster concentrates (granted-actions.ts); the caster's own sheet doesn't offer it. |
| Dream | guided | The caster, as the messenger, is Incapacitated with Speed 0 in its trance for the 8 hours, and ending that effect ends the spell (resolution/grant.ts). A terrifying messenger's message has the target make the Wisdom save, in an encounter or out of one; a failure denies it the benefit of its next Long Rest and deals 3d6 Psychic damage as it wakes (lasting-spells.ts, rest-triggers.ts). A willing creature touched as the messenger in the caster's place, the dream itself and the conversation are the table's, and the target is often off the map. |
| Druidcraft | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. Fire Play lights or snuffs a flame within 30 feet: a light the GM set on the map, tapped while aiming, or the burning light a targeted creature carries (resolution/cast-lights.ts). Weather Sensor, Bloom and the Sensory Effect are harmless descriptions. |
| Earthquake | enforced | The cast places the 100-foot circle; each creature on the ground there makes the Dexterity save at the cast and at the end of each of the caster's turns, Prone with its Concentration broken on a failure, one in the air spared (spell-zones.ts), and the circle is Difficult Terrain (zone-ground.ts). The walls and doors there that are objects take 50 Bludgeoning damage at the cast and as each of the caster's turns ends (objects.ts). The fissures, and which structures touch the ground and what collapses, are the GM's. |
| Elementalism | guided | Beckon Air aimed at a door on the map within 30 feet slams it shut (resolution/cast-walls.ts), and Beckon Fire lights a flame the GM set on the map, or the light a targeted creature carries, within 30 feet (resolution/cast-lights.ts). Beckon Earth, Beckon Water, Sculpt Element and the smoke's scent are harmless descriptions. |
| Enlarge/Reduce | enforced | A willing target takes the effect with no save, an unwilling one on a failed Constitution save. Enlarge makes it one size larger with Advantage on Strength checks and saves and 1d4 more weapon damage; Reduce one size smaller with Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves and 1d4 less on weapon and Unarmed Strike damage, never below 1 (resolution/damage.ts). The token takes the new size (transform/forms.ts). An object that no one wears or carries is the GM's, since loose objects aren't on the map. |
| Ensnaring Strike | enforced | The hit's target makes the Strength save, with Advantage if Large or larger, or is Restrained while the caster concentrates, taking 1d6 Piercing, 1d6 more a slot level, at the start of each of its turns (resolution/pending.ts, turn-boundaries.ts). It, or a creature within reach of it with End an Effect, breaks free with a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell save DC (ending-actions.ts). |
| Entangle | enforced | The cast's Strength save leaves a creature in the square Restrained, escaped with a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell save DC. zone-ground.ts makes the square Difficult Terrain for the duration. Leaving the caster out of its own square is the GM's. |
| Enthrall | enforced | A failed Wisdom save gives -10 to the target's Perception checks while the caster concentrates (ability-checks.ts). Its Passive Perception, and the creatures that succeed automatically because they are fighting the caster's side, are the GM's. |
| Etherealness | enforced | The caster, and two more willing creatures within 10 feet for each slot level above 7, step onto the Border Ethereal for up to 8 hours until the caster ends it: their tokens stay on the map, unseen but by Truesight or See Invisibility, out of reach of the creatures on the plane both ways, moving in any direction through walls and creatures, each foot up or down costing an extra foot (ethereal.ts, movement-rules.ts). Each returns where its token stands, shunted to the nearest unoccupied space with 2 Force damage a foot from a filled one (off-plane.ts). What it perceives of the plane it left is description. |
| Expeditious Retreat | enforced | The cast takes the Dash action at once, and the caster may take it again as a Bonus Action while the spell lasts (builtin-actions.ts). |
| Eyebite | enforced | A failed save leaves the effect picked (resolution/pending.ts): Asleep (Unconscious, waking on damage or a Shake Awake), Panicked (Frightened, its turns spent on the Dash, each move ending farther from the caster: compelled-moves.ts) or Sickened (Poisoned). Targeting another creature on later turns is the GM's. |
| Fabricate | guided | The cast takes 10 minutes (resolution/long-casting.ts) and places its 10-foot Cube. What it makes from the raw materials is the GM's. |
| Faithful Hound | enforced | The hound stays at its point in an encounter or out of one, and spell-zones.ts makes it bite at the start of each of the caster's turns in an encounter: the enemy nearest it within 5 feet makes the Dexterity save against 4d8 Force damage. It barks for the caster when a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of it without the password, the caster's later Magic action moves it 30 feet (zone-moves.ts), and the spell ends when the caster is more than 300 feet from it. The password, and its sight of Invisible creatures, are the GM's. |
| Fear | enforced | A failed save imposes Frightened and drops what the creature holds (effects.ts). On each of its turns it can only Dash and must end its move farther from the caster, and a player's End Turn waits until it has (resolution/economy.ts, compelled-moves.ts, movement-rules.ts); the GM passes the turn of a creature with nowhere to move. A creature that ends its turn out of the caster's sight repeats the save (save-stages.ts, with dynamic vision on). Which route is safest is the mover's. |
| Find Familiar | enforced | The familiar takes one of the spell's forms or another Challenge Rating 0 Beast, as a Celestial, Fey or Fiend, within 10 feet (summons.ts). It rolls its own Initiative and can't attack. A Bonus Action lets the caster's player see through its eyes until the start of the caster's next turn (vision/audience.ts), and a Magic action dismisses it or sends it to its pocket dimension and calls it back (summon-orders.ts). A touch spell is delivered from its space with its Reaction within 100 feet (summons.ts). Casting it again changes its form. Its telepathy is the GM's. |
| Find Steed | enforced | The Otherworldly Steed at the slot's level, a Celestial, Fey or Fiend, appears within 30 feet and acts right after the caster (summons.ts); it can be ridden (mounts.ts). It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the caster dies, and a new casting replaces it. |
| Find the Path | guided | The cast takes its minute (resolution/long-casting.ts), needs divination tools worth 100 GP (resolution/components.ts) and holds Concentration for the day. The way it shows is the GM's. |
| Find Traps | guided | The cast tells its caster's player, by nature alone, each trap the app holds within 120 feet whose middle the caster sees (resolution/sense-traps.ts): the traps set on the map, hidden glyphs, alarms and set item traps. Where each lies is never told to the player; the GM hears it. A trap the app doesn't hold is the GM's. |
| Finger of Death | enforced | The save and its Necrotic damage are applied. A Humanoid it kills rises as a Zombie at the start of the caster's next turn (risen.ts), under the caster's command and on its side, in the corpse's space and acting right after the caster (summons.ts): a player's caster runs it. |
| Fire Shield | enforced | The shield picked gives Resistance to Cold (warm) or Fire (chill), and a creature within 5 feet that hits the caster with a melee attack roll takes 2d8 Fire or Cold (resolution/struck.ts). Its light is carried with the caster's token (vision/cast-sight.ts). |
| Fire Storm | enforced | The cast places up to ten 10-foot Cubes, each touching another and within 150 feet of the caster (multi-templates.ts), and each creature under any of them makes the Dexterity save once against 7d10 Fire damage, half on a success. Setting flammable objects alight is the GM's. |
| Flaming Sphere | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save against 2d6 Fire damage when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere. The Bonus Action moves the sphere up to 30 feet (zone-moves.ts), and a creature it rams makes the save. It sheds its light for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). |
| Flesh to Stone | enforced | A failed save imposes Restrained, and the repeat saves are counted: three successes end it, three failures Petrify it (save-stages.ts). A success leaves Speed 0 until the start of the caster's next turn, and a Construct succeeds without a roll. |
| Floating Disk | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The disk is a marker within 30 feet that stays put while its caster is within 20 feet and follows to stay within 20 feet as it moves away, ending more than 100 feet apart (summons.ts). What it carries, its 500-pound limit and an elevation change of 10 feet it can't cross are the GM's: its load isn't a container. |
| Fog Cloud | enforced | The Sphere is Heavily Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts), and its radius grows 20 feet for each slot level above 1 (spell-zone-state.ts). Gust of Wind disperses it. |
| Forbiddance | enforced | The warded area, up to a 200-foot square, lasts a day on the game clock (spell-zones.ts, game-time.ts). An Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend or Undead that enters it for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 5d10 Radiant or Necrotic damage, chosen at the cast. Strict rules refuse a teleport into it (zone-barriers.ts). The password that spares a creature is the GM's. |
| Forcecage | enforced | The cast raises the 20-foot cage on its placed Cube as bars that stop movement and leave sight, attacks and spells through (spell-walls.ts), and moves a creature standing in the bars out of them. A creature that teleports out first makes a Charisma save against the caster's spell save DC, which the server rolls, and a failure keeps it in and wastes the teleport (forcecage.ts). Disintegrate destroys the cage, and it goes when the spell ends. The solid 10-foot box and its reach into the Ethereal Plane are the GM's. |
| Freedom of Movement | enforced | speed.ts gives the target a Swim Speed equal to its Speed, and no spell or other magical effect reduces its Speeds. terrain.ts charges it nothing extra for Difficult Terrain, and magic can't make it Paralyzed or Restrained (effects.ts), though a net or a constrictor's grapple still holds it. It slips a nonmagical grapple or restraint for 5 feet of movement, with no action and no roll (resolution/slip-free.ts). |
| Gaseous Form | enforced | The willing target becomes a misty cloud: its only speed is a Fly Speed of 10 feet that hovers, it can share a creature's space, has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage, Immunity to Prone and Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, and it can't attack, speak or cast spells. A Magic action or 0 Hit Points ends it. Narrow openings and liquids are the GM's. |
| Gate | guided | The cast needs a diamond worth 5,000 GP (resolution/components.ts) and holds Concentration for the minute. The portal, the plane beyond it and a creature it calls are the GM's. |
| Geas | enforced | A failed Wisdom save leaves the target Charmed for the spell's duration at its slot (resolution/pending.ts). When it acts directly counter to the command, the GM deals it the 5d10 Psychic damage, which a player can't take, at most once a day of game time (lasting-spells.ts, use-pools.ts). Remove Curse ends it, and Greater Restoration ends it as that spell's own row says. Whether the creature defies or understands the command is the GM's. |
| Gentle Repose | enforced | resolution/revival.ts takes only a corpse, and the game time it spends under the spell's 10 days doesn't count against a revival's limit (death.ts). Keeping it from becoming Undead is the GM's. |
| Giant Insect | enforced | A Giant Insect at the slot's level in the form picked appears within 60 feet and acts right after the caster with its spell attack modifier and save DC (summons.ts); uncommanded, it takes the Dodge action (summon-turns.ts). It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the Concentration ends. |
| Glibness | enforced | A Charisma check's d20 counts as at least 15 for the hour (ability-checks.ts). How magic reads the caster's truthfulness is the GM's. |
| Globe of Invulnerability | enforced | The 10-foot Emanation stays where its caster stood (spell-zones.ts). zone-barriers.ts keeps a spell of level 5 or lower cast from outside from affecting the creatures within, one level higher for each slot level above 6. |
| Glyph of Warding | guided | The glyph lasts until it goes off, in an encounter or out of one, drawn for the GM and the caster's player alone. As an explosive rune, the first creature that steps onto it sets it off: each creature in the 20-foot Sphere makes the Dexterity save against 5d8 damage of the type chosen at the cast, 1d8 more a slot level above 3, and the spell ends (spell-zones.ts). A spell of the glyph's level or lower that its caster casts within the minute is stored in it instead, and when the glyph is set off it takes effect at its caster's numbers on that creature, or on the creatures within its area around that creature (stored-casts.ts, stored-cast-release.ts). A Study whose Intelligence (Investigation) check meets the spell save DC within 10 feet notices the glyph and draws it for everyone (traps.ts). Refining the trigger (creature kinds, passwords, an opened book) is the GM's. |
| Goodberry | enforced | resolution/provisions.ts puts ten berries in the caster's inventory, gone when the spell's 24 hours end (effects.ts). Eating one (actor.nourish) restores 1 Hit Point, takes the eater's Bonus Action on its turn in an encounter, and counts as a day's food while the GM tracks food and water (survival.ts). |
| Grease | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save when a creature enters the square or ends its turn there, and a failure leaves it Prone. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). zone-ground.ts makes the square Difficult Terrain. |
| Greater Restoration | enforced | The cast asks which harm it ends on the touched creature: an Exhaustion level, Charmed or Petrified, one curse with its cursed Attunement, a lowered ability score, a lowered Hit Point maximum, or an effect whose own text names the spell (Befuddlement, Contact Other Plane's Incapacitated). A creature without that harm refuses the cast before anything is spent (resolution/restoration.ts), and the cast consumes 100 GP of diamond dust (resolution/components.ts). |
| Guards and Wards | guided | The cast places its 50-foot square for 24 hours, and every closed door in it is locked as by Arcane Lock against all but the caster and its allies until the spell ends (resolution/cast-walls.ts, doors.ts). The fogged corridors and their confusion, the webbed stairs, the illusory walls, the extra spell effect, sparing creatures the caster names who aren't its allies, and Dispel Magic ending one part at a time are the GM's. |
| Guidance | enforced | The touched creature adds 1d4 to its checks with the skill picked at the cast while the caster concentrates (ability-checks.ts). |
| Gust of Wind | enforced | The cast's save pushes a creature that fails 15 feet away from the caster, and the Line disperses the fog and clouds it overlaps (vision/cast-sight.ts). spell-zones.ts repeats the save for a creature ending its turn in the Line, zone-ground.ts charges 2 feet for every foot a creature in it moves closer to the caster, and the Bonus Action points the Line another way from the caster (zone-moves.ts). It puts out a burning creature's fire and the open flames carried in the Line, and gives a lantern its 50 percent chance (zone-outcomes.ts, item-light.ts). |
| Hallow | guided | The cast places the 60-foot-radius area round the touched point until dispelled and picks the types its ward names among Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead (all of them when none is named). zone-barriers.ts keeps a creature of those types from walking in, and a creature inside can't be charmed, frightened or possessed by one, a Charmed or Frightened condition or a possession it already has from one being held off while it is inside (zone-auras.ts). The cast picks its extra effect: Courage (every other creature inside immune to Frightened), Darkness (dark inside, which normal light and lower spells' light don't brighten), Daylight (Bright Light), Extradimensional Interference (the warded types can't teleport in or out), Fear (a warded creature inside is Frightened), Resistance (every other creature inside resists the type picked), Silence (Deafened inside) or Vulnerability (a warded creature inside is vulnerable to the type picked). The extra effect's creatures follow the ward's types, so naming other types for it is the GM's, as are Peaceful Rest, Tongues and a lower spell's magical Darkness inside its Daylight. A Hallow placed over ground already under one fails (resolution/zone-casts.ts). |
| Hallucinatory Terrain | guided | The cast takes 10 minutes (resolution/long-casting.ts) and places its 150-foot Cube for 24 hours. What the terrain seems to be, and seeing through it with a Study, are the GM's. |
| Heal | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores 70 Hit Points, 10 more for each slot level above 6, and ends Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned, for one creature (resolution/spell-targets.ts). |
| Heat Metal | enforced | The cast and each later Bonus Action deal 2d8 Fire, 1d8 more a slot level above 2, to the creature holding or wearing the heated object, which then makes the Constitution save to keep hold (resolution/pending.ts). The object is the metal weapon it holds, else the metal armor it wears: a failure drops a held weapon, still carried (effects.ts), and one that can't drop its armor has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the caster's next turn, as a creature that keeps hold does. An unattended metal object, and who else touches it, are the GM's. |
| Heroes' Feast | enforced | Up to twelve creatures gain Resistance to Poison damage, Immunity to Frightened and Poisoned, and 2d10 rolled for each to its Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points for 24 hours of game time (resolution/grant.ts). The hour the feast takes is the GM's to time. |
| Hideous Laughter | enforced | A failed save imposes Prone and Incapacitated, repeated at the end of each of the target's turns and each time it takes damage, with Advantage then (save-stages.ts). It can't stand up while it laughs (actor-conditions.ts). |
| Hold Person | enforced | A failed save imposes Paralyzed, repeated at the end of each of the target's turns. resolution/spell-targets.ts takes one Humanoid, one more for each slot level above 2. |
| Holy Aura | enforced | While the caster and its allies stand in the 30-foot Emanation, zone-auras.ts gives them Advantage on saving throws and Disadvantage to attack rolls against them. A Fiend or an Undead that hits one with a melee attack makes the Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn (resolution/struck.ts). |
| Ice Storm | enforced | The cast's Dexterity save deals the Bludgeoning and Cold damage, half on a success. zone-ground.ts makes the Cylinder Difficult Terrain of ice until the end of the caster's next turn. |
| Identify | guided | The cast or its Ritual takes a minute and needs a 100 GP pearl (resolution/components.ts). Cast on an item its caster carries, it marks the copy identified (resolution/identify.ts), so its player's sheet shows the kind and the type the GM set without attuning (projections.ts), and no sheet write can set or clear the mark (inventory.ts). A creature's ongoing spells, and objects off the sheet, are the GM's to tell. |
| Illusory Script | guided | The cast or its Ritual takes its minute (resolution/long-casting.ts) and consumes ink worth 10 GP (resolution/components.ts). The writing and who can read it are the GM's. |
| Imprisonment | enforced | A failed save imprisons the target in the form the caster picks (resolution/pending.ts): Burial, Hedged Prison and Minimus Containment take it off the map (off-plane.ts), Chaining holds it Restrained where nothing can move it (forced-movement.ts), and Slumber leaves it Unconscious with nothing to wake it. Imprisoned, it needs no air, food or drink (breath.ts, survival.ts), can't teleport, and no Divination spell can target or sense it (resolution/spell-wards.ts); only a Dispel Magic from a level 9 slot ends it (resolution/dispel.ts). A target that saves is immune for 24 hours of the game clock. The ending trigger the caster names is the GM's to judge. |
| Incendiary Cloud | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save against 10d8 Fire damage on the cast and when a creature enters the cloud or ends its turn there, once a turn. At the start of each of the caster's turns the caster steers it 10 feet in a direction away from itself (zone-moves.ts), or as that turn ends it drifts straight away, and a creature the cloud moves onto makes the save. The cloud is Heavily Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts), and a strong wind disperses it (zone-outcomes.ts). |
| Insect Plague | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Constitution save against 4d10 Piercing damage on the cast and when a creature enters the Sphere or ends its turn there, once a turn. zone-ground.ts makes the Sphere Difficult Terrain, and it is Lightly Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). |
| Instant Summons | guided | The cast or its Ritual takes its minute (resolution/long-casting.ts) and needs a sapphire worth 1,000 GP (resolution/components.ts). Calling the object back is the GM's handover (character.give-item), and learning who holds it is the story's. |
| Irresistible Dance | enforced | A failed save Charms the target, holds its Speed at 0, gives it Disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls and attackers Advantage against it, and offers it an action to collect itself with a Wisdom save at the spell save DC (builtin-actions.ts). A success holds its Speed at 0 until the end of its next turn. |
| Jump | enforced | Each target can leap up to 30 feet for 10 feet of movement once on each of its turns for 1 minute (jumping.ts). |
| Knock | enforced | Aimed at a door on the map that the caster sees within 60 feet, it takes away one of what holds it shut, a lock, a stuck or barred state or a spike, and holds an Arcane Lock off for 10 minutes (doors.ts). A door Stone Shape sealed stays shut. The knock heard 300 feet away is the table's. |
| Legend Lore | guided | The cast takes 10 minutes (resolution/long-casting.ts), consumes incense worth 250 GP and needs four ivory strips worth 50 GP each (resolution/components.ts). The lore is the GM's. |
| Levitate | enforced | A creature on the caster's side rises 20 feet with no save, and any other creature only on a failed Constitution save (falling.ts); while levitating it moves only as if climbing (altitude.ts), and it floats gently down when the spell ends. On the caster's turn a Magic action raises or lowers it 20 feet, kept within 60 feet of the caster, and a caster levitating itself rises or sinks as part of its move with no action (resolution/later-steps.ts). A smaller change of height is set with the GM's height control, and a levitated object has no token, so it is the GM's. |
| Light | enforced | The object touched, held by the caster or a creature on its side, sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 feet more for the hour, and moves with its holder; casting it again ends the earlier light (vision/cast-sight.ts). An enemy's object is refused (resolution/spell-targets.ts). An object no one holds, and covering the light, are the table's. |
| Locate Animals or Plants | guided | The cast or its Ritual is told to the table. What it finds within 5 miles is the GM's. |
| Locate Creature | guided | The cast holds Concentration for the hour. The direction it senses is the GM's to give. |
| Locate Object | guided | The cast holds Concentration for 10 minutes. The direction it senses is the GM's to give. |
| Mage Hand | enforced | The hand appears as a token at a point within 30 feet (summons.ts); a Magic action moves it up to 30 feet (summon-orders.ts), and it vanishes more than 30 feet from the caster or when the spell is cast again. Aimed at a door on the map within 30 feet, it opens or shuts an unlocked one (resolution/cast-walls.ts), and a door held shut stays shut. What else it handles is the GM's. |
| Magic Circle | enforced | The cast picks the types it wards among Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead (all of them when none is named) and whether it faces out or is reversed. Facing out, zone-barriers.ts keeps a creature of those types from walking into the Cylinder and makes one that teleports in succeed on a Charisma save against the cast's DC first, a failure wasting the teleport; reversed, the same holds it in. The creatures it protects, inside the Cylinder or, reversed, outside it, hold its ward while there (zone-auras.ts): those types attack them with Disadvantage and can't charm, frighten or possess them. |
| Magic Jar | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The caster's catatonic body, the possession of a Humanoid (its Charisma save, the host's physical statistics over the caster's, the host's soul held in the container) and the returns and deaths that follow are the GM's: possession over a composed form and command has no vocabulary yet. |
| Magic Mouth | guided | The cast or its Ritual takes its minute (resolution/long-casting.ts) and consumes jade dust worth 10 GP (resolution/components.ts). The message and what sets it off are the GM's. |
| Magic Weapon | enforced | The caster's nonmagical weapon picked gains +1 to its attack and damage rolls, +2 from a level 3 slot and +3 from level 6 (equipment-derivation.ts), for the hour; casting it again moves it. A weapon another creature carries is the GM's. |
| Magnificent Mansion | guided | The cast takes its minute (resolution/long-casting.ts), needs a miniature door worth 15 GP (resolution/components.ts) and lasts 24 hours. The dwelling beyond the door is the GM's to run. |
| Major Image | guided | resolution/concentration.ts holds the caster's Concentration on it, and from a level 4 slot it lasts until dispelled with none. Its 20-foot Cube stays on the map, and the caster's Magic action moves it anywhere within range while the caster is (zone-moves.ts). The illusion itself is the GM's to run. |
| Mass Cure Wounds | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores 5d8 plus the modifier to up to six creatures the caster picks, and resolution/spell-targets.ts keeps them within one 30-foot Sphere centered within 60 feet. |
| Mass Heal | enforced | resolution/heal.ts divides the 700 Hit Points evenly among the creatures the caster picks, none past its maximum, and ends Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned on each. A different split is the caster's to make by hand. |
| Mass Suggestion | enforced | A failed save imposes Charmed on up to twelve creatures (resolution/spell-targets.ts). What the suggestion makes them do is the GM's. |
| Maze | enforced | The target leaves the map while the caster concentrates (off-plane.ts) and returns to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied one. It may take an action for a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check, which ends the spell on a success (resolution/builtins.ts). |
| Meld into Stone | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The caster merges with the stone for 8 hours: off the map, unseen and untouchable from outside and blind to it, casting only on itself, its Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear outside at Disadvantage, and back where it entered (off-plane.ts). Stepping out with 5 feet of movement is the GM's ending of the effect until an effect can be ended with movement; whether the stone is damaged enough to expel it (6d6 or 50 Force and Prone) is the GM's call, the stone not being on the map. |
| Mending | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The repair is the GM's. |
| Message | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The whisper and its reply are the table's. |
| Meteor Swarm | enforced | The cast places up to four 40-foot-radius Spheres at different points within range (multi-templates.ts), and a creature in more than one makes the Dexterity save once, against 20d6 Fire and 20d6 Bludgeoning damage, half on a success. A door or a wall on the map that is an object under the Spheres takes the whole of it, once (resolution/object-targets.ts). Setting objects alight is the GM's. |
| Mind Blank | enforced | The target is immune to Psychic damage (hit-points.ts) and the Charmed condition (effects.ts), and a Divination spell can't target it, catch it in its area or sense it (resolution/spell-wards.ts). Other ways to read its emotions or thoughts, and scrying sensors, are the GM's. |
| Mind Spike | enforced | The save and its Psychic damage are applied, and a failure outlines the target to the caster: Invisible gives it nothing against the caster's attacks or the caster's against it (resolution/attack.ts). Knowing where it is, and hiding, are the GM's. |
| Minor Illusion | guided | The cast spends its action and places its 5-foot Cube, and the table is told. The sound or image, and seeing through it with a Study, are the GM's. |
| Mirage Arcane | guided | The cast takes 10 minutes (resolution/long-casting.ts), and the table is told. The landscape is the GM's, who paints any Difficult Terrain it makes on the map (terrain.ts). |
| Mirror Image | enforced | The caster has three duplicates for a minute. Each hit on it rolls a d6 a duplicate, and on a 3 or higher the hit lands on a duplicate, which is destroyed, ending the spell with the last; an attacker Blinded or with Blindsight or Truesight is unaffected (resolution/mirror-image.ts). |
| Mislead | enforced | The caster turns Invisible until it attacks, deals damage or casts a spell, while the spell goes on (resolution/attack.ts), and its illusory double appears in its space (summons.ts): invulnerable and in no one's way, seeing for the caster's player (vision/audience.ts), moved twice the caster's Speed with a Magic action (summon-orders.ts). How the double behaves is the player's to describe. |
| Misty Step | enforced | granted-moves.ts gives the caster a 30-foot teleport for the turn, which movement-rules.ts takes at once to an unoccupied space it can see and refuses beyond its range. |
| Moonbeam | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Constitution save against 2d10 Radiant damage on the cast and when a creature enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, once a turn. On the caster's later turns a Magic action moves the Cylinder up to 60 feet (zone-moves.ts), and a creature it moves onto makes the save. Its Dim Light is placed for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). A shape-shifted creature that fails returns to its true form and can't shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder or the spell ends (transform/rules.ts, zone-auras.ts). |
| Move Earth | guided | The cast places its 40-foot Cube and holds Concentration for 2 hours. Reshaping the ground is the GM's, on the map's walls and terrain. |
| Nondetection | enforced | The caster or a creature on its side that it touches can't be the target of a Divination spell for 8 hours, nor be caught in one's area or sensed by one (resolution/spell-wards.ts). It consumes 25 GP of diamond dust (resolution/components.ts). Hiding a place or an object, and scrying sensors, are the GM's. |
| Pass without Trace | enforced | zone-auras.ts gives the caster and its allies +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks while they stand in the 30-foot Emanation. Leaving no tracks is the GM's to narrate. |
| Passwall | enforced | Aimed at a wall on the map within 30 feet that the caster sees, it cuts a 5-foot passage that sight and movement pass through for the hour (spell-walls.ts). When it closes, a creature still in the passage is moved out to the nearest unoccupied space on the side it was cut from. Whether a surface is wood, plaster or stone is the GM's, since the map's walls carry no material. |
| Phantasmal Force | enforced | A failed Intelligence save leaves the illusion on the target for the spell's duration, and a creature with Truesight succeeds. On each of the caster's turns its sheet offers the phantasm's 2d8 Psychic damage against that creature once, and against no other (lasting-spells.ts, resolution/economy.ts). The target's Study, an Intelligence (Investigation) check against the spell save DC, ends it (ending-actions.ts). What the phantasm is, and whether the target stands in it or within 5 feet of it, are the GM's. |
| Phantasmal Killer | enforced | The save and its 4d10 Psychic damage are applied, and a failure leaves Disadvantage on the target's ability checks and attack rolls, with the save repeated at the end of each of its turns until it succeeds and the 4d10 again on each failed repeat (save-stages.ts). |
| Phantom Steed | enforced | A Riding Horse with a Speed of 100 feet appears within 30 feet for the hour (summons.ts) and can be ridden (mounts.ts); any damage ends it. |
| Planar Ally | guided | The cast takes 10 minutes (resolution/long-casting.ts), and the table is told. The creature sent, its bargain and its payment are the GM's, who adds it to the encounter. |
| Planar Binding | enforced | Only a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey or a Fiend can be the target. A failed Charisma save binds it to serve the caster for the spell's duration (resolution/concentration.ts), under the caster's command and on its side (summons.ts). What it is told to do, and lengthening another spell's summoning, are the GM's. |
| Plane Shift | guided | The cast needs a forked metal rod worth 250 GP (resolution/components.ts) and takes the caster and up to eight creatures. The journey and where they arrive are the GM's. |
| Plant Growth | guided | Overgrowth makes a creature spend 4 feet of movement for every foot it moves in the Sphere (zone-ground.ts), until the GM ends the area, and the caster leaves squares of it out as it casts (zone-later.ts). The 8-hour Enrichment is the GM's. |
| Polymorph | enforced | A failed Wisdom save turns the target into a Beast of its Challenge Rating or lower that the caster picks (transform/options.ts): the Beast's statistics with the target's own Hit Points and creature type, Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast's Hit Points, no speech or spells, and gear melded. It ends with Concentration, when those Temporary Hit Points run out, or at death (transform/rules.ts). |
| Power Word Heal | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores all the target's Hit Points and ends Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned and Stunned, for one creature (resolution/spell-targets.ts). Standing up from Prone with its Reaction is the creature's choice. |
| Power Word Kill | enforced | resolution/kill.ts kills a target with 100 Hit Points or fewer outright, a character with no death saves, and deals 12d12 Psychic damage to any other. Death Ward turns the death aside. |
| Power Word Stun | enforced | A target with 150 Hit Points or fewer is Stunned and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns; a tougher one's Speed is 0 until the start of the caster's next turn (resolution/pending.ts). |
| Prayer of Healing | enforced | The 2d8 Hit Points are applied, each target gains a Short Rest's benefits, and a creature it healed is refused until it finishes a Long Rest (resolution/prayer-of-healing.ts). |
| Prestidigitation | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. Fire Play lights or puts out a flame within 10 feet: a light the GM set on the map, or the burning light a targeted creature carries (resolution/cast-lights.ts). The sensory effects, cleaning, marks, flavours and trinkets are the GM's, with up to three lasting at once. |
| Prismatic Spray | enforced | resolution/prismatic.ts rolls the d8 for each creature in the Cone, two rays on an 8, and the 12d6 once. Red to Blue ask the Dexterity save against their damage, half on a success. Indigo Restrains on a failure, with the Constitution saves counted until three successes end it or three failures Petrify it (save-stages.ts). Violet Blinds on a failure, and at the start of the caster's next turn the creature makes the Wisdom save: a success ends the Blinded condition, a failure ends it and takes the creature off the map to another plane (save-stages.ts, off-plane.ts). Which plane, and bringing it back, are the GM's. |
| Prismatic Wall | guided | The wall on its placed Line blocks sight and sheds its Bright and Dim Light (vision/cast-sight.ts), and placed through a creature's space the cast fails. A creature other than the caster's allies that can see it and moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there makes the Constitution save against Blinded for 1 minute, and one passing into it makes the seven layers' Dexterity saves in order: 12d6 Fire, Acid, Lightning, Poison and Cold, half on a success, Indigo's Restrained with its tally toward Petrified, and Violet's Blinded with the trip to another plane (spell-zones.ts, resolution/prismatic.ts). Designating creatures other than allies, the globe, what each layer blocks, the wall's AC and destroying the layers are the GM's. |
| Private Sanctum | guided | The cast places the Cube, 100 feet a side and 100 more for each slot level above 4, and picks any of its properties (spell-zones.ts): a dark and foggy edge that sight, Darkvision included, can't pass either way (resolution/zone-casts.ts, vision/areas.ts); no teleporting into or out of it (zone-barriers.ts); and no Divination spell targeting, or catching in its area, a creature inside (zone-auras.ts, resolution/spell-wards.ts). It lasts 24 hours on the game clock. A Cube smaller than the spell's size is the GM's to redraw, and sound across the edge, Divination sensors, planar travel and the year of castings that makes it permanent are the GM's. |
| Programmed Illusion | guided | The cast needs jade dust worth 25 GP (resolution/components.ts) and places its 30-foot Cube. The illusion and what sets it off are the GM's. |
| Project Image | enforced | The illusory copy appears anywhere on the map (summons.ts), seeing for the caster's player (vision/audience.ts) and moved 60 feet with a Magic action (summon-orders.ts). Any damage to it ends it and the spell. Its intangibility to touch and a Study action to discern it are the GM's. |
| Protection from Evil and Good | enforced | Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target and can't make it Charmed or Frightened or possess it (effects.ts). A target already charmed, frightened or possessed by one has Advantage on any new save against that effect (save-stages.ts). |
| Protection from Poison | enforced | The cast ends Poisoned and leaves Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned, for an hour counted on the game clock (game-time.ts). |
| Purify Food and Drink | guided | The cast or its Ritual places its 5-foot Sphere, and the table is told. What it cleanses is the GM's. |
| Raise Dead | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than 10 days of game time, less any time under Gentle Repose, one Undead when it died, and one whose body or head is gone. It returns with 1 Hit Point and no longer Poisoned, and takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that eases by 1 with each Long Rest (death.ts). |
| Ray of Enfeeblement | enforced | A failed Constitution save gives Disadvantage on Strength attack rolls, checks and saves and takes 1d8 off each damage roll, never below 1, repeating the save at the end of each turn; a success gives Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the caster's next turn (resolution/pending.ts). |
| Regenerate | enforced | The 4d8 + 15 Hit Points are applied to one creature, which regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns for the hour (turn-boundaries.ts). Regrowing severed parts is the GM's. |
| Reincarnate | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than 10 days and returns it with all its Hit Points in a new body, rolling the d10 for its species (a 1 rolls again). A character built here is then rebuilt from its ledger as that species (reincarnation.ts): the old species' traits and picks go, its classes, background and scores stay, and the new species' picks take their first legal options, which the narration names and the GM can change in the Level flow. A creature with no build ledger keeps the note for the GM. The soul's consent is the table's. |
| Remove Curse | enforced | resolution/dispel.ts ends every effect marked a curse on the target (Hex, Bestow Curse, Geas, a lycanthrope's or a lamia's and other monsters'), and breaks its Attunement to a cursed item so the item can be removed; the item's own curse stays. A curse the app doesn't track is the GM's. |
| Resilient Sphere | enforced | A failed Dexterity save shuts the target in the sphere while the caster concentrates (enclosures.ts). An attack or spell on it from outside, or from it on anything outside, meets Total Cover's refusal, and an area leaves it out. Disintegrate aimed at it destroys the sphere, harms nothing inside and ends the spell. Rolling the sphere along, and a willing target, are the GM's. |
| Resistance | enforced | The touched creature takes 1d4 off damage of the type picked, once a turn, while the caster concentrates (hit-points.ts). |
| Resurrection | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than a century, one Undead when it died, and one whose body is gone; a lost head is restored. It returns with all its Hit Points, no longer Poisoned, with a -4 penalty to D20 Tests that eases by 1 with each Long Rest (death.ts). For a creature dead 365 days or longer the caster can't cast spells and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until a Long Rest. Death by old age is the GM's to rule. |
| Reverse Gravity | enforced | Each creature in the 50-foot Cylinder that fails the Dexterity save falls up to its top, 100 feet, and hangs there while the spell lasts (falling.ts); a creature that comes into the Cylinder later makes the save the same way (spell-zones.ts). When the spell ends they fall, taking the falling damage and landing Prone. A ceiling lower than the top, and the objects in the area, are the GM's. |
| Revivify | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target that isn't dead, died more than a minute of game time ago (death.ts keeps the time of death: an encounter's rounds, then the game clock), or lost its body or its head. The cast returns it with 1 Hit Point and spends the diamond (resolution/components.ts). Death by old age is the GM's to rule. |
| Rope Trick | enforced | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. Up to eight willing Medium or smaller creatures beside the rope, named at the cast, climb into its space for the hour: off the map, where nothing passes in or out (off-plane.ts), and they drop out where each left when it ends. Where the rope hangs, and a creature climbing in later, are the GM's. |
| Sanctuary | enforced | resolution/ward.ts asks the Wisdom save of a creature that targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell; a failure spends nothing and turns it away from the warded creature for the rest of its turn, so it picks another target. Areas aren't stopped, and the spell ends when the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell or deals damage (resolution/attack.ts). |
| Scrying | guided | The cast takes 10 minutes and needs its 1,000 GP focus (resolution/components.ts). The caster picks how well it knows the target and its connection to it, whose modifiers the target's Wisdom save takes (resolution/pending.ts), and a target that succeeds can't be scried again by it for 24 hours of the game clock (save-immunity.ts). What the sensor shows is the GM's. |
| Secret Chest | guided | The cast needs the chest worth 5,000 GP and its replica worth 50 GP (resolution/components.ts). Hiding the chest on the Ethereal Plane and calling it back with its contents are the GM's. |
| Seeming | guided | Each creature the caster picks that it can see within 30 feet takes the disguise: one on the caster's side with no save, any other only on a failed Charisma save (resolution/pending.ts). The disguises and their 8 hours are the GM's. |
| Sending | guided | The cast is told to the table. The message, the reply and whether it arrives are the table's. |
| Sequester | enforced | The target is Invisible and Unconscious until the spell ends, which taking damage does (effects.ts). The end condition the caster sets, and hiding from divination, are the GM's. |
| Shapechange | enforced | The caster takes a form of its level or Challenge Rating or lower, not a Construct or an Undead, keeping its mind, proficiencies and Spellcasting, with Temporary Hit Points from the first form. A Magic action takes a new form while the spell lasts, and the caster picks whether its gear is worn or melds. |
| Shatter | enforced | The cast's Constitution save against 3d8 Thunder damage, half on a success, is asked of each creature in the 10-foot-radius Sphere, a Construct making it with Disadvantage (saving-throws.ts). A door or a wall on the map that is an object under the Sphere takes the whole of the damage (resolution/object-targets.ts). |
| Shillelagh | enforced | The cast binds to the Club or Quarterstaff the caster picks (resolution/grant-extras.ts): its attack and damage rolls use the better of Strength and the spellcasting ability, its die becomes a d8 (d10 at level 5, d12 at 11, 2d6 at 17), and a hit deals Force or its own type (item-actions.ts). Casting it again moves it, and it ends once the weapon leaves the pack (bound-weapons.ts). |
| Silence | enforced | zone-auras.ts makes a creature Deafened and Immune to Thunder damage while it stands in the Sphere, and silence.ts refuses a spell with a Verbal component cast from inside it (resolution/components.ts). |
| Silent Image | guided | resolution/concentration.ts holds the caster's Concentration on it, and its 15-foot Cube stays on the map: the caster's Magic action moves it anywhere within range (zone-moves.ts). The illusion itself is the GM's to run. |
| Simulacrum | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. The copy of a Beast or Humanoid (a Construct with half its Hit Point maximum under the caster's command), its repair at 100 GP a Hit Point during a Long Rest and its end at 0 Hit Points or on a new casting are the GM's: a summon copied from a creature on the roster has no vocabulary yet. |
| Sleep | enforced | A failed save imposes Incapacitated until the end of the target's next turn, then the second save leaves it Unconscious on a failure (save-stages.ts). Damage ends either stage, and so does a creature within 5 feet taking the Shake Awake action (resolution/builtins.ts). An elf or a creature immune to Exhaustion succeeds without a roll. |
| Sleet Storm | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save when a creature enters the Cylinder or starts its turn there, and a failure leaves it Prone and ends its Concentration. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). zone-ground.ts makes the Cylinder Difficult Terrain of ice, and it is Heavily Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). It douses a burning creature in it and the open flames carried there (zone-outcomes.ts, item-light.ts). |
| Sorcerous Burst | enforced | The attack and the chosen damage type are applied, with the cantrip's dice at the caster's level, and each 8 rolled on its d8s adds another d8, the added dice exploding too, up to the caster's spellcasting ability modifier in added dice (resolution/damage.ts). |
| Spare the Dying | enforced | The cast makes a creature at 0 Hit Points Stable with no check (resolution/stabilize.ts), within 15 feet, 30 at level 5, 60 at level 11 and 120 at level 17 (resolution/spell-targets.ts). |
| Speak with Animals | guided | The cast or its Ritual lasts 10 minutes, and the table is told. The talk is the table's, and an Influence check with a Beast rolls as usual (resolution/builtins.ts). |
| Speak with Dead | guided | The cast lasts 10 minutes, and the table is told. The corpse's answers are the GM's. |
| Speak with Plants | guided | The cast picks what the plants do with the ground of its 30-foot Emanation, which stays where it was cast: the plants clear the painted Difficult Terrain to ordinary ground, or overgrow it into Difficult Terrain (zone-ground.ts). Talking with the plants is the GM's. |
| Spike Growth | enforced | spell-zones.ts deals 2d4 Piercing damage for every 5 feet a creature travels into or within the Sphere, and zone-ground.ts makes the Sphere Difficult Terrain. Whether a creature saw the danger before it moved in is the GM's. |
| Spirit Guardians | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the save when a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, and charges an affected creature double for each step it moves inside (terrain.ts). The creatures the caster designates are its allies. |
| Spiritual Weapon | enforced | The force appears within 60 feet (summons.ts) and the cast's attack reaches a creature within 5 feet of it; each later Bonus Action moves it up to 20 feet first and strikes from there (summon-strikes.ts). The force can't be harmed and fills no space. |
| Stone Shape | guided | Aimed at a door on the map the caster touches, it seals the door shut so that no check opens it; aimed at a wall, it cuts a lasting 5-foot passage through it (spell-walls.ts, doors.ts). The other shapes it makes are the GM's. |
| Storm of Vengeance | enforced | The first turn's save, Thunder damage and Deafened condition are applied, and spell-zones.ts runs turns 2 to 10 at the start of each of the caster's later turns under the cloud: the acid rain, the six bolts the caster calls with a Magic action (zone-later.ts), the hail, and the freezing rain that makes the ground Difficult Terrain, Heavily Obscures it, stops ranged weapon attacks and puts out open flames. Whether it is outdoors is the GM's. |
| Summon Dragon | enforced | The Draconic Spirit at the slot's level appears within 60 feet and acts right after the caster with its spell attack modifier and save DC, its Rends half the slot's level (summons.ts); uncommanded, it takes the Dodge action (summon-turns.ts). The caster shares the Resistance picked while it lasts. It disappears at 0 Hit Points or when the Concentration ends. |
| Symbol | enforced | The cast picks the glyph, which waits hidden at its point, drawn for the GM and its caster (spell-zones.ts). A creature that comes onto it sets it off: it glows for 10 minutes, and each creature in its 60-foot Sphere, or entering it or ending its turn there once a turn, makes the glyph's save (Death's 10d10 Necrotic, Discord, Fear, Pain, Sleep or Stunning). A Search whose Wisdom (Perception) check meets the spell save DC within 10 feet notices the glyph and draws it for everyone (traps.ts). A creature the Fear glyph frightens must move at least 30 feet away from it on each of its turns, if able (compelled-moves.ts). |
| Telekinesis | enforced | With the cast and as a Magic action on later turns, a Huge or smaller creature that fails the Strength save is moved up to 30 feet to the space the caster picks, lifted as high as it picks, and Restrained and held aloft until the end of the caster's next turn, when it falls (resolution/telekinesis.ts, altitude.ts, falling.ts); a new target lets the old one go. A creature that fails it can instead have the weapon it holds pulled from its hands. Unattended objects and fine control are the GM's. |
| Telepathic Bond | guided | The cast or its Ritual links up to eight creatures for the hour, and the table is told. What they say to one another is the table's. |
| Teleport | guided | The caster picks how familiar the destination is as it casts, and the server rolls the d100 on the Teleportation Outcome table (resolution/teleport-outcome.ts): a Mishap deals 3d10 Force damage to the caster and each creature it takes and rolls again, Off Target rolls the 2d12 miles and the d8 direction, and Similar Area and On Target are told to the table. Where the destination is, the travellers leaving the map and the encounter they arrive in are the GM's. |
| Teleportation Circle | guided | The cast takes its minute (resolution/long-casting.ts) and consumes rare inks worth 50 GP (resolution/components.ts), and the circle stays until the end of the caster's next turn. Where it leads is the GM's. |
| Thaumaturgy | enforced | The cast keeps the wonder picked for a minute (resolution/grant-extras.ts), and Booming Voice gives Advantage on Intimidation checks (ability-checks.ts). Aimed at a door on the map within 30 feet, Invisible Hand flings an unlocked door open or slams it shut (resolution/cast-walls.ts). What the other wonders look and sound like is the GM's. |
| Time Stop | enforced | time-stop.ts rolls 1d4 + 1 and gives the caster that many turns in a row; an action of its that targets another creature, or a move more than 1,000 feet from where it cast the spell, ends it. A spell area the caster made during it that later acts on another creature ends it too (spell-zones.ts), a burst included. |
| Tiny Hut | enforced | The dome stays where it was cast (zone-barriers.ts): only the creatures inside it at the cast pass through it, and a spell of level 3 or lower cast from outside can't reach inside. The cast fails while a creature's space lies partly in the dome. Those outside can't see in while those inside see out (resolution/zone-casts.ts, vision/sight.ts), the cast commands Dim Light or Darkness inside, and the spell ends when its caster leaves the dome (zone-auras.ts). Commanding the light again after the cast, the dome's colour and the weather inside are the GM's. |
| Tongues | guided | The touched creature understands and is understood in any language for the hour, which the table plays. |
| Transport via Plants | guided | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. | Tree Stride | enforced | The cast spends its action and checks its components (resolution/economy.ts, resolution/components.ts), and the table is told. Once on each of the caster's turns while it concentrates it may teleport up to 500 feet, seen or not, from one tree to another for 10 feet of movement (granted-moves.ts, movement-rules.ts). Where the trees stand and which share a kind are the GM's: trees aren't map pieces. |
| True Polymorph | guided | Creature into Creature is applied (transform/): an unwilling target saves, a willing one doesn't, and it takes a stat block of its Challenge Rating or lower with Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Points, no speech or spells. Object into Creature and Creature into Object are the GM's: neither an object nor an object form is a game piece yet. |
| True Resurrection | enforced | resolution/revival.ts refuses a target dead more than 200 years, and brings back one whose body is gone (Disintegrate) in a new body. | True Strike | enforced | The cast binds a carried weapon the caster is proficient with and leaves its Magic action open for one attack with that weapon, which uses the spellcasting ability for the attack and damage rolls, deals Radiant or the weapon's own type as the caster picks, and adds 1d6 Radiant at level 5, 2d6 at 11 and 3d6 at 17; the binding ends with that attack (resolution/grant-extras.ts, resolution/true-strike.ts). |
| Tsunami | enforced | The wall's first save and damage are applied. At the start of each of the caster's later turns zone-waves.ts moves it 50 feet away from the caster with the creatures in it, each Huge or smaller creature in it or that it moves onto making the save once a round, and at the end of that turn it loses 50 feet of height and 1d10 of its damage, ending at none. A creature in it can't move unless it first succeeds on a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell save DC. A fall from the wall's top is the GM's. |
| Unseen Servant | enforced | The Invisible servant appears within 60 feet with AC 10, 1 Hit Point and Strength 2 and can't attack (summons.ts). A Bonus Action sends it 15 feet (summon-orders.ts), and it ends more than 60 feet from the caster. Its tasks are the GM's. |
| Wall of Fire | enforced | spell-zones.ts deals 5d8 Fire damage to a creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn in it, after the cast's Dexterity save, and the wall blocks sight for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). The cast picks a straight wall or a ring and its burning side, and a creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side takes the damage too (zone-shapes.ts). |
| Wall of Force | enforced | The cast raises the wall on its placed Line as walls that stop movement and leave sight through (spell-walls.ts). A creature in its space is moved out of it, the caster's allies to the caster's side and the rest to the far side. Nothing damages it, Disintegrate destroys it whole and ends the spell, and it goes when the Concentration ends. Picked as a dome or globe, it is raised round the 10-foot circle the cast places, holding in or out the creatures it rings (resolution/cast-walls.ts). Its angle off the ground and its reach into the Ethereal Plane are the GM's. |
| Wall of Ice | enforced | The save and its Cold damage for creatures in the wall's space are applied, and they are moved out of it. The wall rises on its placed Line as 10-foot sections that stop movement and leave sight through (spell-walls.ts), each an object with AC 12 and 30 Hit Points, Immunity to Cold damage and Vulnerability to Fire damage that is gone at 0 Hit Points (objects.ts). It goes when the Concentration ends. The frigid air a broken section leaves, and the dome and sphere forms, are the GM's. |
| Wall of Stone | enforced | The cast raises the wall on its placed Line as 10-foot stone panels that stop movement and sight, each an object with AC 15, 180 Hit Points and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage that is gone at 0 Hit Points (spell-walls.ts, objects.ts); picked as the thin form, it raises 20-foot panels of 90 Hit Points along a Line twice as long. A creature in its space is moved out of it. The wall stays for good once the caster holds Concentration for the full 10 minutes, and goes if the Concentration ends sooner. Its bridges, ramps and battlements, the panels that fall with a broken one, and the save of a creature it would shut in against the map's other walls are the GM's. |
| Wall of Thorns | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save against 7d8 Slashing damage when a creature enters the wall or ends its turn there, once a turn, after the cast's 7d8 Piercing. zone-ground.ts makes a creature spend 4 feet of movement for every foot it moves through the wall, and the wall blocks sight for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). Its circle form is the GM's. |
| Warding Bond | enforced | The target has +1 to AC and saving throws and Resistance to all damage for the hour, and each time it takes damage the caster takes the same amount (hit-points.ts). The bond ends when the caster drops to 0 Hit Points or the two are more than 60 feet apart on the map, and a new Warding Bond cast on either creature ends the old one (warding-bond.ts). |
| Water Breathing | enforced | The cast gives each target the water-breathing effect for 24 hours, which ends any breath it holds and spares it from holding one (breath.ts). |
| Water Walk | enforced | Each target moves across the water painted on the map as on solid ground (speed.ts, terrain.ts), so swimming costs it nothing and nothing in the water reaches it (water.ts).
