| Web | enforced | spell-zones.ts asks for the Dexterity save the first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, and a failure leaves it Restrained, escaped with a Strength (Athletics) check against the spell save DC. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). zone-ground.ts makes the webs Difficult Terrain, and they are Lightly Obscured for dynamic vision (vision/cast-sight.ts). Fire burns them (zone-fire.ts): a 5-foot square that Fire damage, a fire's area or a burning creature reaches burns for a round, dealing 2d4 Fire damage to a creature that starts its turn there, and is then gone, and the spell ends with the last of the webs. |
| Weird | enforced | The save, its Psychic damage and Frightened are applied, with the repeat save at the end of each turn and 5d10 Psychic damage on each failed repeat (save-stages.ts). |
| Wind Walk | enforced | Each willing target becomes a cloud with a Fly Speed of 300 feet that hovers, Immunity to Prone and Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage; it can only Dash or take the Magic action that ends the form, which leaves it Stunned for 1 minute. While the spell lasts each target keeps a Magic action that makes it a cloud again, Stunned for the minute of the change (resolution/shape-shift.ts, granted-actions.ts). A cloud whose form ends in the air drifts down safely, and one more than 600 feet up falls the rest (altitude.ts, falling.ts). |
| Wind Wall | enforced | The save and its Bludgeoning damage are applied. While the caster concentrates, zone-walls.ts makes an arrow, a bolt or a thrown weapon miss a target across the wall, and zone-barriers.ts bars a Small or smaller creature in the air from crossing it. A giant's Rock and spells go through. Its hold on gases is the GM's. |
| Wish | guided | The cast picks its use (resolution/wish.ts). Instant Health restores the caster and the creatures it picks to all their Hit Points; Resistance gives up to ten creatures it picks lasting Resistance to the type chosen; Spell Immunity marks up to ten for 8 hours. Any use but duplicating a spell stresses the caster: each spell it casts until a Long Rest deals it 1d10 per spell level that nothing reduces, the 2d4 days of Strength 3 are marked, and the server rolls the 33 percent chance, after which a Wish cast is refused (resolution/economy.ts). Which spell a Wish duplicates and its cast, the conditions Instant Health ends, the spell Spell Immunity names, the Strength score itself, Sudden Learning's feat, Roll Redo, Object Creation and Reshape Reality are the GM's. |
| Word of Recall | guided | The cast takes the caster and up to five creatures within 5 feet, and the table is told. The sanctuary and the arrival there are the GM's. |
| Zone of Truth | guided | spell-zones.ts asks a creature that enters the 15-foot Sphere for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there for the Charisma save, in an encounter or out of one, and the caster knows the result. Whether it lies is the GM's to play. |

| Gnoll Warrior: Rampage (1/Day) | enforced | It is offered only right after the gnoll damages a creature that was already Bloodied (bloodied-hits.ts). Taken move first, the use is spent and a move of half its Speed granted (granted-moves.ts), and then it makes its Rend. |
| Gray Ooze: Pseudopod | enforced | The attack and its 2d8 + 1 Acid damage are applied, and a hit gives the nonmagical body armor the target wears a cumulative -1 to the AC it offers, destroying it at AC 10 (resolution/on-hit.ts, row-penalties.ts). Mending removes the penalty (resolution/mend.ts). |
| Green Hag: Spellcasting | guided | Casts its listed spells at the stat block's numbers (monster-spells.ts); Minor Illusion applies only as its own row says. |
| Half-Dragon: Claw | enforced | The hit's Slashing damage and 2d6 of the type picked for its Draconic Origin are applied (statblock-picks.ts); a half-dragon with no pick yet asks the GM for one first. |
| Homunculus: Bite | enforced | The hit's damage is applied and its Constitution save opens. A failure leaves the target Poisoned until the end of the homunculus's next turn; a failure by 5 or more Poisons it for 1 minute, and Unconscious with it until it takes damage (save-margins.ts). |
| Horned Devil: Hurl Flame | guided | The server resolves it and says the GM's part with it: A flammable object the target hit that isn't worn or carried starts burning; objects are the GM's to burn. |

| Kraken: Fling | enforced | Its one target is a Large or smaller creature the kraken grapples (resolution/action-targets.ts), and the use picks a space it can see within 60 feet on the ground (resolution/destination.ts): the creature lands there, out of the kraken's grip, and the save falls on it and each creature in that space (saving-throws.ts). |

A Huge or larger creature that fails takes the Piercing damage alone. 50 damage from inside in one turn makes it save at DC 25 as that turn ends or let them all out Prone where they stand, and its death lets them climb out. |

| Lamia: Spellcasting | guided | Casts its listed spells at the stat block's numbers (monster-spells.ts); Minor Illusion, Major Image apply only as their own rows say. |

The terrifying message's 3d6 Psychic as the target wakes lowers its Hit Point maximum by as much, and a target it kills has its soul trapped in the bag, which no revival gets past until the bag is destroyed (rest-triggers.ts, resolution/revival.ts, objects.ts). ## Monster traits

The number after each trait is how many stat blocks print it.

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Abduct (2) | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges the bugbear no extra movement to drag a creature it grapples. |
| Aberrant Ground (1) | enforced | zone-ground.ts makes the ground within 10 feet of the mouther Difficult Terrain for every other creature, and it moves with the mouther; the move preview shows it round a mouther the mover can see (zone-preview.ts). |
| Acid Absorption (1) | enforced | Each time Acid damage lands on it, the creature regains Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt (damage-traits.ts), beside the stat block's own defences against it (hit-points.ts). |
| Adhesive (1) | enforced | In object form, a Huge or smaller creature that hits the mimic with a melee attack sticks to it: Grappled, escape DC 13 with Disadvantage on the check, until the mimic is defeated (resolution/struck.ts). Objects stuck to it are the GM's. |
| Agile (2) | enforced | movement-rules.ts opens no Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy's reach. |
| Air Form (2) | enforced | movement-rules.ts lets the air elemental end a move in another creature's space and the invisible stalker only in an enemy's, and terrain.ts lets either through any gap in the walls an inch wide at no extra cost (wall-passage.ts). The map's drag preview (movePreview.ts) charges the same path. |
| Amorphous (4) | enforced | With dynamic vision on, terrain.ts lets the creature through any gap in the walls its body can follow, however narrow, at no extra cost (wall-passage.ts, slipsThroughStep in rules-5e), and the map's drag preview (movePreview.ts) charges the same path. A closed door still stops it. |
| Amphibious (31) | enforced | breath.ts reads it: the creature breathes water, or holds its breath for the time it prints, when it is out of air. |
| Aura of Authority (1) | enforced | statblock-traits.ts gives the hobgoblin and its allies within 10 feet Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws while it isn't Incapacitated. |
| Aversion to Fire (1) | enforced | Fire damage that lands gives the golem Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn (damage-traits.ts). |
| Barbed Hide (1) | enforced | trait-turns.ts deals 1d10 Piercing damage at the start of the devil's turns to each creature it grapples or that grapples it. |
| Beast of Burden (1) | enforced | carrying.ts counts the creature one size larger for its carrying capacity, and weighs what its inventory holds against it. |
| Berserk (2) | enforced | trait-turns.ts rolls the d6 when the golem starts its turn Bloodied and keeps it berserk until it isn't Bloodied. While berserk its attacks go only to the nearest creature it can see (resolution/action-targets.ts). Which object it smashes with no creature in sight is the GM's. |
| Blood Frenzy (1) | enforced | resolution/attack.ts gives the sahuagin Advantage against a creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points. |
| Bloodied Frenzy (1) | enforced | resolution/attack.ts and saving-throws.ts give the Bloodied berserker Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws. |
| Bloodied Fury (2) | enforced | resolution/attack.ts gives the Bloodied creature Advantage on attack rolls. |
| Blurred Form (1) | enforced | Attack rolls against the mephit have Disadvantage unless it is Incapacitated (resolution/attack.ts). |
| Bound (1) | enforced | The amulet's wearer is the creature that commands the guardian. While the guardian is within 60 feet of it, half of any damage the wearer takes, rounded up, goes to the guardian instead (shared-damage.ts, hit-points.ts). The telepathic call and sensing the amulet's direction are the GM's. |
| Celestial Restoration (1) | enforced | timed-revival.ts rolls the time as the creature dies and keeps it on its death record, which no player reads, and once that much game time has passed it comes back to life with all its Hit Points (game-time.ts), unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains or within 5 feet of them first (resolution/remains.ts). Where it reappears is the GM's, told as it returns. |
| Compression (1) | enforced | With dynamic vision on, terrain.ts lets the creature through any gap in the walls its body can follow, however narrow, at no extra cost (wall-passage.ts, slipsThroughStep in rules-5e), and the map's drag preview (movePreview.ts) charges the same path. A closed door still stops it. |
| Confer Fire Resistance (1) | enforced | mounts.ts gives a creature that mounts the nightmare Resistance to Fire damage for as long as it rides. |
| Corrosive Form (2) | enforced | resolution/struck.ts deals the black pudding's 1d8 Acid damage to a creature that hits it with a melee attack (the gray ooze's printing deals none), and gives a nonmagical weapon that damages it a cumulative -1 to attack rolls, destroyed at -5 (row-penalties.ts; Mending removes it, resolution/mend.ts). Nonmagical ammunition that hits and damages it is destroyed, so none of it is found after the encounter (resolution/ammunition.ts). Eating through wood or metal is the GM's. |
| Death Burst (5) | enforced | statblock-traits.ts opens the save for each creature in the Emanation when it dies, with the damage rolled once. |
| Death Throes (1) | enforced | statblock-traits.ts opens the Dexterity save for each creature within 30 feet when the balor dies, with its Fire and Force damage rolled once. Its new body in the Abyss is the GM's. |
| Demonic Restoration (5) | guided | death-traits.ts tells the GM as the creature dies that it may come back, and marks a body that disappears as gone (death.ts). When and where it returns are the GM's. |
| Diabolical Restoration (7) | guided | death-traits.ts tells the GM as the creature dies that it may come back, and marks a body that disappears as gone (death.ts). When and where it returns are the GM's. |
| Divine Awareness (2) | reference | Communication and senses like this are the GM's to run. |
| Draconic Origin (1) | enforced | The GM picks the damage type once for each half-dragon from its row tools (statblock-picks.ts, PickControl). Its Dragon's Breath and its Claw's 2d6 deal that type every time, and an unpicked one asks for the pick first. |

## Barbarian features

**Enforced (23):** Ability Score Improvement · Barbarian Subclass · Brutal Strike · Danger Sense · Epic Boon · Extra Attack · Fast Movement · Feral Instinct · Frenzy (Path of the Berserker) · Improved Brutal Strike · Indomitable Might · Instinctive Pounce · Intimidating Presence (Path of the Berserker) · Mindless Rage (Path of the Berserker) · Persistent Rage · Primal Champion · Primal Knowledge · Rage · Reckless Attack · Relentless Rage · Retaliation (Path of the Berserker) · Unarmored Defense · Weapon Mastery

Notes on the curated rows:

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Brutal Strike | enforced | After Reckless Attack, the tap forgoes the Advantage of the Barbarian's next Strength attack this turn (resolution/attack.ts), and its hit carries 1d10 of the weapon's type and one effect (resolution/hit-options.ts): Forceful Blow's 15-foot push and a move of half its Speed that must end nearer the target and provokes no Opportunity Attacks (granted-moves.ts), or Hamstring Blow's 15 feet less Speed, one at a time on a creature. |
| Improved Brutal Strike | enforced | Staggering Blow (Disadvantage on the next save and no Opportunity Attacks) and Sundering Blow (+5 to the next attack roll another creature makes against the target) join Brutal Strike's effects, and from Barbarian 17 a hit carries 2d10 and two effects (resolution/hit-options.ts, resolution/attack.ts). |
| Instinctive Pounce | enforced | The Bonus Action that starts a Rage gives the Barbarian a move of half its Speed for the turn (resolution/movement-grants.ts), charged to its own grant (movement-rules.ts). |
| Intimidating Presence (Path of the Berserker) | enforced | The Bonus Action's Wisdom save against Frightened is applied, and conversions.ts restores its use for one use of Rage (actor.convert). |
| Mindless Rage (Path of the Berserker) | enforced | Immunity to Charmed and Frightened while raging is applied (equipment-derivation.ts), and either condition ends as the Rage starts (resolution/grant.ts). |
| Persistent Rage | enforced | When the Barbarian rolls Initiative, initiative-hooks.ts opens its window and the Persistent Rage action restores every expended use of Rage, once per Long Rest (resolution/rage.ts). A Rage under it lasts 10 minutes, and only Unconscious ends it early (effects.ts). |
| Primal Knowledge | enforced | The extra skill is applied. While raging, Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth and Survival checks are made as Strength checks when that is the better roll (ability-checks.ts). |
| Relentless Rage | enforced | hit-points.ts rolls the Constitution save when a raging Barbarian drops to 0 Hit Points and isn't killed outright: DC 10, 5 more for each use since its last rest (rests.ts clears the count). A success leaves it at twice its Barbarian level. |
| Weapon Mastery | enforced | equipment-derivation.ts applies the mastery property of each picked weapon kind. A Barbarian picks melee weapons and a Rogue the weapons it is proficient with. In the step a Long Rest opens, actor.rechoose swaps picks and rebuilds the sheet (ledger-rechoice.ts): one for a Barbarian or Fighter, any for a Paladin, Ranger or Rogue. |

## Bard features

**Enforced (16):** Ability Score Improvement · Bard Subclass · Bardic Inspiration · Bonus Proficiencies (College of Lore) · Countercharm · Cutting Words (College of Lore) · Epic Boon · Expertise · Font of Inspiration · Jack of All Trades · Magical Discoveries (College of Lore) · Magical Secrets · Peerless Skill (College of Lore) · Spellcasting · Superior Inspiration · Words of Creation

Notes on the curated rows:

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bardic Inspiration | enforced | The Bonus Action gives another creature within 60 feet that can see or hear the Bard (resolution/action-targets.ts) the Bard's die, a d6 growing to a d12, one die at a time, for an hour of game time; roll-answers.ts offers it when that creature fails an attack roll, a save, a check or a death save, and the die is added and spent. |
| Countercharm | enforced | roll-answers.ts asks the Bard by a reaction prompt when it or a creature within 30 feet fails a save against an effect that would make it Charmed or Frightened. The save waits, and using the Reaction rerolls it with Advantage. |
| Cutting Words (College of Lore) | enforced | roll-answers.ts asks the Bard by a reaction prompt when a creature it can see within 60 feet hits with an attack roll, succeeds on a check or rolls damage. Using it spends a Bardic Inspiration use and the Reaction and takes the die off the roll, which can turn the hit into a miss or lower the damage before it lands (damage-window.ts). |
| Font of Inspiration | enforced | Bardic Inspiration comes back on a Short Rest, and conversions.ts spends a spell slot for one use of it. |
| Jack of All Trades | enforced | ability-checks.ts adds half the Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, to a skill check the Bard isn't proficient in. |
| Peerless Skill (College of Lore) | enforced | roll-answers.ts offers it on the Bard's failed attack roll or check: the Bardic Inspiration die is added, and the use is kept when the roll still fails. |
| Spellcasting | enforced | character-build.ts gives the class its slots, cantrips and prepared spells, and each spell is a cast action at the class's spell save DC and attack bonus. resolution/economy.ts spends the slot, and rests.ts restores slots on a Long Rest. level-up-picks.ts lets a player's level up replace only the cantrips and spells the class's level allows. |
| Superior Inspiration | enforced | When the Bard rolls Initiative with fewer than two uses of Bardic Inspiration left, initiative-hooks.ts brings it up to two. |
| Words of Creation | enforced | Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill are always prepared, and either may take a second creature within 10 feet of the first (resolution/action-targets.ts). |

| Potent Cantrip (Evoker) | enforced | resolution/damage.ts deals half an Evoker's cantrip damage on a missed attack roll, and resolution/pending.ts halves it on a successful save, with no other effect. |
| Ritual Adept | enforced | A Wizard casts a Ritual spell from its spellbook unprepared while it carries the book (resolution/economy.ts), a spell copied into the book beyond the sheet included (ritual-adept.ts). Without the book the unprepared Ritual is refused. |
| Sculpt Spells (Evoker) | enforced | An Evoker's Evocation spell protects up to 1 plus the spell's level creatures the Wizard can see: they succeed on its save with no roll and take no damage (resolution/pending.ts). Saves its area calls for later are rolled as usual. |
| Signature Spells | enforced | Two level 3 spells from the spellbook (spellbook.ts checks the pick as a build or a level up makes it) are always prepared, and each is cast once at level 3 with no slot, back on a Short or Long Rest, on its own counter (character-build.ts). |
| Spell Mastery | enforced | The level 1 and level 2 picks, spells from the spellbook with a casting time of an action (character-offers.ts filters the casting time, spellbook.ts checks the book), are always prepared and cast at will at their own level with no slot (character-build.ts); one is swapped for another of the same level from the book in the step a Long Rest opens (ledger-rechoice.ts). |
| Spellcasting | enforced | character-build.ts gives the class its slots, cantrips and prepared spells, and each spell is a cast action at the class's spell save DC and attack bonus. resolution/economy.ts spends the slot, and rests.ts restores slots on a Long Rest. level-up-picks.ts lets a player's level up replace only the cantrips and spells the class's level allows. |

| Arcane Cantrip (High Elf) | enforced | The High Elf knows Prestidigitation, a pick the build fills when the ledger names none (character-build.ts), or the Wizard cantrip it swapped in during the step a Long Rest opens (ledger-rechoice.ts). |

| Clockwork Devices (Rock Gnome) | reference | The table makes and runs the devices: each makes one Prestidigitation effect, which is flavour, and lasts 8 hours. |
| Damage Resistance (Dragonborn) | enforced | The ancestry's own Damage Resistance row grants the Resistance, which hit-points.ts applies. |

Cloud's Jaunt gives a 30-foot teleport taken on the map at once to an unoccupied space the Goliath can see (granted-moves.ts). |
| Halfling Nimbleness (Halfling) | enforced | A Halfling moves through the space of a creature larger than it as Difficult Terrain, and can't end its move there (movement-rules.ts, spacePassage in rules-5e); the map's drag preview charges the same path. |
| Large Form (Goliath) | enforced | The Bonus Action makes the Goliath Large for 10 minutes, with +10 feet of Speed and Advantage on Strength checks, and its token takes the bigger space (transform/forms.ts). resolution/grant.ts refuses it while a creature stands in that space. |
| Luck (Halfling) | enforced | roll-answers.ts offers a reroll when the d20 of the Halfling's attack roll, check, save or death save shows a 1, and the new roll stands. |

| Resourceful (Human) | enforced | rests.ts gives a Human Heroic Inspiration when it finishes a Long Rest. |
| Trance (Elf) | enforced | Magic can't put an elf to sleep: it succeeds without rolling against the Sleep spell and a brass dragon's Sleep Breath (resolution/pending.ts), and a magical sleep it fails into (Eyebite's Asleep) never lands (effects.ts). Its own Long Rest runs out 4 hours of its effects, and the party's Long Rest moves the clock 4 hours when every member holds Trance (rests.ts). Not needing sleep has no rule to read: the clock tracks no sleep. |

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alert | enforced | Initiative rolls add the Proficiency Bonus. Right after Initiative is rolled, before either has acted and neither Incapacitated, the holder's player offers to swap scores with an allied character, and the swap is made when that character's player takes it; the GM swaps any two at once (encounter.ts). |
| Boon of Combat Prowess | enforced | The ability score increase is applied, and roll-answers.ts offers Peerless Aim on a missed attack roll: the attack hits, and the boon waits for the start of the creature's next turn. |
| Boon of Dimensional Travel | enforced | The ability score increase is applied, and once each Attack or Magic action is taken (after its last attack or ray) resolution/movement-grants.ts gives a 30-foot teleport for the turn, which movement-rules.ts takes at once to an unoccupied space the creature can see. |
| Boon of Fate | enforced | The ability score increase is applied. roll-answers.ts offers Improve Fate on the holder's own D20 Test, and asks by a prompt about another creature's within 60 feet: 2d4 is added or taken off, and the use returns when Initiative is rolled or on a rest. |
| Boon of Irresistible Offense | enforced | The ability score increase is applied, Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage ignores Resistance (hit-points.ts), and a rolled 20 on an attack roll adds damage equal to the increased score, of the attack's type (resolution/damage.ts). |
| Boon of Spell Recall | enforced | The ability score increase is applied, and resolution/spell-recall.ts rolls a d4 for a spell cast with a level 1 to 4 slot, keeping the slot when it matches the level. |
| Boon of the Night Spirit | enforced | The ability score increase is applied. With dynamic vision on, Merge with Shadows makes the creature Invisible as a Bonus Action only in Dim Light or Darkness (resolution/validate.ts), until it next takes an action, a Bonus Action or a Reaction (resolution/release.ts), and hit-points.ts gives it Resistance to all damage but Psychic and Radiant there. |
| Boon of Truesight | enforced | The ability score increase is applied, and Truesight 60 feet is a sense dynamic vision and attack rolls read (vision/senses.ts). |
| Grappler | enforced | The ability score increase is applied, attack rolls against a creature it grapples have Advantage (resolution/attack.ts), an Unarmed Strike hit in the Attack action both damages and grapples once a turn (Punch and Grab, resolution/hit-options.ts), and dragging a grappled creature its size or smaller costs no extra movement (Fast Wrestler, movement-rules.ts). |
| Savage Attacker | enforced | resolution/hit-options.ts offers it on a weapon hit once a turn. Chosen, resolution/damage.ts rolls the weapon's damage dice twice and uses the higher roll, the one an attacker always picks of the two. |
| Two-Weapon Fighting | enforced | equipment-derivation.ts adds the ability modifier to the damage of the Light property's extra attack. |
