Notes on the curated rows:

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ammunition of Slaying | enforced | The GM picks the creature type it slays. A hit on a creature of that type makes it take the DC 17 Constitution save for 6d10 Force damage, half on a success, and spends the piece's magic; a hit on another creature keeps it (resolution/ammunition.ts). |
| Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location | enforced | While it is worn and attuned, a Divination spell can't target its wearer, catch it in its area or sense it (resolution/spell-wards.ts), unless the wearer allows it, which it does for a spell cast by its own side. Being seen through a scrying sensor is the GM's, as the sensor is. |
| Amulet of the Planes | guided | Its Plane Shift is cast only after a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check, which the server rolls in an encounter and outside one; a failure spends the action and casts nothing (cast-check.ts). Where a failure sends its wearer and those within 15 feet, on the d100 table, is the GM's. |
| Apparatus of the Crab | guided | Crewed, it is a Large vehicle with its printed AC, 200 Hit Points, speeds and immunities that its pilot works on the turn after its own: its claws swing at +8 for 2d6 Bludgeoning or close to grapple (escape DC 15) (summons.ts). Its crew's place inside and their cover, the levers' order, its shutters, light, depth and air are the GM's. |
| Armor of Invulnerability | enforced | Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage is applied, and Metal Shell's Magic action gives Immunity to them for 10 minutes once a dawn, ending if the armor comes off (inventory.ts). |
| Arrow-Catching Shield | enforced | Its wielder has +2 AC against ranged attack rolls on top of the Shield's (resolution/attack.ts), and a ranged attack at a creature within 5 feet of it offers a Reaction that makes the wielder the target instead (resolution/redirect.ts). |
| Bag of Beans | guided | inventory.ts rolls its 3d4 beans when it is added, which never come back, and the bag is a plain one once they are gone. Dumped beans explode in a 10-foot Sphere, DC 15 Dexterity for 5d4 Force, half on a success. What a planted bean grows, on its d100 table, is the GM's. |
| Bag of Devouring | guided | The 50 percent pull of a creature that reaches in, the creature inside escaping with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check or being pulled out with DC 20, and its devouring at the start of its turn are the GM's until random outcomes and a death at a turn's start are vocabulary; what it eats and what it spits to another plane are story. |
| Bag of Holding | enforced | It holds 500 pounds in the Gear tab and weighs 5 pounds whatever it holds (containers.ts, carrying.ts). Retrieving a thing from it takes the Utilize action in an encounter. A GM write that overloads it, or puts it inside another extradimensional space, destroys it and spills what it held, and a player is refused instead (containers.ts). Where its contents scatter is the GM's. |
| Bag of Tricks | enforced | The GM says which bag a found one is (item-records.ts); its pull rolls the d8 on that bag's table, and the creature appears within 20 feet acting right after its user until the next Long Rest or 0 Hit Points (summons.ts). A Bonus Action commands it (summon-orders.ts). |
| Bead of Force | enforced | Throwing a bead uses it up: each creature in the 10-foot-radius Sphere makes the DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 5d4 Force damage, and one that fails is shut in the sphere for a minute, which no attack or effect passes (enclosures.ts). Pushing out the creatures that saved, and rolling the sphere, are the GM's. |
| Bead of Nourishment | enforced | It is a day's food: while the GM tracks food and water, a character eats one from its pack (actor.nourish), and survival.ts eats the beads it carries as the game day ends, after its Rations. |
| Belt of Dwarvenkind | enforced | Its attuned wearer's Constitution rises by 2, to at most 20, and it has Darkvision 60 feet, Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves against Poisoned, and Advantage on Persuasion checks with a dwarf or a duergar (ability-checks.ts). Knowing Dwarvish and the beard are the table's. |
| Berserker Axe | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls, the curse's lock on Attunement, 1 more Hit Point maximum per level while attuned (live-abilities.ts) and Disadvantage on attacks with other weapons are applied. berserker-axe.ts asks the DC 15 Wisdom save when another creature damages the bearer; while berserk its action must attack (resolution/economy.ts) and only the nearest creature it sees (resolution/action-targets.ts), and the berserk ends on a turn that starts with no creature within 60 feet. Keeping the axe within reach is the story's. |
| Boots of Levitation | enforced | The action levitates the wearer with no save for up to 10 minutes on its Concentration (effects.ts), which damage, another Concentration spell or Incapacitation ends: it rises 20 feet, moves only as if climbing, and floats down when the levitation ends (falling.ts). |
| Boots of Speed | enforced | A Bonus Action doubles its wearer's Speed (speed.ts) and gives Opportunity Attacks against it Disadvantage. Its 10 minutes a Long Rest are 100 rounds: a click lasts all that is left, and ending it early gives the rest back (use-cost.ts, effects.ts). |
| Boots of Striding and Springing | enforced | Its wearer's Speed is at least 30 feet, and neither Heavy armor's Strength requirement nor a load past carrying capacity takes any of it (speed.ts, carrying.ts). The once-a-turn leap of 30 feet for 10 feet of movement is applied (jumping.ts). |
| Boots of the Winterlands | enforced | Its attuned wearer has Resistance to Cold damage, extreme cold asks it no save (environment.ts), and painted ice costs it no extra movement (spell-zones.ts, movement-rules.ts); the ice's slip save still reaches it. |
| Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals | enforced | Once a dawn, a Water Elemental appears near its user, acts right after it, and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts). Filling the bowl is the GM's. |
| Bracers of Archery | enforced | Proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and +2 to damage rolls made with either (a magic one bound to it included), are applied (riders.ts). |
| Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals | enforced | Once a dawn, a Fire Elemental appears near its user, acts right after it, and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts). |
| Brooch of Shielding | enforced | Resistance to Force damage is applied, and damage from the Magic Missile spell does nothing to the wearer: hit-points.ts reads the spell that dealt it (resolution/damage-source.ts). |
| Broom of Flying | enforced | The action gives the rider a Fly Speed of 50 feet with hover, which ends when it lands (falling.ts) or when it gets off on the sheet. Its slower 30 feet while it carries over 200 pounds needs the rider's body weight, which no sheet records, and sending it alone to a place within a mile is story. |
| Candle of Invocation | guided | Lit, it sheds Dim Light 30 feet for its 4 hours (item-light.ts), and while it burns its attuned bearer has Advantage on attack rolls, saves, checks and Initiative. It casts Gate once, which destroys it. Whether an alignment matches the candle's, the others in its light, slot-free level 1 spells for a Cleric or Druid, Gate only at the first lighting, and the minutes a snuffed candle keeps are the GM's. |
| Cape of the Mountebank | enforced | Its Dimension Door, once a dawn, teleports the wearer on the map with a willing creature beside it (granted-moves.ts, teleport-company.ts) and leaves the space it left Lightly Obscured until the end of its next turn (vision areas). |
| Carpet of Flying | enforced | The GM says which of the four sizes a carpet is, and a Magic action makes it hover and fly with its user at that size's Fly Speed until it lands (falling.ts). Its weight limits and half speed, and steering it from 30 feet away, need what the sheet doesn't record. |
| Censer of Controlling Air Elementals | enforced | Once a dawn, an Air Elemental appears near its user, acts right after it, and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts). |
| Chime of Opening | enforced | Each strike casts Knock on its 10 charges, which never come back, and the last one cracks it (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Cloak of Arachnida | enforced | Resistance to Poison damage and a Climb Speed equal to its wearer's Speed are applied. The webs of a Web spell can't hold the wearer (spell-zones.ts), and its Web cast is DC 13 over a 40-foot Cube once a Long Rest. Climbing upside down on ceilings is the GM's to allow. |
| Cloak of Displacement | enforced | Attack rolls against its wearer have Disadvantage, except while its Speed is 0 and from the moment it takes damage until the start of its next turn (`lapses`, equipment-derivation.ts and hit-points.ts). |
| Cloak of Elvenkind | enforced | Its attuned wearer has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and Wisdom (Perception) checks to perceive it, passive scores included, have Disadvantage (ability-checks.ts). |
| Cloak of the Bat | enforced | Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks is applied. In Dim Light or Darkness its wearer grips it for a Fly Speed of 40 feet that ends in Bright Light (light-endings.ts), a flier then falling (falling.ts), and once a dawn casts Polymorph on itself into a Bat that keeps its Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma (item-actions.ts, transform/). Failing to grip the edges is the story's. |
| Crystal Ball | guided | Its holder casts Scrying at DC 17 with no slot (item-actions.ts), which applies as its own row says. The sensor and what it shows are the GM's. |
| Crystal Ball of Mind Reading | guided | It casts Scrying at DC 17, and Detect Thoughts at DC 17 only through that Scrying: it takes no Concentration of its own and ends with the Scrying (resolution/concentration.ts). Which creatures stand within 30 feet of the sensor is the GM's. |
| Crystal Ball of Telepathy | guided | It casts Scrying at DC 17, and Suggestion at DC 17 once a dawn only through that Scrying: it takes no Concentration of its own and ends with the Scrying (resolution/concentration.ts). Speaking telepathically with creatures near the sensor, and which of them it can reach, are the GM's. |
| Crystal Ball of True Seeing | guided | Its holder casts Scrying at DC 17 with no slot (item-actions.ts), which applies as its own row says. The sensor, what it shows and the Truesight around it are the GM's, since the sensor is never on the map. |
| Cube of Force | guided | Mage Armor, Shield (a Reaction when its holder is hit), Tiny Hut, Private Sanctum, Resilient Sphere and Wall of Force are casts at DC 17 on its 10 charges at their printed costs, 1d6 back at dawn (item-actions.ts). It takes the state of Tiny Hut and Private Sanctum. |
| Cubic Gate | guided | On its 3 charges, 1d3 back at dawn, it casts Gate or Plane Shift (item-actions.ts, resolution/charges.ts). The planes its faces open on, the portal and the journey are the GM's. |
| Dagger of Venom | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls is applied. Coating the blade is a Bonus Action once a day, and the dagger's next hit spends it on a DC 15 Constitution save against 2d10 Poison and Poisoned for 1 minute (resolution/on-hit.ts). |
| Dancing Sword | enforced | A Bonus Action tosses it: it hovers in a space within 30 feet and attacks a creature within 5 feet of it with its wielder's attack roll and damage, and each later Bonus Action moves it up to 30 feet, to a spot within 30 feet of its wielder, and attacks again; after its fourth attack it flies back, and it falls if its wielder is more than 30 feet away (summon-strikes.ts, summons.ts). Catching it out of the air and a wielder with no hand free are the table's. |
| Deck of Illusions | guided | A Magic action spends one of its 34 cards and rolls the d100 table, placing an illusion of that creature within 30 feet that can't attack or be touched, which its user moves with a Magic action and which goes when its user is farther than 120 feet (summons.ts). A found deck's missing cards, the drawer's own image on 97-00, the DC 15 Investigation that sees through it and Dispel Magic ending it are the GM's. |
| Defender | enforced | The +3 to attack and damage rolls is applied, and its wielder moves 1, 2 or 3 of it to AC as a form on the sheet before its first attack of a turn, held until its next turn starts and giving AC only while it holds the weapon (inventory.ts setItemForm, turn-boundaries.ts). |
| Demon Armor | enforced | The +1 AC, the clawed Unarmed Strikes (1d8 Slashing, +1 to attack and damage: resolution/builtins.ts), Disadvantage on attacks against demons and on saves against what a demon forces (a stat block's Demon tag), and the curse's lock on doffing and Attunement until Remove Curse (inventory.ts) are applied. Abyssal is the sheet's. |
| Dimensional Shackles | enforced | Its Utilize action places them on an Incapacitated creature of Large size or smaller within reach: it can't teleport or leave the plane by its own means (ethereal.ts, movement-rules.ts). The action again on it removes them, and its DC 30 Strength (Athletics) check breaks them (builtin-actions.ts). That the check comes once in 30 days, a creature its user names removing them, and the broken shackles' loss are the GM's. |
| Dragon Orb | guided | Peering into it is a DC 15 Charisma save its user makes: a success gives control of the orb, and a failure leaves the user Charmed by it while attuned, and a player can't end that attunement (attunement.ts); the GM ending the attunement ends either. Only a user who controls it casts its spells, at their printed charges from 7 (1d4 + 3 back at dawn): Cure Wounds at level 9 for 4, Daylight for 1, Death Ward for 2, Detect Magic for none, Scrying at DC 18 for 3; and Call Dragons waits an hour of game time (clock-pools.ts). The Suggestion it casts on a charmed user and its AC 20 are the GM's. |
| Dragon Scale Mail | enforced | The +1 AC and the Resistance to the type the GM picks are applied, with Advantage on saves against a Dragon's breath weapon (saving-throws.ts). Its Magic action to sense the nearest dragon is counted once a dawn; the distance and direction it tells are the GM's. |
| Dust of Disappearance | enforced | Thrown with an action, it makes its user and each creature in its 10-foot Emanation Invisible for one roll of 2d4 minutes, ending for a creature that makes an attack roll, deals damage or casts a spell, and is used up (resolution/grant.ts). The objects it hides are scenery. |
| Dust of Sneezing and Choking | enforced | Thrown, it opens the DC 15 Constitution save against Incapacitated on its thrower and every creature in its 30-foot Emanation but Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants and Undead, repeated at the end of each turn, and is used up. A creature that fails chokes, gaining a level of Exhaustion at the end of each of its turns until it saves, when those levels go (breath.ts), and Lesser Restoration ends it (resolution/restoration.ts). |
| Dwarven Plate | enforced | The +2 AC is applied. In an encounter, a push or pull moves its wearer up to 10 feet less for its Reaction, which the server takes whenever it is free (forced-movement.ts). |
| Dwarven Thrower | enforced | The +3 to attack and damage rolls is applied, it is thrown 20/60 (inventory.ts weapon changes), and a ranged hit deals 1d8 Force more, 2d8 against a Giant. Only a Dwarf or a creature attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind attunes to it (attunement.ts); it flies back to its thrower's hand. |
| Efficient Quiver | enforced | Its compartments hold 60 pieces of ammunition, 18 javelins or similar, and 6 long objects such as bows or staffs, picked in the Gear tab; it weighs 2 pounds whatever it holds, and ammunition is fired from it (containers.ts, ammunition.ts). |
| Efreeti Bottle | guided | Opened the first time, an Efreeti appears within 30 feet and the server rolls the d10, which settles the bottle (summons.ts): on a 1 it attacks its user and leaves after 5 rounds, on a 10 it stays up to an hour to grant a Wish, and either way the bottle's magic is gone; on 2 to 9 it obeys for 1 hour and the bottle holds a servant from then on, which comes twice more, each opening 24 hours after it returns (clock-pools.ts), and then the bottle is spent. What the Wish does is the GM's. |
| Elemental Gem | enforced | The GM says which gem a found one is (item-records.ts): breaking it uses it up, and its elemental appears beside its user, acts right after it and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts). |
| Energy Bow | enforced | It binds to its Longbow or Shortbow with +1 to attack and damage rolls, and its arrows deal Force damage with no ammunition to spend (inventory.ts weapon changes). Arrow of Restraint is a hit option that deals no damage and asks a DC 15 Strength save against a minute of Restrained, escaped with a DC 20 Athletics check (resolution/hit-options.ts), and Arrow of Transport teleports a willing Medium or smaller creature within 60 feet to a space within 10 feet of its wielder (resolution/movement-grants.ts). The arrows' light and the Energy Ladder are the GM's. |
| Eversmoking Bottle | guided | Opening it fills a 60-foot Emanation with Heavily Obscured smoke for 10 minutes (vision/sight.ts). The cloud growing 10 feet a minute while the bottle stays open, closing it, and a strong wind dispersing it after a minute are the GM's. |
| Feather Token | guided | The GM says which token a found one is (item-records.ts). The Bird token is used up for a Roc that can't attack and obeys its user until it is dismissed with a Magic action or drops to 0 Hit Points (summons.ts). The Whip token is used up for a floating whip within 10 feet that lasts an hour, until dismissed or its user dies: its user's Bonus Action moves it up to 20 feet and strikes a creature within 10 feet of it at +9 for 1d6 + 5 Force, until its user is Incapacitated (summon-strikes.ts, granted-actions.ts). The Anchor, Fan, Swan Boat and Tree, which act on ships and the scenery, are the GM's. |
| Figurine of Wondrous Power | guided | The GM says which figurine a found one is (item-records.ts): its creature appears within 60 feet for its time, acts right after its user and defends itself when uncommanded, and a Magic action turns it back (summons.ts). Its days of waiting start when it reverts (clock-pools.ts), each Golden Lion and each Ivory Goat on its own; the Goat of Traveling spends an hour or part of one each time from its 24 and waits only once they are spent. The Goat of Terror can't attack, the Onyx Dog has Blindsight 60 feet, the Silver Raven offers Animal Messenger, and the Obsidian Steed's d10 shows 1 one time in ten, leaving it under no one's command. While the Goat of Terror is ridden, each Hostile creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of it makes the DC 15 Wisdom save against Frightened, a success leaving it immune for 24 hours (trait-turns.ts, mounts.ts). The goat's horns, the steed refusing to revert and its ride to Hades are the GM's. |
| Folding Boat | reference | The boat or ship its command words make is the GM's to run: the app has no vehicles. |
| Frost Brand | enforced | The extra 1d6 Cold on a hit and Resistance to Fire while held are applied, and drawing it can put out the nonmagical flames within 30 feet, the GM's lights on the map and the burning lights creatures carry, once an hour of game time (resolution/cast-lights.ts). Its light in freezing cold depends on weather the app doesn't track. |
| Gem of Brightness | enforced | Its light is lit and put out on the row, and its beam (1 charge) and flare (5 charges) open the DC 15 Constitution save against Blinded on its 50 charges, which never come back; with none left it is a plain jewel that no longer lights (item-spent.ts). |
| Giant Slayer | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls and the extra 2d6 against Giants are applied, and a hit on a Giant opens its DC 15 Strength save against Prone (resolution/on-hit.ts). |
| Gloves of Missile Snaring | enforced | A hit by a weapon from range opens a reaction prompt (damage-window.ts), and using it takes 1d10 plus the wearer's Dexterity modifier off the damage. Whether a hand is free, and catching the missile, are the GM's. |
| Hammer of Thunderbolts | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls is applied, and its 5 charges (1d4 + 1 back at dawn) each hurl it 20/60 for a thunderclap whose DC 17 Constitution save Stuns the target and every other creature within 30 feet of it but the wielder (resolution/on-hit.ts). With a Belt of Giant Strength or Gauntlets of Ogre Power attuned too, the Strength they bestow rises by 4, to 30 (live-abilities.ts), and a rolled 20 against a Giant asks a DC 17 Constitution save or it dies (resolution/kill.ts). |
| Handy Haversack | enforced | Its central pouch holds 500 pounds and each side pouch 200, picked in the Gear tab; it weighs 5 pounds whatever it holds (containers.ts, carrying.ts). Retrieving a thing from it takes a Bonus Action, or the Utilize action. Overloading it, or putting it in another extradimensional space, destroys it as a Bag of Holding. |
| Hat of Disguise | guided | Its Disguise Self cast leaves the disguise on its wearer, which ends when the hat is taken off (inventory.ts). How the disguise looks and who sees through it are the GM's. |
| Hat of Many Spells | guided | Only a Wizard attunes to it (attunement.ts), and it is an Arcane Focus for its Wizard spells. Unknown Spell's pick of a spell, its slot and its Arcana check are the GM's; on a failed check its user rolls the d100 table (item-outcomes.ts), whose spells at its user's own numbers, Stunned, Poisoned and Petrified, the creature that appears and the Hostile bats are applied. The butterflies, the objects pulled out, the portal and the magic item are the GM's. |
| Helm of Brilliance | guided | inventory.ts counts each kind of gem when the helm is added (1d10 diamonds, 2d10 rubies, 3d10 fire opals, 4d10 opals), which never come back, and each of its spells at DC 18 spends one gem of its kind: Daylight an opal, Fireball a fire opal, Prismatic Spray a diamond, Wall of Fire a ruby. Diamond Light against Undead, Fire Opal Flames, Ruby Resistance while a ruby is left, the helm losing its magic once every gem is gone, and the d20 when Fire from a spell lands are the GM's. |
| Helm of Comprehending Languages | guided | Its wearer casts Comprehend Languages at will (item-actions.ts), and what the wearer understands is the table's. |
| Helm of Telepathy | guided | Its Detect Thoughts and Suggestion casts are cast actions. The telepathy itself is the GM's. |
| Helm of Teleportation | guided | On its 3 charges, 1d3 back at dawn, its wearer casts Teleport (item-actions.ts), which applies as its own row says. The travellers leaving the encounter are the GM's to move. |
| Holy Avenger | enforced | The +3 to attack and damage rolls and the extra 2d10 Radiant against Fiends and Undead are applied, and its 10-foot Emanation (30 feet for a level 17 Paladin) gives its wielder and its allies Advantage on saves against magic (saving-throws.ts magicSaveAuraClaims). Only a Paladin attunes to it (attunement.ts). |
| Horn of Blasting | enforced | Its blast fills a 30-foot Cone with a DC 15 Constitution save: 5d8 Thunder and Deafened for 1 minute on a failure, half on a success. Each use rolls the d100 for its 20 percent chance to explode, dealing 10d6 Force to its user and destroying it (resolution/charges.ts, item-breaks.ts). The glass and crystal objects it shatters are story. |
| Horn of Valhalla | enforced | Each metal is its own action: 2 to 5 Berserkers appear within 60 feet for 1 hour, immune to Charmed and Frightened (summons.ts). They obey a user whose sheet has the metal's training and attack one whose sheet lacks it. clock-pools.ts keeps it from being blown again until 7 days have passed on the game clock. |
| Horseshoes of a Zephyr | enforced | The creature wearing all four ignores Difficult Terrain (movement-rules.ts) and crosses the water painted on the map as solid ground (speed.ts, terrain.ts). Lava isn't on the map, and leaving no tracks and travelling 12 hours a day are overland travel the GM runs. |
| Immovable Rod | guided | Its Utilize action fixes the rod against a closed door on the map within reach, which it holds shut: the rod leaves its bearer's hands, a DC 30 Strength (Athletics) check forcing the door moves it back to whoever fixed it, and a creature beside the door can push its button with a Utilize action and take it (resolution/door-work.ts, doors.ts). The rod fixed anywhere else, as a ladder rung, a bar or a weight holding 8,000 pounds, is open-ended use the GM rules on. |
| Instant Fortress | guided | Its Magic action raises the tower on the 20-foot square it places (resolution/tower.ts): four walls that are objects with AC 20, 100 Hit Points, Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage and Resistance to the rest, and a door on the side facing its user that opens only for that user and that Knock leaves shut (doors.ts). The creatures in the square are pushed to the nearest free space next to it, and the command again shrinks it only while no creature stands inside. The Bonus Action the door's command costs, the damage the tower keeps once shrunk, siege equipment, its floors and battlement, and repair by Wish are the GM's. |
| Ioun Stone | enforced | The GM says which stone a found one is (item-records.ts), the bearer learns it on attuning, and two stones of different kinds attune as two items. Agility, Fortitude, Insight, Intellect, Leadership and Strength raise their score live (live-abilities.ts); Awareness and Protection are applied; Mastery adds 1 to the Proficiency Bonus every derived number reads; Regeneration heals 15 Hit Points at the end of each hour with at least 1 (clock-healing.ts); Sustenance spares its bearer food and water (survival.ts). Absorption's and Greater Absorption's Reaction cancels a spell of level 4 or 8 or lower it sees cast, until 20 or 50 levels are cancelled (resolution/counter.ts), and Reserve stores up to 4 levels of spells cast into it, cast by its bearer at the caster's numbers (stored-casts.ts); the GM sets what a found one holds on its row. |
| Iron Bands | enforced | The throw's attack roll is applied, and a hit Restrains the target until its user's Bonus Action command releases it (resolution/endings.ts releaseItemEffects). A DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, its action, breaks the bands and destroys them, and a failure keeps that creature from trying again for 24 hours (resolution/endings.ts). |
| Iron Flask | guided | Its Magic action's DC 17 Wisdom save against a Celestial, Elemental, Fey or Fiend it sees within 60 feet traps a failing one off the map in the flask, one at a time (resolution/held-creatures.ts, off-plane.ts); the release action brings it back beside its user, obeying the user for 1 hour (summons.ts). A creature trapped before saving with Advantage, a found flask holding a creature and what a released one does after the hour are the GM's. |
| Javelin of Lightning | enforced | It may deal Lightning damage on a hit, and once a dawn it becomes a bolt: a 5-foot Line from its thrower that ends at a target within 120 feet (annotations.ts), DC 13 Dexterity save for 4d6 Lightning, half on a success. |
| Luck Blade | guided | The +1 to attack and damage rolls and saving throws is applied, and roll-answers.ts offers its Luck reroll on a failed D20 Test once a day while the wielder isn't Incapacitated. Its Wish casts on 1d3 charges rolled when it is added, which never come back, and once a dawn (resolution/economy.ts). What a Wish does is the GM's. |
| Mace of Disruption | enforced | The extra 2d6 Radiant against Fiends and Undead and the weapon's light are applied. A Fiend or an Undead the hit leaves at 25 Hit Points or fewer makes the DC 15 Wisdom save (resolution/kill.ts): a failure destroys it, and a success leaves it Frightened until the end of the wielder's next turn. |
| Mace of Smiting | enforced | The +1 to attack and damage rolls, +3 against Constructs, and the 7 Bludgeoning on a rolled 20 (14 against a Construct) are applied. A Construct that rolled 20 leaves at 25 Hit Points or fewer is destroyed (resolution/kill.ts). |
| Mace of Terror | enforced | Its 3 charges come back 1d3 at dawn, and each opens the DC 15 Wisdom save against Frightened for a minute on the creatures its wielder picks within 30 feet, repeated at the end of each turn. A Frightened creature must spend its movement getting as far from the wielder as it can (compelled-moves.ts, movement-rules.ts), makes no Opportunity Attacks, and for its action can only Dash, try to escape what holds it, or Dodge when it has nowhere to move (resolution/economy.ts). |
| Manual of Bodily Health | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Constitution rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Manual of Gainful Exercise | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Strength rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Manual of Golems | guided | The GM says which golem a found manual teaches (item-records.ts). A reader that isn't a spellcaster with two level 5 spell slots takes 6d6 Psychic damage (resolution/validate.ts), and when the GM marks the work done the manual burns and its golem joins the map under its maker's command (summons.ts). The days of work and the gold are the GM's downtime. |
| Manual of Quickness of Action | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Dexterity rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Marvelous Pigments | reference | What its paints make is the GM's: an open-ended creation. |
| Medallion of Thoughts | guided | On its 5 charges, 1d4 back at dawn, its wearer casts Detect Thoughts at DC 13 (item-actions.ts), which applies as its own row says. The thoughts read are the GM's. |
| Mirror of Life Trapping | guided | The hung mirror as an object, the DC 15 Charisma save of a creature that sees its reflection within 30 feet, the twelve cells off the map, freeing a named creature and its shattering are the GM's: a sight-gated area save from an object on a wall has no vocabulary yet. Talking with a trapped creature is story. |
| Mysterious Deck | guided | The GM says whether a found deck holds 13 or 22 cards (item-records.ts), and each draw rolls that column of the d100 table (item-outcomes.ts): Euryale's -2 to saves, the Fool's and the Jester's 72 hours of Disadvantage or Advantage on D20 Tests, and the Knight who serves are applied, and every other card is told to the table for the GM, as are the declared count of draws and the Fool and Jester leaving the deck. |
| Necklace of Fireballs | enforced | inventory.ts rolls its 1d6 + 3 beads when it is added, and each bead casts a level 3 Fireball at DC 15 and never comes back; up to five hurled at once add 1d6 each, to 12d6 (item-actions.ts). |
| Necklace of Prayer Beads | guided | Attunement by a Cleric, Druid or Paladin is held (attunement.ts). The beads are the GM's: a copy holds no count of each kind of bead, so their spells and once-a-dawn uses aren't offered. |
| Nine Lives Stealer | enforced | The +2 to attack and damage rolls is applied. On a rolled 20 against a creature with fewer than 100 Hit Points, other than a Construct or an Undead, the target makes the DC 15 Constitution save, and a failure slays it (resolution/kill.ts). Each slaying spends one of the 1d8 + 1 charges rolled when the sword is added, which never come back, and with none left it slays no more. |
| Oathbow | enforced | Naming a sworn enemy marks it for 7 days, once a dawn and one at a time (resolution/grant.ts), and the bow's ranged attacks against it have Advantage, set Half and Three-Quarters Cover and long range's Disadvantage aside and deal 3d6 Piercing more; while it lives its wielder has Disadvantage on attacks with every other weapon (resolution/attack.ts). |
| Oil of Etherealness | guided | Applying it covers one Medium or smaller creature within reach and is used up: the creature steps onto the Border Ethereal for 1 hour, as the Etherealness spell (ethereal.ts, off-plane.ts). The 10 minutes the application takes are the GM's to pass on the game clock. |
| Oil of Sharpness | enforced | Applying it outside an encounter makes one carried Slashing or Piercing weapon, or up to 20 pieces of ammunition, a +3 Weapon or +3 Ammunition (resolution/rebind.ts), and the vial is spent. |
| Oil of Slipperiness | enforced | Applied, it is used up and its creature has Freedom of Movement's effect for 8 hours: a Swim Speed equal to its Speed that magic can't reduce, no Paralyzed or Restrained from magic, and a slip out of a nonmagical grapple or restraint for 5 feet of movement. Poured, it is used up and casts Grease on its 10-foot square, which lasts 8 hours (item-actions.ts `castLastsMinutes`, resolution/concentration.ts). |
| Pearl of Power | enforced | Its Magic action restores one expended slot of level 3 or lower, once per Long Rest (conversions.ts). |
| Periapt of Wound Closure | enforced | death-saves.ts counts an attuned wearer's death save of 9 or lower as a 10, and rests.ts and resolution/hit-point-die.ts double what each Hit Point Die it rolls to heal restores. |
| Philter of Love | enforced | Drunk, it waits 10 minutes for the first creature its drinker sees, which then Charms it for 1 hour as the charmer (first-sight.ts, with dynamic vision on; with it off the GM names the creature). Whether that creature is its true love is the story's. |
| Pipes of Haunting | enforced | Its 3 charges come back 1d3 at dawn; each opens the DC 15 Wisdom save against Frightened for a minute on the creatures its user picks within 30 feet, repeated at the end of each turn, and a creature that succeeds is immune to the pipes for 24 hours of the game clock (resolution/pending.ts, save-immunity.ts). |
| Pipes of the Sewers | guided | Its Bonus Actions spend 1 to 3 charges to call that many Swarms of Rats under no one's control, when the GM says rats are near (summons.ts). Playing it as a Magic action asks each Swarm of Rats within 30 feet a DC 15 Wisdom save: one that fails obeys the piper until the piper's next turn while it starts its turns within 30 feet, and one that succeeds can't be swayed for 24 hours (summons.ts). Playing again asks a swayed swarm again, where the text keeps it swayed, and rats being Indifferent to the bearer are the GM's. |
| Plate Armor of Etherealness | enforced | Its Magic action, once a dawn (a Long Rest), puts the wearer on the Border Ethereal as the Etherealness spell for up to 8 hours (ethereal.ts); repeating the command word ends it with no new use, and taking the armor off ends it (inventory.ts). |
| Portable Hole | guided | As a container it weighs nothing whatever it holds, and putting it in another extradimensional space destroys both (containers.ts). Folding it shut holds the creatures in the open hole off the map until each forces its way out with an action and a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check, coming back beside it (off-plane.ts). The open hole on the map and its air are the GM's. |
| Potion of Clairvoyance | reference | Drinking it gives the effect of Clairvoyance, whose sensor and what it shows are the GM's. |
| Potion of Diminution | enforced | Drinking it makes the drinker one size smaller for 1d4 hours, rolled by the server, with Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves and 1d4 less damage with weapons and Unarmed Strikes, never below 1 (resolution/damage.ts). |
| Potion of Gaseous Form | enforced | Drinking it gives Gaseous Form's misty cloud for 1 hour with no Concentration, ended early as a Bonus Action or at 0 Hit Points. |
| Potion of Growth | enforced | Drinking it makes the drinker one size larger for 10 minutes, with Advantage on Strength checks and saves and 1d4 more damage with weapons and Unarmed Strikes. The token takes the new size (transform/forms.ts). |
| Potion of Longevity | reference | Its 1d6 + 6 years off the drinker's age, and the cumulative 10 percent chance of ageing instead, are the table's: the app tracks no age. |
| Potion of Mind Reading | guided | Drunk, it is used up and its drinker bears Detect Thoughts for 10 minutes with no Concentration. The thoughts it reads, and the DC 13 save a creature makes against a deeper probe, are the GM's. |
| Potion of Poison | enforced | Drunk or given as a Potion of Healing is, it deals its 4d6 Poison damage whatever the drinker's DC 13 Constitution save, and a failure leaves an hour of Poisoned (saving-throws.ts). Its holder sees it as a Potion of Healing, by row id, name, text and actions, until Identify reveals it (disguised-items.ts, projections.ts). |
| Potion of Vitality | enforced | Drinking it ends the drinker's Exhaustion and the Poisoned condition, and for 24 hours each Hit Point Die it spends restores its maximum (rests.ts, resolution/hit-point-die.ts). |
| Potion of Water Breathing | enforced | Drinking it lets the drinker breathe underwater for 24 hours of game time (breath.ts). |
| Quarterstaff of the Acrobat | enforced | The +2 to attack and damage rolls and Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks are applied, it is thrown 30/120, and Attack Deflection is offered once a rest when a hit would land (resolution/pending.ts). A Bonus Action makes it a rod or a pole (inventory.ts setItemForm), where it neither swings nor deflects. |
| Ring of Animal Influence | guided | On its 3 charges, 1d3 back at dawn, its wearer casts Animal Friendship and Fear (Beasts only) at DC 13, which apply as their own rows say, and Speak with Animals, whose talk is the table's (item-actions.ts). |
| Ring of Djinni Summoning | enforced | The djinni appears within 120 feet while its wearer keeps Concentration, up to 1 hour, defending itself when uncommanded (summons.ts); clock-pools.ts holds the ring for 24 hours from when it departs, and the ring loses its magic if the djinni dies (item-spent.ts). |
| Ring of Elemental Command | enforced | Elemental Bane's Advantage on attacks against Elementals and their Disadvantage against its wearer are applied, and an Elemental that fails Elemental Compulsion's DC 18 save is Charmed and commanded by the wearer until the wearer's next turn (summons.ts). The GM says which plane a found ring is (item-records.ts): its Resistance, Immunity or speed, and its spells at DC 18 on 5 charges with their printed costs. The Water ring's wearer breathes water (breath.ts), and the Earth ring's moves through the map's walls as Difficult Terrain and is shunted out of one it ends its turn in (wall-passage.ts). The languages are the GM's. |
| Ring of Free Action | enforced | Difficult Terrain costs its wearer no extra movement (movement-rules.ts), and spells and other magical effects can't reduce its Speeds (speed.ts) or give it the Paralyzed or Restrained condition (effects.ts); a net or a grapple still holds it. |
| Ring of Mind Shielding | enforced | While it is worn and attuned, Detect Thoughts can't target its wearer, Zone of Truth doesn't hold it, and no magical sense that tells a creature's type finds it, Detect Evil and Good and Divine Sense included (resolution/spell-wards.ts, vision/detect.ts). Telepathy, the imperceptible ring and the soul it can hold are the GM's. |
| Ring of Regeneration | enforced | Its wearer regains 1d6 Hit Points for every 10 minutes of game time while it has at least 1 (clock-healing.ts), and in an encounter every 100 rounds. Regrowing a lost body part is the story's: the sheet has no body parts. |
| Ring of Shooting Stars | guided | Its at-will cantrips, and on its 6 charges Faerie Fire, Shooting Stars of 1 to 3 Cubes at a charge each (use-cost.ts, multi-templates.ts) and the Lightning Spheres, are applied: up to four areas on the wearer's Concentration for a minute, each discharging once at the first creature within 5 feet of it for the damage its number gives (spell-zone-state.ts, spell-zones.ts). The spheres' Dim Light, and their Bonus Action move within 120 feet, are the GM's, who drags each sphere's area. |
| Ring of Spell Storing | enforced | Held out (no action), the ring takes the next spell of level 1 through 5 cast at its wearer or by it within a minute, at its caster's slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus and modifier, if the levels it holds stay at 5 or fewer; a spell that doesn't fit is lost. The attuned wearer casts each held spell from its sheet at those numbers, freeing its space (stored-casts.ts). The GM sets what a found ring holds on its row; a player sees the held spells once attuned (projections.ts). |
| Ring of Spell Turning | enforced | Its wearer has Advantage on saves against spells, and a successful save against a spell of level 7 or lower leaves the spell no effect on it: no half damage, nothing a success would leave (saving-throws.ts). When that spell targeted only the wearer with no area, the wearer's Reaction turns it back: the caster makes the same save against its own spell save DC (roll-answers.ts, spell-reflection.ts). |
| Ring of the Ram | enforced | Each of its three actions spends 1 to 3 of its 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn) on a ranged spell attack at its printed +7 against a creature within 60 feet, dealing 2d10 Force and pushing it 5 feet for each charge. Aimed at a door on the map it sees within 60 feet, the same charges make a Strength check at +5 a charge against the highest DC of what holds the door shut (10 more under an Arcane Lock), and a success breaks it open; Sovereign Glue and Stone Shape's seal don't give (resolution/door-work.ts, doors.ts). The DC to break any other object, which the SRD doesn't print, is the GM's. |
| Ring of Three Wishes | guided | Its three Wish casts are counted and never come back, and the ring is nonmagical after the last (resolution/charges.ts, item-spent.ts). What a Wish does is the GM's. |
| Ring of Warmth | enforced | Cold damage its wearer takes is 2d8 less (hit-points.ts), and extreme cold asks the wearer no save (environment.ts). |
| Ring of X-ray Vision | guided | Its Magic action gives X-ray vision for the minute: walls don't block the wearer's sight within 30 feet (vision/senses.ts). The Constitution save against Exhaustion on a second use before a Long Rest is the GM's, and so is lead blocking the sight, since walls have no material. |
| Robe of Eyes | guided | Darkvision and Truesight out to 120 feet are read by dynamic vision, and Wisdom (Perception) checks the roller says rely on sight have Advantage (ability-checks.ts). The Blinded drawback from a Light spell cast on the robe or Daylight within 5 feet is the GM's. |
| Robe of Scintillating Colors | enforced | Its 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn) each make the robe shed Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light 30 more until the end of the wearer's next turn, give Disadvantage to attackers that see it, and Stun until then a creature within 30 feet that sees it and fails the DC 15 Wisdom save (resolution/pending.ts, vision/rules.ts). |
| Robe of Stars | enforced | The +1 to saving throws is applied, its six stars each cast a level 5 Magic Missile with 1d6 coming back at dusk or a Long Rest, and its Magic action takes the wearer off the map to the Astral Plane until the action again brings it back to its last space or the nearest unoccupied one (off-plane.ts). What it finds on the Astral Plane is story. |
| Robe of Useful Items | reference | Its patches are the GM's: a copy holds no patches, so pulling one off makes nothing on the sheet. |
| Rod of Absorption | enforced | Held and attuned, its Reaction absorbs a spell aimed at its holder alone with no area: the spell has no effect, what it was cast with is spent, and its levels are stored, up to 50 absorbed in the rod's existence (resolution/counter.ts, counter-answers.ts). A found rod holds 1d10 levels (item-charges.ts), and a spellcaster holding it turns stored levels into a spent spell slot of level 5 or lower, no higher than its own (conversions.ts). That a spent rod is mundane is the GM's to say. |
| Rod of Alertness | enforced | Advantage on Initiative and Wisdom (Perception) checks, and its detection casts, are applied. The Protective Aura once a dawn plants the rod's light where its user stands for 10 minutes, and while in its 60 feet of Bright Light the user and its allies have +1 to AC and saves and See Invisibility there (zone-auras.ts). Pulling the rod out is the GM's, who ends its area. |
| Rod of Lordly Might | enforced | It swings as a +3 Mace; Drain Life (healing its wielder half the Necrotic damage a failed save deals) and Paralyze ride a melee hit and Terrify is an action, each once a day. Its buttons are forms its holder picks for a Bonus Action (inventory.ts setItemForm): a flaming Longsword or Shortsword with 2d6 Fire and its light, a +3 Battleaxe or Spear, a pole or a battering ram (+10 to break through). The pole's length and anchoring, magnetic north and the depth or height it tells are story. |
| Rod of Resurrection | enforced | Its casts spend their printed charges, and it regains 1 charge at dawn or at a Long Rest (item-charges.ts). |
| Rod of Security | enforced | Its Magic action takes its user and up to 199 willing creatures it sees off the map to its demiplane for 200 days divided by the visitors, and the action again, or the time running out, brings every visitor back to the space it left or the nearest unoccupied one; it then waits 240 hours of game time (off-plane.ts, clock-pools.ts). Each hour there a visitor regains Hit Points as if it spent a Hit Point Die (clock-healing.ts) and needs no food or water (survival.ts). The demiplane's form and that its visitors don't age are story. |
| Rope of Entanglement | enforced | The save against Restrained is applied, with the DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to escape (ending-actions.ts), and its user's Bonus Action command releases the target (resolution/endings.ts). The rope that holds it is an object with AC 20 and 20 Hit Points, immune to Poison and Psychic damage, that an attack can break, which frees it, and it regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes (objects.ts, effects.ts). |
| Scarab of Protection | enforced | The +1 AC and Advantage on saves against spells are applied, and Preservation turns a failed save against a Necromancy spell or an Undead into a success for a Reaction and one of its 12 charges, which never come back; the last crumbles it (roll-answers.ts, resolution/charges.ts). |
| Scimitar of Speed | enforced | The +2 to attack and damage rolls is applied, and it offers an attack as a Bonus Action beside its own (equipment-derivation.ts). |
| Sending Stones | guided | Each stone casts Sending once a dawn (item-actions.ts). The message, the reply and the pairing with the other stone are the table's. |
| Shield of Missile Attraction | enforced | Its holder resists the damage of attacks made with Ranged weapons, read as the damage lands with how the attack was made (hit-points.ts, resolution/damage-source.ts). Its curse locks its Attunement until Remove Curse, and while attuned, held or not, draws onto its bearer every Ranged weapon attack at another creature within 10 feet of it (resolution/missile-attraction.ts). |
| Shield of the Cavalier | guided | The +2 AC on top of the Shield's own is applied (equipment-derivation.ts). Forceful Bash, a shield attack with a push and a knock Prone in place of one of the Attack action's attacks, and Protective Field, a Reaction that spares the wearer or an ally damage from an attack or a failed save, are the GM's. |
| Sovereign Glue | guided | Its 1d6 + 1 ounces are rolled when it is added and counted. A Utilize action spends an ounce to glue a closed door on the map within reach shut; a minute later the glue has set, and then no check, tool, Knock or Ring of the Ram opens it until Universal Solvent dissolves it (resolution/door-work.ts, doors.ts). Bonding any other two objects, and Oil of Etherealness or Wish breaking the bond, are the GM's. |
| Spellguard Shield | enforced | Spell attack rolls against its holder have Disadvantage (resolution/attack.ts), and its holder has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects (riders.ts). |
| Sphere of Annihilation | enforced | Set the Sphere puts it on the map, where a creature whose space it enters, or that enters its space, makes the DC 19 Dexterity save or takes 8d10 Force damage, obliterated at 0 Hit Points (spell-zones.ts, hit-points.ts). Control the Sphere rolls the DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check from within 60 feet, holding it until the start of the creature's next turn or drawing it 10 feet closer, and Move the Sphere moves it toward a creature 5 feet a point of Intelligence (zone-sphere.ts). Its meetings with portals are the GM's. |
| Staff of Charming | enforced | Its one-charge casts are cast actions; roll-answers.ts offers to turn a failed save against an Enchantment spell aimed only at the holder into a success once a day, and a successful one into the spell turned back on its caster for a Reaction and a charge: the caster makes the same save against the holder's spell save DC (spell-reflection.ts). |
| Staff of Fire | enforced | Resistance to Fire damage is applied, and Burning Hands, Fireball and Wall of Fire spend their printed charges (item-actions.ts); a 1 on the last charge's d20 destroys it (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Staff of Frost | enforced | Resistance to Cold damage is applied, and Fog Cloud, Cone of Cold, Ice Storm and Wall of Ice spend their printed charges (item-actions.ts); a 1 on the last charge's d20 destroys it (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Staff of Power | guided | It swings as a +2 Quarterstaff, the +2 to AC, saving throws and spell attack rolls is applied, and its spells spend their printed charges; the last charge's d20 gives 1d8 + 2 back on a 20 and leaves only a +2 Quarterstaff on a 1 (resolution/charges.ts). Retributive Strike is the GM's. |
| Staff of Striking | enforced | It swings as a +3 Quarterstaff, a melee hit can spend 1, 2 or 3 of its 10 charges for 1d6 Force each (resolution/hit-options.ts), and a 1 on the last charge's d20 leaves a plain Quarterstaff (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Staff of Swarming Insects | enforced | Insect Cloud fills a 30-foot Emanation that is Heavily Obscured for everyone but its holder for 10 minutes (vision/cast-sight.ts). Giant Insect costs 4 charges and brings the insect (summons.ts), and Insect Plague costs 5. A strong wind dispersing the cloud is the GM's. |
| Staff of the Magi | guided | It swings as a +2 Quarterstaff, the +2 to spell attack rolls and Advantage on saves against spells are applied, and its spells spend their printed charges from 50; a 20 on the last charge's d20 gives 1d12 + 1 back (resolution/charges.ts). Spell Absorption's Reaction cancels a spell aimed at its holder alone with no area and adds the spell's level to its charges (resolution/counter.ts, counter-answers.ts), and the table is told when that takes it past 50. Retributive Strike, and that explosion, are the GM's. |
| Staff of the Python | enforced | Thrown within 10 feet, it becomes a Giant Constrictor Snake that acts right after its user, commanded within 60 feet and defending itself otherwise; a Bonus Action turns it back (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts), and the staff then waits an hour (clock-pools.ts). The snake dying shatters the staff (item-spent.ts). |
| Staff of the Woodlands | enforced | It swings as a +2 Quarterstaff, the +2 to spell attack rolls is applied, its spells spend their printed charges and Tree Form's use is counted. A 1 on the last charge's d20 leaves a plain Quarterstaff (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Staff of Thunder and Lightning | enforced | It swings as a +2 Quarterstaff. Lightning and Thunder ride a melee hit, Thunder and Lightning does both as a Bonus Action (resolution/hit-options.ts), and Lightning Strike's 120-foot Line and Thunderclap's 60-foot Emanation are actions (area-targeting.ts), each once a day. |
| Staff of Withering | enforced | It swings as a Quarterstaff, and a hit can spend a charge for 2d10 Necrotic and a DC 15 Constitution save against an hour of Disadvantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saves (resolution/hit-options.ts), counted on the game clock after an encounter (game-time.ts). |
| Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals | enforced | Once a dawn, an Earth Elemental appears within 30 feet, acts right after its user, and leaves after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points or when a Bonus Action dismisses it (summons.ts, summon-orders.ts). |
| Sun Blade | enforced | It swings as a +2 Finesse Longsword that deals Radiant damage, with 1d8 Radiant more against an Undead, and its blade sheds sunlight whose Bright and Dim radii a Magic action sets 5 feet wider or narrower between 10 and 30 feet (resolution/cast-lights.ts, vision/senses.ts). A Bonus Action puts the blade away to the hilt or brings it back (inventory.ts setItemForm). |
| Sword of Life Stealing | enforced | On a rolled 20 against a creature that is neither a Construct nor an Undead it deals 15 Necrotic damage more, and its wielder gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage the target takes (resolution/damage.ts). |
| Sword of Sharpness | enforced | A rolled 20 against a creature adds 14 Slashing damage and a level of Exhaustion (resolution/damage.ts, resolution/on-hit.ts), and its damage dice against an object are maximized (object-strikes.ts). |
| Sword of Wounding | enforced | The extra Necrotic damage is applied, and a hit opens a DC 15 Constitution save whose failure stops the target regaining Hit Points for 1 hour or until it succeeds on the save it repeats at the end of each of its turns (resolution/on-hit.ts); the hour runs on the game clock after an encounter (game-time.ts). |
| Talisman of Pure Good | guided | It is a Holy Symbol for its bearer's spells (resolution/components.ts) with +2 to spell attack rolls, and Pure Rebuke spends one of its 7 charges, which never come back; the last destroys it (item-spent.ts). The rebuke's DC 20 Dexterity save, with Disadvantage for a Fiend or an Undead, a failure destroying the target and a success dealing 4d6 Psychic, and the 8d6 Radiant it deals a Fiend or an Undead that touches it, are the GM's. |
| Talisman of the Sphere | enforced | Attuned, it gives Control the Sphere's Intelligence (Arcana) check Advantage, and its holder that starts its turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation can take a Magic action to move it 10 feet plus 10 a point of Intelligence (zone-sphere.ts). |
| Talisman of Ultimate Evil | guided | It is a Holy Symbol for its bearer's spells (resolution/components.ts) with +2 to spell attack rolls, and Ultimate End spends one of its 6 charges, which never come back; the last destroys it (item-spent.ts). The DC 20 Dexterity save, with Disadvantage for a Celestial, a failure destroying the target and a success dealing 4d6 Psychic, and the 8d6 Necrotic it deals any other creature that touches it, are the GM's. |
| Thunderous Greatclub | enforced | Its wearer's Strength is at least 20 (live-abilities.ts), a hit deals 1d8 Thunder more and 3d8 more to an object (object-strikes.ts), and Clap of Thunder's 30-foot Cone asks the DC 15 Strength save against Prone and deals 3d8 Thunder to the doors and walls that are objects in it. Earthquake, once a day, asks each creature on the ground in its 50-foot circle for the DC 20 Dexterity save against Prone and a concentrating one for the DC 20 Constitution save against its Concentration (resolution/pending.ts), and deals 50 Bludgeoning to the objects there. The fissure is the GM's. |
| Tome of Clear Thought | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Intelligence rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Tome of Leadership and Influence | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Charisma rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Tome of Understanding | enforced | item-study.ts records the study in the reader's build, so Wisdom rises by 2 (to at most 30) and stays through every rebuild, and the copy's magic is spent. The 48 hours of study are downtime the GM gives, and the GM moves the clock. |
| Trident of Fish Command | guided | A charge casts Dominate Beast at DC 15 on a creature with a Swim Speed (resolution/action-targets.ts), which affects only a Beast (resolution/type-gates.ts); it has 3 charges and regains 1d3 at dawn, and the cast takes the spell's state. What the Beast does under it is the GM's. |
| Universal Solvent | guided | Its 1d6 + 1 ounces are rolled when it is added and counted. A Utilize action spends an ounce on a door on the map within reach and dissolves the Sovereign Glue that holds it (resolution/door-work.ts, doors.ts). Dissolving any other adhesive is the GM's. |
| Vorpal Sword | enforced | The +3 to attack and damage rolls is applied. On a rolled 20 it cuts off the target's head (resolution/kill.ts): the creature dies, and only a revival that restores lost parts brings it back. A creature with no head, Immunity to Slashing damage, a neck too big (larger than Large) or Legendary Resistance to spend takes 30 Slashing damage more instead, and a hydra loses one head. Its Slashing damage ignores Resistance, that sword's alone (hit-points.ts reads the row that dealt it). A creature that lives without its head is the GM's. |
| Wand of Enemy Detection | enforced | Its 7 charges (1d6 + 1 back at dawn, a 1 on the last one's d20 destroying it) each show its holder's player, for a minute, the direction of the nearest Hostile creature within 60 feet, hidden or not, but not its distance (vision/detect.ts); it ends when the wand is put away. |
| Wand of Fear | enforced | Command (Flee or Grovel only, 1 charge) and Fear in a 60-foot Cone (3 charges) at DC 15 on 7 charges, 1d6 + 1 back at dawn, a 1 on the last charge's d20 destroying it (item-actions.ts, resolution/charges.ts). Each cast applies as its spell's own row says. |
| Wand of Fireballs | enforced | Fireball at DC 15 on its charges, each charge past the first raising its level by 1 up to 3 (item-actions.ts); a 1 on the last charge's d20 destroys it (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Wand of Lightning Bolts | enforced | Lightning Bolt at DC 15 on its charges, each charge past the first raising its level by 1 up to 3 (item-actions.ts); a 1 on the last charge's d20 destroys it (resolution/charges.ts). |
| Wand of Paralysis | enforced | Its ray (1 of 7 charges, 1d6 + 1 back at dawn) opens a DC 15 Constitution save against Paralyzed for 1 minute on one creature it sees within 60 feet, repeated at each turn's end, and a 1 on the last charge's d20 destroys it (resolution/charges.ts). Only a spellcaster attunes to it. |
| Wand of Polymorph | enforced | Polymorph at DC 15 on 7 charges, 1d6 + 1 back at dawn, a 1 on the last charge's d20 destroying it (resolution/charges.ts); only a spellcaster attunes to it. |
| Wand of Secrets | enforced | Its Magic action spends 1 of its 3 charges (1d3 back at dawn): if a secret door on the map or a hidden trap or glyph lies within 60 feet of its holder, the table hears which way the wand points at the nearest, and the GM what it is and how far (resolution/door-work.ts). |
| Wand of the War Mage, +1 | enforced | The +1 to spell attack rolls is applied, and a spell attack roll sets the target's Half Cover aside (resolution/attack.ts). |
| Wand of the War Mage, +2 | enforced | The +2 to spell attack rolls is applied, and a spell attack roll sets the target's Half Cover aside (resolution/attack.ts). |
| Wand of the War Mage, +3 | enforced | The +3 to spell attack rolls is applied, and a spell attack roll sets the target's Half Cover aside (resolution/attack.ts). |
| Wand of Wonder | guided | Its 7 charges (1d6 + 1 back at dawn, a 1 on the last one's d20 destroying it) each roll the d100 table, and its nested d10 and d4 (item-outcomes.ts). What lands on its user (Stunned, 1d6 Psychic, its own shrinking, Invisibility) happens at once; the spells at DC 15, the rain and the butterflies as obscured areas, the creature that appears, the burst of light and the creature turning to stone are its user's to place that turn at no further cost. Holding the point of origin chosen before the roll, the 120-foot range for shorter spells, and the closest creature as the target are the GM's to police; the grass, the leaves, the object sent to the Ethereal Plane and the gems' shared damage are the GM's. |
| Weapon of Warning | enforced | Advantage on Initiative for its attuned bearer and the allies within 30 feet of it, and the Alarm that wakes each of them sleeping naturally (Unconscious with Hit Points and no effect holding it there) as the encounter begins, are applied (encounter.ts). |
| Well of Many Worlds | guided | Opening a portal starts its wait of 1d8 hours of game time before the next (clock-pools.ts). Where a portal leads, and what passes through, are the GM's. |
| Wings of Flying | enforced | The action gives a Fly Speed of 60 feet for an hour, or until the wearer ends it on the sheet; a creature in the air when it ends falls (falling.ts). clock-pools.ts keeps the wings from being used again until 1d12 + 1 hours of game time have passed from their use (the hour they last, then the wait). |

## Gear and tools

Notes on the curated rows:

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Acid (vial) | enforced | Thrown in place of an attack at a creature or object the thrower sees within 20 feet: a creature makes the Dexterity save (DC 8 plus the thrower's Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or takes 2d6 Acid damage, and a door or a wall on the map that is an object fails it and takes the damage (resolution/object-targets.ts, objects.ts). |
| Alchemist's Fire (flask) | enforced | Thrown in place of an attack at a creature or object the thrower sees within 20 feet: a creature makes the Dexterity save or takes 1d4 Fire damage and starts burning, 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it puts the fire out (hazards.ts). A door or a wall on the map that is an object fails the save and takes the 1d4 Fire (resolution/object-targets.ts); an object has no turns, so its burning after that is the GM's. |
| Alchemist's Supplies | guided | The sheet rolls its check with the ability it names and offers its Utilize uses at their printed DCs; a use rolled in an encounter takes the Utilize action and needs the tool in the pack (tool-uses.ts). crafting.ts makes what its Craft line lists in downtime, for half the price in raw materials and a day of 8 hours per 10 GP, helpers with the proficiency dividing the days. What a check finds is the GM's. |
| Arcane Focus (Crystal) | enforced | resolution/components.ts takes it as a Sorcerer's, Warlock's or Wizard's Spellcasting Focus for a Material component that has no cost and isn't consumed, with a free hand to hold it. |
| Arcane Focus (Orb) | enforced | resolution/components.ts takes it as a Sorcerer's, Warlock's or Wizard's Spellcasting Focus for a Material component that has no cost and isn't consumed, with a free hand to hold it. |
| Arcane Focus (Rod) | enforced | resolution/components.ts takes it as a Sorcerer's, Warlock's or Wizard's Spellcasting Focus for a Material component that has no cost and isn't consumed, with a free hand to hold it. |
| Arcane Focus (Staff) | enforced | It swings as a Quarterstaff: 1d6 Bludgeoning, Versatile (1d8), the Topple mastery. |
| Arcane Focus (Wand) | enforced | resolution/components.ts takes it as a Sorcerer's, Warlock's or Wizard's Spellcasting Focus for a Material component that has no cost and isn't consumed, with a free hand to hold it. |
| Backpack | enforced | It holds 30 pounds of gear in the Gear tab, weighed with its bearer's load (containers.ts, carrying.ts). Taking a thing out in an encounter is the turn's free object interaction, and a second takes the Utilize action (object-interactions.ts). |
| Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000) | enforced | Spilling them from the pack places a 10-foot square that rolls nothing as it lands (resolution/concentration.ts). spell-zones.ts asks a creature that enters it for the DC 10 Dexterity save, once a turn, and a failure leaves it Prone. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). The square stays until the GM ends it, which is gathering them up. |
| Barrel | reference | The Gear tab carries it, weighed with its bearer's load (carrying.ts). What it holds, 40 gallons of liquid or 4 cubic feet of dry goods, is the table's: the app measures no volume. |
| Basket | enforced | It holds 40 pounds of gear in the Gear tab, weighed with its bearer's load (containers.ts, carrying.ts). Taking a thing out in an encounter is the turn's free object interaction, and a second takes the Utilize action (object-interactions.ts). |
| Bedroll | enforced | Equipped, it is the Bedroll its owner sleeps in: environment.ts passes its Constitution save against extreme cold at the end of each hour on the game clock. Sleeping in light armor is the GM's. |
| Bell | reference | The Gear tab carries it, weighed with its bearer's load (carrying.ts). Ringing it takes the Utilize action, and who hears it within 60 feet is the GM's. |
| Blanket | enforced | Equipped, it is wrapped round its owner: environment.ts gives Advantage on the Constitution save against extreme cold at the end of each hour on the game clock. |
| Block and Tackle | reference | The Gear tab carries it, weighed with its bearer's load (carrying.ts). Hoisting up to four times what its user can lift is the GM's, since the app weighs only what a creature carries. |
| Book | enforced | While it is equipped, the sheet offers "consulting an accurate Book about its topic" beside the checks (check-situations.ts), and an Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature or Religion) check that names it gains +5 (ability-checks.ts). Whether the Book is accurate and on topic is the GM's. |
| Bottle, Glass | reference | The Gear tab carries it, weighed with its bearer's load (carrying.ts). What it holds, a pint and a half, is the table's: the app measures no volume. |
| Brewer's Supplies | guided | The sheet rolls its check with the ability it names and offers its Utilize uses at their printed DCs; a use rolled in an encounter takes the Utilize action and needs the tool in the pack (tool-uses.ts). crafting.ts makes what its Craft line lists in downtime, for half the price in raw materials and a day of 8 hours per 10 GP, helpers with the proficiency dividing the days. What a check finds is the GM's. |
| Bucket | reference | The Gear tab carries it, weighed with its bearer's load (carrying.ts). What it holds, half a cubic foot, is the table's: the app measures no volume. |
| Burglar's Pack | enforced | A character who comes by it at the build (character-build.ts) or on the sheet (inventory.ts) gets what it holds, each in its own stack. |
| Calligrapher's Supplies | guided | The sheet rolls its check with the ability it names and offers its Utilize uses at their printed DCs; a use rolled in an encounter takes the Utilize action and needs the tool in the pack (tool-uses.ts). crafting.ts makes Ink in downtime, and scribes a Spell Scroll of a spell the scribe has prepared on each day of work, at the Spell Scroll Costs table's days and gold, with the scribe's spell save DC and attack bonus. What a check finds is the GM's. |
| Caltrops (bag of 20) | enforced | Spreading them from the pack places a 5-foot square that rolls nothing as it lands (resolution/concentration.ts). spell-zones.ts asks a creature that enters it for the DC 15 Dexterity save, once a turn: 1 Piercing damage and a Speed of 0 until the start of its next turn on a failure. A move that enters it waits there on the save, and a failure ends the move (zone-stops.ts, held-moves.ts). The square stays until the GM ends it, which is gathering them up. |
| Carpenter's Tools | guided | door.use pries a door on the map open, or seals a closed one, with a DC 20 Strength check with the tools, taking the Utilize action in an encounter (doors.ts). A sealed door is forced open at DC 20. Its sheet use takes the Utilize action too (tool-uses.ts), and crafting.ts makes what its Craft line lists in downtime. Prying a container open is the GM's, rolled as the sheet's check: no container has a lid to pry. |
