| --- | --- | --- |
| Ammunition | enforced | ammunition.ts draws a piece for each shot from the attacker's pack or quiver and refuses a shot without one, and half the spent pieces can be recovered after the encounter. |
| Cleave | enforced | resolution/extra-attacks.ts offers a second melee attack against another creature within 5 feet of the first, once a turn, without the ability modifier on its damage. |
| Finesse | enforced | item-actions.ts lets the attack and its damage use the better of Strength and Dexterity. |
| Graze | enforced | resolution/masteries.ts deals the ability modifier's damage on a miss. |
| Heavy | enforced | equipment-derivation.ts gives a Heavy melee weapon's attacks Disadvantage below Strength 13 and a Heavy ranged weapon's below Dexterity 13. |
| Light | enforced | resolution/extra-attacks.ts offers a second attack with a different Light weapon as a Bonus Action after an attack with one, without the ability modifier on its damage unless it is negative. |
| Loading | enforced | resolution/economy.ts fires only one piece of ammunition from it on each action, Bonus Action or Reaction. |
| Nick | enforced | resolution/extra-attacks.ts makes the Light weapon's extra attack part of the Attack action, once a turn. |
| Push | enforced | resolution/masteries.ts pushes a Large or smaller creature hit up to 10 feet straight away. |
| Reach | enforced | item-actions.ts adds 5 feet to the reach of its attacks and of the Opportunity Attacks it offers. |
| Sap | enforced | resolution/masteries.ts gives a creature hit Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the attacker's next turn. |
| Slow | enforced | resolution/masteries.ts takes 10 feet off a creature's Speed after a hit that damages it, until the attacker's next turn, without stacking. |
| Thrown | enforced | item-actions.ts offers it as a ranged attack at its range with the melee ability, and the weapon leaves the hand where it lands (resolution/ammunition.ts). |
| Topple | enforced | resolution/masteries.ts asks a creature hit for a Constitution save against 8 plus the attack's ability modifier and Proficiency Bonus, Prone on a failure. |
| Two-Handed | enforced | resolution/economy.ts and resolution/attack.ts need both hands free to attack with it. |
| Versatile | enforced | equipment-derivation.ts deals its larger die when it is held in two hands. |
| Vex | enforced | resolution/masteries.ts gives the attacker Advantage on its next attack roll against a creature it hit and damaged, before the end of its next turn. |

## Conditions

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blinded | enforced | resolution/attack.ts: its attack rolls have Disadvantage and attack rolls against it have Advantage. ability-checks.ts fails its Perception check to find a creature unless its Blindsight reaches it, and any check the GM marks as needing sight (check-rolls.ts, a call for a roll). It can't target a creature a spell or action needs it to see unless its Blindsight reaches it (resolution/spell-targets.ts, action-targets.ts, vision/rules.ts). movement-rules.ts: it makes an Opportunity Attack only against a mover in its Blindsight, and with dynamic vision on vision/sight.ts lets it see only within Blindsight. |
| Charmed | enforced | resolution/economy.ts: a Charmed creature can't attack its charmer or target it with a save, damage or a spell, whether the condition came from a spell, an action or the GM's chip naming the charmer (actor-conditions.ts). ability-checks.ts gives the charmer Advantage on Charisma checks and Animal Handling against it (Influence, or a check the GM calls naming it). |
| Deafened | enforced | ability-checks.ts fails a check the GM marks as needing hearing (check-rolls.ts, a call for a roll); nothing else in the condition changes a roll. |
| Exhaustion | enforced | condition-rules.ts takes 2 per level from every D20 Test, and speed.ts takes 5 feet per level from Speed. effects.ts kills the creature at level 6, and rests.ts removes a level on each Long Rest, except the levels hunger and thirst hold until the creature eats and drinks its fill (survival.ts). Breathing again takes off the levels suffocating gave (breath.ts). |
| Frightened | enforced | resolution/attack.ts, ability-checks.ts and encounter.ts give it Disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks and Initiative while the source of its fear is within line of sight (vision/rules.ts; always with dynamic vision off, or when the GM set the condition by hand without naming its source). movement-rules.ts refuses a willing move, a granted one included, that ends closer to the source, measuring height too. |
| Grappled | enforced | speed.ts: Speed 0. resolution/attack.ts: Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but the grappler. movement-rules.ts lets the grappler drag it, and resolution/builtins.ts rolls Escape a Grapple against the escape DC. |
| Incapacitated | enforced | resolution/economy.ts refuses its actions, Bonus Actions and Reactions. effects.ts ends its Concentration and its grapples, and encounter.ts gives it Disadvantage on Initiative. |
| Invisible | enforced | resolution/attack.ts: Advantage on its attack rolls and Disadvantage on attack rolls against it, unless the other creature sees it (Blindsight, Truesight or See Invisibility within range, or the map with dynamic vision on) or Faerie Fire outlines it. A spell or action that needs a target its user sees can't pick it unless its user sees it the same way (resolution/spell-targets.ts, action-targets.ts). encounter.ts: Advantage on Initiative. movement-rules.ts: it provokes an Opportunity Attack only from a creature whose Blindsight or Truesight reaches it. |
| Paralyzed | enforced | It counts as Incapacitated, and speed.ts sets its Speed to 0. saving-throws.ts fails its Strength and Dexterity saves. resolution/attack.ts gives attack rolls against it Advantage and makes a hit from within 5 feet a Critical Hit. |
| Petrified | enforced | It counts as Incapacitated, with Speed 0 and failed Strength and Dexterity saves, and attack rolls against it have Advantage. hit-points.ts gives it Resistance to all damage, and effects.ts makes it immune to the Poisoned condition. Its change of substance is narrative. |
| Poisoned | enforced | resolution/attack.ts and ability-checks.ts: Disadvantage on its attack rolls and ability checks, Initiative included. |
| Prone | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges an extra foot per foot while it crawls, and actor-conditions.ts charges half its Speed to stand up and lets a creature drop Prone only on its own turn and not at Speed 0. resolution/attack.ts: Disadvantage on its attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have Advantage within 5 feet and Disadvantage beyond. |
| Restrained | enforced | speed.ts: Speed 0. resolution/attack.ts: Disadvantage on its attack rolls and Advantage on attack rolls against it. saving-throws.ts: Disadvantage on its Dexterity saves. |
| Stunned | enforced | It counts as Incapacitated. saving-throws.ts fails its Strength and Dexterity saves, and resolution/attack.ts gives attack rolls against it Advantage. |
| Unconscious | enforced | effects.ts adds Prone, and it counts as Incapacitated with Speed 0. saving-throws.ts fails its Strength and Dexterity saves. resolution/attack.ts gives attack rolls against it Advantage and makes a hit from within 5 feet a Critical Hit. effects.ts and hit-points.ts take the weapons, wands, staffs and rods it holds out of its hands; they stay carried, and what one gave its Armor Class goes with it (held-items.ts). |

## Rules glossary

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ability Check | enforced | check-rolls.ts and ability-checks.ts roll it on the server. The roll adds the ability modifier and any proficiency or Expertise, with the Advantage and Disadvantage the rules give. |
| Ability Score and Modifier | enforced | The builder sets the scores, and every roll adds the modifier from abilityModifier in rules-5e. |
| Action | enforced | resolution/economy.ts allows one action on a creature's turn and refuses a second unless a feature such as Action Surge gives one. |
| Advantage | enforced | rules-5e rolls two d20s and keeps the higher. Any Advantage and any Disadvantage on the same roll cancel. |
| Adventure | reference | A definition; there is nothing to apply. |
| Alignment | reference | A definition; nothing in play reads it. |
| Ally | enforced | creature-sides.ts puts player characters and friendly creatures on one side, by token disposition. Auras, Pack Tactics and Help read it. |
| Area of Effect | enforced | commands/actions.ts places the template and area-targeting.ts finds who is inside, as high as its shape reaches (altitude.ts); a lasting area reads the same height as creatures enter it or start a turn there (spell-zones.ts). The creature a Cone, a Line or an Emanation comes from is left out of it, and with dynamic vision on a creature every straight line to which a wall or closed door blocks from the point of origin is left out too. |
| Armor Class | enforced | armor-class.ts in the domain package works out AC from armor, Shield, Dexterity and riders, and every attack roll is compared with it. |
| Armor Training | enforced | equipment-derivation.ts gives untrained armor Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity D20 Tests, and resolution/economy.ts refuses spells while it is worn. An untrained Shield adds no AC. Training an item grants counts too (Elven Chain). |
| Attack | enforced | resolution/economy.ts counts the attacks the Attack action allows, Extra Attack included, and lets the creature move between them. Equipping or stowing a weapon is the table's. |
| Attack Roll | enforced | resolution/attack.ts rolls it on the server and compares it with the target's AC. |
| Attitude | guided | The GM sets a monster's or NPC's attitude from its row (actor.set-attitude), Indifferent until then and never sent to a player. ability-checks.ts reads it in Influence and in Charisma checks naming the creature: Advantage against a Friendly one, Disadvantage against a Hostile one. What the creature does about it is the GM's. |
| Attunement | enforced | inventory.ts holds a creature to three attuned items, and an item that needs Attunement gives nothing until it has it. attunement.ts lets a player attune or end Attunement only during a Short Rest, to one copy of an item whose printed prerequisite the creature meets (a class, a species, spellcasting or another attuned item); the GM may attune anyone. A cursed item's Attunement can't be ended. |
| Blinded | enforced | resolution/attack.ts: its attack rolls have Disadvantage and attack rolls against it have Advantage. ability-checks.ts fails its Perception check to find a creature unless its Blindsight reaches it, and any check the GM marks as needing sight (check-rolls.ts, a call for a roll). It can't target a creature a spell or action needs it to see unless its Blindsight reaches it (resolution/spell-targets.ts, action-targets.ts, vision/rules.ts). movement-rules.ts: it makes an Opportunity Attack only against a mover in its Blindsight, and with dynamic vision on vision/sight.ts lets it see only within Blindsight. |
| Blindsight | enforced | vision/senses.ts reads it from stat blocks, features, items and effects. Within its range a creature perceives what no wall hides, Blinded, in darkness or fog, or against the Invisible condition (vision/sight.ts). Attack rolls, Hide, Search and Opportunity Attacks read it, by the distance between the tokens with dynamic vision off. |
| Bloodied | enforced | The server counts half Hit Points or fewer as Bloodied (healthBandOf in hit-points.ts) for the rules that name it, such as monster traits and damage that changes when Bloodied. |
| Bonus Action | enforced | resolution/economy.ts allows one Bonus Action on a turn, and only from a feature, spell or item that offers one. |
| Breaking Objects | enforced | A door or wall on the map, and what holds a creature (a Net, a web, a rope), can be an object with an Armor Class, Hit Points and a damage threshold (objects.ts); the GM's door editor sets them from the substance and size tables. object.attack rolls a creature's attack against it (object-strikes.ts), an action that targets a creature or object (Acid, Alchemist's Fire, Oil) can be aimed at it, and a spell whose area harms objects (Shatter, Meteor Swarm) deals its damage to each one under the area; the object fails the save and takes all of it (resolution/object-targets.ts). object.damage deals the GM's damage. Poison and Psychic damage do nothing, and at 0 Hit Points a wall or door is gone and a held creature is freed. Objects the map doesn't hold (furniture, chests) and an object left burning are the GM's. |
| Bright Light | enforced | With dynamic vision on, vision/sight.ts gives Bright Light under the encounter's bright ambient light, in a painted bright area and within a light's bright radius, and a creature sees normally there. |
| Burning | enforced | hazards.ts deals 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of the creature's turns. Put Out the Fire (resolution/builtins.ts) ends it and leaves the creature Prone. |
| Burrow Speed | enforced | speed.ts and movement-rules.ts let a creature with a Burrow Speed move by burrowing, charged against that speed. |
| Campaign | reference | A definition; there is nothing to apply. |
| Cantrip | enforced | Every cantrip a sheet or stat block knows is a cast action with no slot (character-build.ts, monster-spells.ts), and its damage grows at the character levels its row prints (cantripTierAt in the content package). |
| Carrying Capacity | enforced | carrying.ts weighs a character's or stat block's rows and coins (fifty to the pound), what its containers hold counted as each weighs it (containers.ts), against its Strength times its size's figure, one size up with Powerful Build or Beast of Burden. speed.ts holds its Speed to 5 feet while it carries more, up to twice that, and to 0 beyond it; the Gear tab shows the load. Dragging, lifting or pushing something it doesn't carry is the GM's. |
| Challenge Rating | guided | The bestiary shows each monster's CR and XP, and the encounter budget (EncounterBudget.tsx, encounters.ts in rules-5e) rates an encounter for the party's levels. The GM decides what to run. |
| Character Sheet | reference | A definition. The app's own sheet is where each character's records live. |
| Charmed | enforced | resolution/economy.ts: a Charmed creature can't attack its charmer or target it with a save, damage or a spell, whether the condition came from a spell, an action or the GM's chip naming the charmer (actor-conditions.ts). ability-checks.ts gives the charmer Advantage on Charisma checks and Animal Handling against it (Influence, or a check the GM calls naming it). |
| Climb Speed | enforced | speed.ts gives a creature with a Climb Speed its own budget for climbing, with no extra cost. |
| Climbing | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges an extra foot per foot of climbing without a Climb Speed. A check for a slippery surface is the GM's. |
| Concentration | enforced | resolution/concentration.ts ends the first Concentration spell when a second starts. hit-points.ts asks for a Constitution save against DC 10 or half the damage, up to 30, and effects.ts ends it when the caster is Incapacitated or dies, or when a spell that only affects creatures has none left under it. Its duration counts down on the game clock (game-time.ts). |
| Condition | enforced | effects.ts applies every condition through applyCondition, which honours immunities, ends one a creature becomes immune to, and ends it when its save says or its duration runs out, in rounds during an encounter and on the game clock between them (game-time.ts). |
| Cone | enforced | area-targeting.ts: its width at any point equals that point's distance from the origin. The server finds every creature with a cell centre inside the template. |
| Cover | enforced | With dynamic vision on, cover.ts works out Half, Three-Quarters and Total Cover from the walls between the attacker, or a placed area's point of origin (resolution/pending.ts), and each target, and Half Cover from a creature in the way; a spell's wall gives the cover its text names against an attack or a picked target (Blade Barrier's Three-Quarters, zone-walls.ts), and the GM can mark more. The server adds 2 or 5 to AC and Dexterity saves, and resolution/validate.ts refuses any picked target behind Total Cover, each of a spell's several targets included, or across a sphere of force (enclosures.ts). Cover from what the map doesn't hold (furniture, a low wall drawn as a full one) is the GM's mark. |
| Crawling | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges an extra foot per foot while a creature is Prone. |
| Creature | reference | A definition; there is nothing to apply. |
| Creature Type | enforced | statblock-facts.ts reads the stat block's type, and riders gated on a creature type read it (Divine Smite's extra die against Fiends and Undead). |
| Critical Hit | enforced | resolution/attack.ts makes a 20 on the d20 hit, and the damage step rolls the attack's damage dice twice. |
| Cube | enforced | area-targeting.ts: a Cube is a square on the map with its own size for each side. The server finds every creature with a cell centre inside the template. |
| Curses | enforced | inventory.ts hides a cursed item's curse until it is attuned, and its bearer can't end the Attunement. Spells (Hex, Bestow Curse, Geas) and monsters (a lycanthrope's bite, a lamia's touch, a mummy's rot and others) mark what they leave as a curse. Remove Curse ends them all and Greater Restoration the one picked, each breaking the Attunement to a cursed item (resolution/dispel.ts, resolution/restoration.ts), and Wish's Instant Health ends them as Greater Restoration does. |
| Cylinder | enforced | area-targeting.ts: a Cylinder is a circle of its radius as tall as its height, and a creature counts at the height it stands (altitude.ts). The server finds every creature with a cell centre inside the template. |
| D20 Test | enforced | Ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws all roll on the server, and riders that name D20 Tests reach each of them. |
| Damage | enforced | hit-points.ts takes damage off Temporary Hit Points first and then Hit Points. |
| Damage Roll | enforced | The server rolls damage dice and adds the modifiers the action carries. |
| Damage Threshold | enforced | An object on the map with a damage threshold takes no damage from a hit or effect below it, and the whole of one at or above it (objects.ts). No SRD stat block prints one. |
| Damage Types | enforced | Damage carries one of the 13 types, and hit-points.ts applies Immunity, Resistance and Vulnerability by type. |
| Darkness | enforced | With dynamic vision on, vision/sight.ts treats an unlit point in a dark encounter or a painted dark area as Heavily Obscured: only Darkvision, Blindsight, Truesight or Devil's Sight see there, and only Blindsight, Truesight or Devil's Sight into magical Darkness. Attack rolls, Hide, Search and what each player sees read it. |
| Darkvision | enforced | vision/senses.ts reads it from species, stat blocks, items and effects, and with dynamic vision on vision/sight.ts lets the creature see Dim Light within its range as Bright Light and Darkness as Dim Light, so a creature in darkness there is Lightly Obscured to it. |
| Dash | enforced | resolution/grant.ts and speed.ts add the creature's Speed to its movement for the turn. |
| Dead | enforced | death.ts counts a creature dead at three failed death saves, at Exhaustion 6 or from massive damage, and a monster dead at 0 Hit Points. resolution/heal.ts gives the dead no Hit Points; only the GM's revival brings one back. |
| Deafened | enforced | ability-checks.ts fails a check the GM marks as needing hearing (check-rolls.ts, a call for a roll); nothing else in the condition changes a roll. |
| Death Saving Throw | enforced | death-saves.ts rolls it from the dying character's sheet: 10 or more succeeds, a 1 counts as two failures and a 20 restores 1 Hit Point. hit-points.ts adds a failure for damage taken at 0 Hit Points, two for a Critical Hit. |
| Dehydration | enforced | survival.ts, while the GM tracks food and water: each character drinks from its Waterskins as the game day ends, as far as its need goes; less than half its water costs a level of Exhaustion that no rest removes until it drinks its fill. The GM gives a drink at a source. |
| Difficult Terrain | enforced | The GM paints difficult terrain on the map (terrain.ts), and movement-rules.ts charges double through it, through an enemy's space and, with dynamic vision on, through an opening sized for a creature one size smaller, which a narrower gap bars (footprintStepPassage in rules-5e): a Small or Medium creature squeezes through a gap half a square to three quarters of one wide. The map's drag preview charges the same path (movePreview.ts). Freedom of Movement ignores it. |
| Difficulty Class | enforced | The server works out spell save DCs and feature DCs from the sheet and compares every save and check with its DC. |
| Dim Light | enforced | With dynamic vision on, vision/sight.ts knows Dim Light (dim ambient light, a painted dim area, a light's outer radius) and treats it as Lightly Obscured. |
| Disadvantage | enforced | rules-5e rolls two d20s and keeps the lower. Any Advantage and any Disadvantage on the same roll cancel. |
| Disengage | enforced | movement-rules.ts opens no Opportunity Attacks against the creature for the rest of its turn. |
| Dodge | enforced | builtin-actions.ts gives attack rolls against it Disadvantage from an attacker it can see (vision/rules.ts) and its Dexterity saves Advantage until its next turn. Both lapse while it is Incapacitated. |
| Emanation | enforced | area-targeting.ts: an Emanation is a circle around its creature, which isn't in the area. The server finds every creature with a cell centre inside the template. |
| Encounter | reference | A definition. Encounters run in the encounter tracker, which the other rows describe. |
| Enemy | enforced | creature-sides.ts puts monsters and hostile creatures against the party, by token disposition. Opportunity Attacks, auras and Sneak Attack read it. |
| Exhaustion | enforced | condition-rules.ts takes 2 per level from every D20 Test, and speed.ts takes 5 feet per level from Speed. effects.ts kills the creature at level 6, and rests.ts removes a level on each Long Rest, except the levels hunger and thirst hold until the creature eats and drinks its fill (survival.ts). Breathing again takes off the levels suffocating gave (breath.ts). |
| Experience Points | enforced | experience.ts keeps each character's XP total, which the GM awards as an amount or as a share of the defeated creatures' stat block XP (the lair XP for one fought in its lair). The sheet shows the next level's threshold and offers the level up once the total reaches it. How much to award, or levelling by milestone, is the GM's. |
| Expertise | enforced | ability-checks.ts doubles the Proficiency Bonus on a check with a skill the sheet has Expertise in. |
| Falling | enforced | falling.ts rolls 1d6 Bludgeoning for every 10 feet fallen, to 20d6, through the damage rules, and lands the creature Prone unless it took no damage. Into water, the water painted where it comes down or water the GM names, it uses its Reaction for a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, the better of the two, a success halving the damage. The GM starts a fall with actor.fall, and a creature that can't stay in the air falls by itself; Feather Fall and Slow Fall are offered as Reactions to it. What it fell from and where it lands are the GM's. |
| Fly Speed | enforced | speed.ts gives a creature with a Fly Speed its own budget for flying. |
| Flying | enforced | altitude.ts keeps the height a fly move or the GM gives a token, and every distance counts it. falling.ts drops a flier that is Prone, Incapacitated or at a Fly Speed of 0 unless it can hover, and one left with nothing to fly with, after any command. |
| Friendly | enforced | ability-checks.ts gives an Influence check, or a Charisma check naming the creature, Advantage against a creature the GM set Friendly. |
| Frightened | enforced | resolution/attack.ts, ability-checks.ts and encounter.ts give it Disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks and Initiative while the source of its fear is within line of sight (vision/rules.ts; always with dynamic vision off, or when the GM set the condition by hand without naming its source). movement-rules.ts refuses a willing move, a granted one included, that ends closer to the source, measuring height too. |
| Grappled | enforced | speed.ts: Speed 0. resolution/attack.ts: Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but the grappler. movement-rules.ts lets the grappler drag it, and resolution/builtins.ts rolls Escape a Grapple against the escape DC. |
| Grappling | enforced | resolution/builtins.ts rolls the target's Strength or Dexterity save against 8 plus Strength plus the Proficiency Bonus, and refuses a target more than one size larger. The grapple ends when the grappler is Incapacitated or moves out of reach (effects.ts). |
| Hazard | reference | A definition. Each hazard it names has its own row: Burning, Dehydration, Falling, Malnutrition and Suffocation. |
| Healing | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores Hit Points up to the maximum, and healing a dying character brings it back to consciousness. |
| Heavily Obscured | enforced | With dynamic vision on, no one sees into a Heavily Obscured space (darkness beyond a creature's senses, a painted fog or foliage area, a spell's cloud) in vision/sight.ts, so an attack there is against an unseen target, a creature there may Hide, and a Perception check to find a creature there fails (ability-checks.ts). |
| Help | enforced | resolution/attack.ts gives the next attack roll by an ally against the distracted enemy, which must be within 5 feet of the helper, Advantage. Help with a Check gives an ally Advantage on its next check with one of the helper's skill or tool proficiencies before the helper's next turn (help-assist.ts), in an encounter or outside one from the sheet's Checks tab. Whether the ally is near enough to assist is the GM's call. |
| Heroic Inspiration | enforced | held-rolls.ts spends it to reroll the d20 of an attack, a check, a save (a pending one or a loose one from the sheet) or a death save while the roll is shown, initiative-reroll.ts an initiative die before the character's first turn, and resolution/held-damage.ts one die of an action's damage or healing looked at before it counts, a hit's extras (Sneak Attack, a smite) included. rests.ts rerolls the lowest die of a Hit Point Dice spend. Only the GM gives it by hand. rests.ts gives it to a Human on a Long Rest, and turn-boundaries.ts to a Champion at the start of its turn. A character who gains a second one passes it to a player character without it or lets it go (heroic-inspiration.ts). The damage dice of a reaction's strike are the GM's to reroll. |
| Hide | enforced | resolution/builtins.ts rolls a DC 15 Dexterity (Stealth) check and makes the creature Invisible on a success, until it makes an attack roll or casts a spell with a Verbal component (resolution/release.ts), or an enemy's Search meets its total; a throw that asks for a save (a Net, a flask) keeps it hidden. With dynamic vision on, resolution/validate.ts asks that it be Heavily Obscured or behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover and out of every enemy's sight (vision/rules.ts). A sound louder than a whisper is the GM's call. |
| High Jump | enforced | jumping.ts lets a jump rise up to 3 plus the Strength modifier with 10 feet moved this turn before it, half from a standing start, a foot of movement for each foot. Reaching up half its height more is the GM's. |
| Hit Point Dice | enforced | rests.ts lets a creature spend them only during a Short Rest (its own or the party's), each healing its roll plus the Constitution modifier, and restores them all on a Long Rest. The GM may spend them any time. |
| Hit Points | enforced | hit-points.ts keeps Hit Points between 0 and the maximum, and a creature at 0 falls Unconscious or dies. |
| Hostile | enforced | ability-checks.ts gives an Influence check, or a Charisma check naming the creature, Disadvantage against a creature the GM set Hostile. |
| Hover | enforced | speed.ts records whether a creature hovers, and falling.ts keeps a hovering flier in the air while it is Prone, Incapacitated or at a Fly Speed of 0. |
| Illusions | reference | Illusions are the GM's to run. |
| Immunity | enforced | hit-points.ts ignores damage of an immune type. effects.ts refuses a condition the creature is immune to, and a creature that becomes immune (Heroism, a Periapt of Proof against Poison) loses the condition it already has. |
| Improvised Weapons | enforced | builtin-actions.ts and resolution/builtins.ts give every creature an improvised swing and throw: 1d4 plus Strength of a damage type the attacker picks, with no Proficiency Bonus, thrown 20/60. A carried weapon swings or flies as an improvised weapon too (item-actions.ts), and one thrown leaves the hand to be picked up (ammunition.ts). Treating a table leg as a Club is the GM's. |
| Incapacitated | enforced | resolution/economy.ts refuses its actions, Bonus Actions and Reactions. effects.ts ends its Concentration and its grapples, and encounter.ts gives it Disadvantage on Initiative. |
| Indifferent | enforced | A creature is Indifferent until the GM sets another attitude: its checks roll normally, and Perfume's Advantage reads it (ability-checks.ts). |
| Influence | guided | resolution/builtins.ts rolls the chosen Charisma or Wisdom check against 15 or the monster's Intelligence, whichever is higher, with Advantage against a Friendly creature or its charmer and Disadvantage against a Hostile one (ability-checks.ts). Animal Handling is refused against a creature that is neither a Beast nor a Monstrosity. The GM decides what the monster does. |
| Initiative | enforced | encounter.ts rolls Initiative as a Dexterity check, with its Advantage, Disadvantage and the bonuses and dice Dexterity checks take, flat or rolled (a Stone of Good Luck's +1), and orders the turns. Heroic Inspiration rerolls its d20 before the character's first turn (initiative-reroll.ts). The players order their characters tied on a score before either acts (initiative.order-tie); the GM orders tied monsters. |
| Invisible | enforced | resolution/attack.ts: Advantage on its attack rolls and Disadvantage on attack rolls against it, unless the other creature sees it (Blindsight, Truesight or See Invisibility within range, or the map with dynamic vision on) or Faerie Fire outlines it. A spell or action that needs a target its user sees can't pick it unless its user sees it the same way (resolution/spell-targets.ts, action-targets.ts). encounter.ts: Advantage on Initiative. movement-rules.ts: it provokes an Opportunity Attack only from a creature whose Blindsight or Truesight reaches it. |
| Jumping | enforced | token.move's `jump` way of moving goes straight over what lies between, measured as a Long Jump across and a High Jump up (jumping.ts), and a landing in Difficult Terrain rolls a DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or leaves the jumper Prone. |
| Knocking Out a Creature | enforced | A melee hit's confirm offers Knock out (resolution/knock-out.ts), and every apply path then lands it: hit-points.ts leaves a creature it drops at 1 Hit Point and Unconscious until it regains Hit Points, stabilize.ts gives it first aid, or an hour passes on the game clock and its Short Rest ends (game-time.ts). |
| Lightly Obscured | enforced | With dynamic vision on, vision/sight.ts knows Lightly Obscured points (Dim Light, a painted light fog or foliage area), and ability-checks.ts gives a Perception check to find a creature there Disadvantage: a check naming it, and the Search action, whose one roll is read against each hidden creature with the lower of two d20s where that creature is Lightly Obscured (resolution/builtins.ts). A Passive Perception compared with a Hide total is 5 less. |
| Line | enforced | area-targeting.ts: a Line has a fixed width, and the point it starts from isn't in it. The server finds every creature with a cell centre inside the template. |
| Long Jump | enforced | jumping.ts lets a jump cover up to the Strength score with 10 feet moved this turn before it, half from a standing start, a foot of movement for each foot, and rolls the DC 10 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check on a landing in Difficult Terrain. Clearing a low obstacle is the GM's. |
| Long Rest | enforced | rests.ts needs 1 Hit Point and 16 hours since the last one. It restores Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, spell slots and uses, removes a level of Exhaustion and ends what lasts until a Long Rest. The party's Long Rest stays open from the game clock's time until the GM finishes it, which moves the clock 8 hours and counts down every effect (long-rest.ts, game-time.ts). Rolling Initiative, taking damage or casting a spell above a cantrip interrupts a member's rest, and the GM interrupts one for an hour of walking or exertion (rest-interruptions.ts): after an hour of rest it gets a Short Rest's benefits and may spend Hit Point Dice, and resuming adds an hour per interruption. A Long Rest the GM grants one character at once has no span to interrupt. |
| Magic | enforced | resolution/economy.ts spends the action when a spell or an item's action is used. A spell of a minute or more, a creature's own or an item's, takes the action on each of its caster's turns in an encounter and resolves on the last, when an item's charges or a scroll are spent (resolution/long-casting.ts). Outside an encounter it completes at once and moves the game clock by its whole hours. |
| Magical Effect | enforced | resolution/pending.ts marks a save against a spell or a magic item as magical, which Magic Resistance reads. |
| Malnutrition | enforced | survival.ts, while the GM tracks food and water: each character eats its Rations as the game day ends, as far as its need goes; less than half its food asks a DC 10 Constitution save against a level of Exhaustion, and five days with no food give a level each day. Those levels stay until it eats its fill. The GM gives a meal. |
| Monster | reference | A definition; there is nothing to apply. |
| Nonplayer Character | reference | A definition; there is nothing to apply. |
| Object | enforced | Doors and walls on the map, and the nets, webs and ropes that hold creatures, can carry an object's Armor Class and Hit Points (objects.ts). An object takes damage from attacks (object.attack), and it fails every saving throw: an action aimed at it, or the area of a spell that harms objects, deals it the whole of its damage (resolution/object-targets.ts). |
| Occupied Space | enforced | movement-rules.ts refuses a move that ends in another creature's space, unless one of them can share it, and occupied-space.ts leaves a creature that ends its turn in another's space Prone unless it is Tiny or larger than the other. |
| Opportunity Attacks | enforced | movement-rules.ts opens a Reaction prompt when a mover leaves an enemy's reach, and reactions.ts resolves it as one melee attack. The mover waits at the edge of that reach while the prompt is open and carries on once it is answered, unless the attack dropped it, grappled it or knocked it Prone (held-moves.ts), and the spell areas on the rest of its way act on it as it goes on. Disengage, teleporting and forced movement provoke none. |
| Paralyzed | enforced | It counts as Incapacitated, and speed.ts sets its Speed to 0. saving-throws.ts fails its Strength and Dexterity saves. resolution/attack.ts gives attack rolls against it Advantage and makes a hit from within 5 feet a Critical Hit. |
| Passive Perception | enforced | ability-checks.ts works it out as 10 plus the Wisdom (Perception) bonus, 5 more with Advantage and 5 less with Disadvantage. After a successful Hide, resolution/builtins.ts names to the GM each enemy whose score meets the Stealth total, each 5 lower where the hider is Lightly Obscured to it, and none whose sight can't reach the hider. Whether one notices is the GM's call. |
| Per Day | enforced | use-pools.ts counts the uses, and a Long Rest gives them back. |
| Petrified | enforced | It counts as Incapacitated, with Speed 0 and failed Strength and Dexterity saves, and attack rolls against it have Advantage. hit-points.ts gives it Resistance to all damage, and effects.ts makes it immune to the Poisoned condition. Its change of substance is narrative. |
| Player Character | reference | A definition; there is nothing to apply. |
| Poisoned | enforced | resolution/attack.ts and ability-checks.ts: Disadvantage on its attack rolls and ability checks, Initiative included. |
| Possession | guided | A possessing effect (a ghost's Possession) is marked possessed (effects.ts). Protection from Evil and Good, a Magic Circle and Hallow keep their types from possessing the creatures they ward, with Advantage on a new save against a possession already held (save-stages.ts, zone-auras.ts), and Dispel Evil and Good's Break Enchantment ends it (resolution/break-enchantment.ts). What the possessor does with the body is as its own row says. |
| Proficiency | enforced | The server adds the Proficiency Bonus to attacks, saves and checks the sheet is proficient in. |
| Prone | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges an extra foot per foot while it crawls, and actor-conditions.ts charges half its Speed to stand up and lets a creature drop Prone only on its own turn and not at Speed 0. resolution/attack.ts: Disadvantage on its attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have Advantage within 5 feet and Disadvantage beyond. |
| Reach | enforced | resolution/economy.ts refuses a melee attack beyond reach, 5 feet unless the weapon or stat block says more. Opportunity Attacks use the same reach. |
| Reaction | enforced | resolution/economy.ts refuses a second Reaction before the creature's next turn, when encounter.ts gives it back. |
| Ready | enforced | resolution/ready.ts holds the response until the start of the creature's next turn and spends its Reaction to take it. A readied spell spends its slot at once and holds Concentration. |
| Resistance | enforced | hit-points.ts halves damage of a resisted type, rounded down, once per instance of damage. |
| Restrained | enforced | speed.ts: Speed 0. resolution/attack.ts: Disadvantage on its attack rolls and Advantage on attack rolls against it. saving-throws.ts: Disadvantage on its Dexterity saves. |
| Ritual | enforced | character-build.ts gives each Ritual spell on a sheet a cast with no slot, which resolution/economy.ts refuses unprepared except a Wizard's from the spellbook it carries (ritual-adept.ts). resolution/long-casting.ts adds the 10 minutes: in an encounter the cast takes the action on each turn until it completes. |
| Round Down | enforced | The server rounds down wherever a rule divides (halved damage, half Speed, DCs). |
| Save | enforced | Another name for a saving throw; see that row. |
| Saving Throw | enforced | saving-throws.ts opens a save prompt for each target and rolls it on the server, with the proficiency, riders, Advantage and Disadvantage that apply. A creature may choose to fail it without a roll (save.answer). |
| Search | guided | resolution/builtins.ts rolls the chosen Wisdom check. With dynamic vision on, a Perception search finds each hidden creature in its line of sight whose Hide total it meets and ends its hiding, read with Disadvantage against one Lightly Obscured to the searcher and Advantage against one its Hunter's Mark marks. The GM sets the DC of an Insight, Medicine or Survival search and says what the creature finds, and with dynamic vision off who the searcher can see is the GM's. |
| Shape-Shifting | enforced | transform/assume.ts takes a form as an effect on the creature: a stat block's statistics replace its own, with what the effect says it keeps (transform/compose.ts), or one of its printed forms changes its size and speeds. Its Hit Points stay its own, conditions and effects carry over, and the token takes the form's size (transform/forms.ts). It reverts when the effect ends or it dies (transform/rules.ts). |
| Short Rest | enforced | rests.ts needs 1 Hit Point, lets Hit Point Dice be spent, gives back what a Short Rest restores and ends what lasts until one. The party's Short Rest moves the game clock an hour when the GM finishes it. rest-interruptions.ts ends it for anyone who rolls Initiative, takes damage or casts a spell above a cantrip. |
| Simultaneous Effects | guided | simultaneous-effects.ts: two or more things that change Hit Points as a turn starts or ends (ongoing damage, Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points regained, a trait that burns or regenerates) wait for the creature's controller, its player or the GM, to put them in order, and turn-boundaries.ts plays them out that way. The saves a turn opens are prompts answered in any order. Other things that happen at once (effects set off by the same hit) run in the server's order, which the GM may correct. |
| Size | enforced | token-placement.ts sizes each token's space by its size, and size limits (grappling, shoving) are checked on the server. |
| Skill | enforced | ability-checks.ts adds the Proficiency Bonus to a check with a skill the sheet is proficient in. |
| Speed | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges each move against the creature's Speed for the turn, and each special speed has its own budget. |
| Spell | enforced | Every spell a sheet or stat block knows is a cast action that spends its casting time and slot (resolution/economy.ts) and is told to the table as cast (cast-narration.ts). Each spell's own row under Spells says what else the app does with it. |
| Spell Attack | enforced | resolution/attack.ts rolls it with the caster's spell attack bonus, Advantage and Disadvantage included. |
| Spellcasting Focus | enforced | resolution/components.ts checks a cast's components: a Verbal one needs a caster who can speak outside Silence, a Somatic one a free hand (a Shield or bound hands fill one), and a Material one a Component Pouch, the focus the class names or the material itself. A priced material must be carried, and a consumed one is used up. A stat block's cast is held to its Verbal component unless its text says it needs none; its hands and materials are the GM's. |
| Sphere | enforced | area-targeting.ts: a Sphere is a circle of its radius, and the point it starts from is in it. The server finds every creature with a cell centre inside the template. |
| Stable | enforced | stabilize.ts stops death saves after three successes, first aid or Spare the Dying. effects.ts rolls the 1d4 hours on the game clock after which the creature regains 1 Hit Point, and damage before then starts its dying again. |
| Stat Block | reference | A definition. Each monster's actions and traits have their own rows above. |
| Study | guided | resolution/builtins.ts rolls the chosen Intelligence check. The GM sets the DC and says what the creature learns. |
| Stunned | enforced | It counts as Incapacitated. saving-throws.ts fails its Strength and Dexterity saves, and resolution/attack.ts gives attack rolls against it Advantage. |
| Suffocation | enforced | breath.ts: a creature out of air holds its breath for 1 plus its Constitution modifier minutes (at least 30 seconds, or a Hold Breath trait's time), counted as its turns end and as game time passes, then gains a level of Exhaustion at the end of each of its turns; breathing again takes those levels off. The GM starts it from the creature's row, and an underwater encounter, a gelatinous cube's Engulf or a water elemental's Whelm starts it too. Amphibious, Water Breathing and a Cloak of the Manta Ray spare a creature. |
| Surprise | enforced | encounter.ts gives a creature the GM marks as surprised Disadvantage on its Initiative roll. |
| Swim Speed | enforced | speed.ts gives a creature with a Swim Speed its own budget for swimming, with no extra cost. |
| Swimming | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges an extra foot per foot of swimming without a Swim Speed. A check in rough water is the GM's. |
| Target | enforced | resolution/spell-targets.ts holds a spell to the number of targets it names (more with a higher slot), the ones the caster can see (vision/rules.ts, with dynamic vision on or off), its range, and for creatures of the caster's choice in an area, to those inside it; resolution/validate.ts refuses one behind Total Cover. A target of a type the spell can't affect is unaffected and the slot is spent, and its player isn't told the type (resolution/type-gates.ts). |
| Telepathy | reference | Telepathy is the table's to run. |
| Teleportation | enforced | movement-rules.ts moves a teleporting creature with no movement spent and no Opportunity Attack. A teleport a spell, feature or action granted for the turn (granted-moves.ts) is taken at once when it keeps to its range, an unoccupied space and one the creature can see; any other teleport of a player's needs the GM's go-ahead. |
| Temporary Hit Points | enforced | hit-points.ts takes damage from Temporary Hit Points first, and a Long Rest clears them. A new grant doesn't add to them: the creature keeps the higher of the two (resolution/heal.ts, turn-boundaries.ts). |
| Tremorsense | enforced | vision/senses.ts reads it, and with dynamic vision on vision/sight.ts lets the creature pinpoint creatures within range, walls or not, without seeing them, unless it or the other creature is in the air (altitude.ts). Whether two surfaces touch, or a liquid joins them, is the GM's: the map holds neither. |
| Truesight | enforced | Within its range vision/sight.ts lets a creature see Invisible creatures and into normal and magical Darkness, and attack rolls read it, by the distance between the tokens with dynamic vision off. It succeeds with no roll on its saves against a visual illusion (Phantasmal Force, Phantasmal Killer, Hypnotic Pattern) cast within its range (resolution/pending.ts). True forms and the Ethereal Plane are the GM's. |
| Unarmed Strike | enforced | resolution/builtins.ts rolls the strike for 1 plus Strength Bludgeoning damage, or the grapple or shove save against 8 plus Strength plus the Proficiency Bonus; a failed save against the Shove's push moves the target 5 feet away. |
| Unconscious | enforced | effects.ts adds Prone, and it counts as Incapacitated with Speed 0. saving-throws.ts fails its Strength and Dexterity saves. resolution/attack.ts gives attack rolls against it Advantage and makes a hit from within 5 feet a Critical Hit. effects.ts and hit-points.ts take the weapons, wands, staffs and rods it holds out of its hands; they stay carried, and what one gave its Armor Class goes with it (held-items.ts). |
| Unoccupied Space | enforced | movement-rules.ts ends a move only in a space no other creature fills. |
| Utilize | guided | In an encounter the Utilize action takes the user's action on its own turn, and outside one it takes nothing. A Shield donned or doffed (held-items.ts), a door worked on (doors.ts) and a tool's or gear's Utilize use from the sheet (tool-uses.ts) take it, and a use needs the item in the pack. One object interaction a turn is free: drawing a weapon, opening a door or taking a thing out of a container, and a second takes the Utilize action (object-interactions.ts). What the object does is the GM's. |
| Vulnerability | enforced | hit-points.ts doubles damage of a type the creature is vulnerable to, once per instance. |
| Weapon | reference | A definition. Each weapon's own row under Weapons says what the app does with it. |
| Weapon Attack | enforced | resolution/attack.ts rolls it with the weapon's ability, proficiency, properties and mastery. |

## Gameplay Toolbox

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cackle Fever | reference | Its incubation, outbreaks of laughter and recovery are the GM's to run. |
| Collapsing Roof | enforced | traps.ts: the GM sets it over a trapped area, hidden from the players. A creature moving onto it sets it off: each creature under it makes the Dexterity save at its band's DC against its damage, half on a success, and the area becomes Difficult Terrain. A Search (Perception) within 10 feet at DC 11 finds the trip wire, which is then stepped over or cut. |
| Combat Encounters | reference | Guidance for building encounters; elevation, terrain and hazards run as their own rules. |
| Creating a Background | reference | Guidance for making a background; the builder offers the SRD's. |
| Curses | reference | Guidance on curses; Bestow Curse and cursed items run as their own records. |
| Deep Water | enforced | environment.ts asks a creature without a Swim Speed the DC 10 Constitution save after each hour in the painted water, a failure a level of Exhaustion. |
| Demonic Possession | reference | Possession, the demon's control and the ways to end it are the GM's to run. The Charmed and Frightened conditions it can leave are set by the GM. |
| Extreme Cold | enforced | environment.ts asks each creature on the encounter's map the DC 10 Constitution save at the end of each hour of game time, a failure a level of Exhaustion. Cold Resistance or Immunity, and a Bedroll it is in, succeed; a Blanket gives Advantage. |
| Extreme Heat | enforced | environment.ts asks each creature on the encounter's map without a Waterskin with water left the Constitution save at the end of each hour, DC 5 and 1 more each hour after, with Disadvantage in Medium or Heavy armor, a failure a level of Exhaustion. Fire Resistance or Immunity succeeds. |
| Falling Net | enforced | traps.ts: the creature that crosses the trip wire makes the Dexterity save or is Restrained by a Net with AC 10 and 5 Hit Points, escaped with a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check by it or a creature beside it; a Huge or larger creature succeeds. A found wire is stepped over or cut. |
| Fear and Mental Stress | reference | Guidance on fear and mental stress: the saves it suggests are the GM's to call, and the Frightened condition runs as a condition. |
| Fire-Casting Statue | enforced | traps.ts: a creature moving onto the pressure plate or starting its turn there sets it off, and each creature in its blast (its trapped area, or the Cone the GM marks with trap.edit) makes the DC 15 Dexterity save against its Fire damage, half on a success. It resets each turn. The glyph (DC 10, within 5 feet) and the plate (DC 15) are found with a Search, and defaced or wedged with an Iron Spike. Its Arcana Study is the GM's. |
| Frigid Water | enforced | environment.ts counts each creature's time in the painted water, by the minute on the game clock and by the round in an encounter. Past minutes equal to its Constitution score, each minute asks the DC 10 Constitution save, a failure a level of Exhaustion. Cold Resistance or Immunity succeeds. |
| Heavy Precipitation | enforced | Everything is Lightly Obscured (vision/sight.ts), each creature on the map has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks (environment.ts), and heavy rain puts out the open flames it carries. |
| Hidden Pit | enforced | traps.ts: a creature moving onto the lid falls in, its move ending at the bottom, takes the fall's damage at the band's depth and can't climb out without a Climb Speed or climbing gear (movement-rules.ts). The lid stays open. A Study (Investigation) at DC 15 finds it, and a wedged Iron Spike makes it safe. Arcane Lock holding it shut is the GM's. |
| High Altitude | enforced | environment.ts counts each hour on the road as 2 toward Extended Travel's 8 hours (time.pass with a travel pace), past which each hour asks the Constitution save. Acclimatizing over 30 days is the GM's. |
| Magical Contagions | reference | Guidance for running contagions. |
| Poison | enforced | Each sample poison is a consumable (`poisons.v1.json`): a contact or ingested dose is brought to a creature within 5 feet, an inhaled one fills a 5-foot Cube, and an injury poison coats a weapon or ammunition as a Bonus Action, its save opened by the next Piercing or Slashing hit (resolution/on-hit.ts). Harvesting poison from a creature is the GM's. |
| Poisoned Darts | enforced | traps.ts: each creature in the darts' path (the trapped area, or the line the GM marks with trap.edit) makes the DC 13 Dexterity save, and on a failure is struck by its own 1d3 darts of Poison damage. It resets each turn up to three times. The holes and the plate are found with a Search at DC 15, then plugged or wedged. |
| Poisoned Needle | enforced | The GM sets it off when a lock is opened without its key (trap.spring): its victim makes the Constitution save against its Poison damage, half on a success, and is Poisoned for an hour on a failure. A Search at DC 15 finds it, and a DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check with Thieves' Tools disarms it, a failure setting it off (traps.ts). |
| Rolling Stone | guided | traps.ts sets it off when a creature moves onto its plate and tells the GM the stone rolls; the stone's Initiative, its moves and the saves of the creatures it rolls over are the GM's to run. A Study at DC 15 finds the plate, and an Iron Spike wedges it. |
| Sewer Plague | reference | Its incubation, Exhaustion and recovery are the GM's to run. |
| Sight Rot | reference | Drinking tainted water, the Blinded condition it leaves and its cure are the GM's to run. |
| Slippery Ice | enforced | The GM paints it (terrain.ts): it is Difficult Terrain, and ice.ts asks the DC 10 Dexterity save against Prone of a creature that moves onto it for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. Ice Walk spares the creature. |
| Spiked Pit | enforced | traps.ts: as the Hidden Pit, and the spikes at the bottom deal their Piercing damage at the band's dice. |
| Strong Wind | enforced | environment.ts gives each creature on the map Disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls, puts out the open flames it carries, disperses the fog a wind ends, and brings down a flier that ends its turn aloft. A sandstorm's Disadvantage on Perception checks is applied too. |
| Thin Ice | reference | Creatures carry no weights in the app, so when thin ice breaks under them is the GM's; the GM paints the hole as water. |
| Traps | enforced | traps.ts holds the toolbox's traps on the map, hidden until found, with their triggers, saves, damage and ways to make them safe. Designing a new trap is the GM's. |
| Travel Pace | guided | time.pass takes the party's pace: its checks read the pace, and environment.ts counts Extended Travel's hours past 8. Terrain, encounters and navigation are the GM's. |
| Troubleshooting | reference | Guidance for running encounters. |

## Rules chapters

| Record | State | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ability Checks (D20 Tests) | enforced | ability-checks.ts rolls a check with its ability, skill or tool, proficiency, Advantage and Disadvantage against the DC the action or the GM sets. |
| Ability Checks (Social Interaction) | enforced | The Influence action rolls the skill against the creature's attitude, Advantage when it is Friendly and Disadvantage when Hostile, with a DC of 15 or its Intelligence (resolution/builtins.ts, ability-checks.ts). What it agrees to is the GM's. |
| Ability Modifiers (The Six Abilities) | enforced | Every roll reads the ability modifier worked out from the score (rules-5e abilityModifier). |
| Ability Scores (The Six Abilities) | enforced | The sheet holds each ability score, raised and capped by the build and its items (live-abilities.ts). |
| Advantage/Disadvantage (D20 Tests) | enforced | Advantage and Disadvantage from every source are gathered on each D20 Test, and having both cancels them (rules-5e aggregateRollMode). |
| Adventuring Equipment (Exploration) | reference | A pointer to the Equipment chapter, whose gear has its own rows. |
| Armor Class (Multiclassing) | enforced | Of several ways to calculate Armor Class, the sheet uses the best one, and only one applies (character-build.ts). |
| Attack Rolls (D20 Tests) | enforced | resolution/attack.ts rolls an attack with its ability and proficiency, a natural 20 always hitting as a Critical Hit and a natural 1 always missing. |
| Class Features (Multiclassing) | enforced | Each class's features come at that class's own level, and the special rules for Extra Attack, Spellcasting and Armor Class calculations apply as their rows say (character-build.ts). |
| Cover (Combat) | enforced | cover.ts measures Half and Three-Quarters Cover from the walls and creatures between attacker and target, or the GM marks it, and resolution/attack.ts and saving-throws.ts add +2 or +5 to AC and Dexterity saves; Total Cover refuses the target (resolution/spell-targets.ts, action-targets.ts). |
| Critical Hits (Damage and Healing) | enforced | resolution/damage.ts rolls a Critical Hit's damage dice twice. |
| Damage Rolls (Damage and Healing) | enforced | resolution/damage.ts rolls each damage roll with its modifiers and types. |
| Damage Types (Damage and Healing) | enforced | Every damage roll carries its type, which hit-points.ts reads for Resistance, Vulnerability and Immunity. |
| Dropping to 0 Hit Points (Damage and Healing) | enforced | hit-points.ts drops a character at 0 into Unconscious and dying, or kills it outright when the damage left over reaches its maximum, and defeats any other creature; death-saves.ts rolls the Death Saving Throws until the character stabilizes, revives or dies. |
| Equipment Proficiencies (Proficiency) | enforced | Weapon proficiency adds the Proficiency Bonus to attacks, armor without training gives Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity rolls and blocks spellcasting, and tool proficiency adds it to checks with the tool (equipment-derivation.ts, ability-checks.ts). |
| Experience Points (Multiclassing) | enforced | experience.ts counts XP against the total level's thresholds. |
| Extra Attack (Multiclassing) | enforced | Extra Attack from two classes doesn't stack, and a Fighter's own tiers count (character-build.ts, resolution/extra-attacks.ts). |
| Gaining a Level (Create Your Character) | enforced | The Level flow adds a level's Hit Points (fixed or rolled), Hit Point Dice, features and picks (next-level.ts, level-up-picks.ts), and experience.ts tracks the XP each level needs. |
| Hazards (Exploration) | reference | A pointer. Each hazard it names has its own glossary row: Burning, Dehydration, Falling, Malnutrition and Suffocation. |
| Healing (Damage and Healing) | enforced | resolution/heal.ts restores Hit Points up to the maximum, and healing a creature at 0 brings it back to consciousness. |
| Hiding (Exploration) | enforced | The Hide action rolls Dexterity (Stealth) against DC 15 where the creature is out of sight or Heavily Obscured, makes it Invisible until it is found, attacks or makes a sound, and sets the DC to find it (resolution/builtins.ts, vision/rules.ts). |
| Hit Points (Damage and Healing) | enforced | hit-points.ts tracks Hit Points against the maximum, and Bloodied at half or fewer. |
| Hit Points and Hit Point Dice (Multiclassing) | enforced | The builder takes the level 1 maximum for the first class only, each later level from its own class's die, and keeps a Hit Point Dice pool for each die size (character-build.ts). |
| Immunity (Damage and Healing) | enforced | hit-points.ts takes no damage of a type the creature is immune to, and an immune creature can't be given a condition it is immune to (effects.ts). |
| Interacting with Objects (Exploration) | enforced | One object interaction a turn is free and a second takes the Utilize action (object-interactions.ts), a Search can find what is hidden (resolution/builtins.ts, traps.ts), carrying.ts weighs the load, and doors and walls on the map are objects with AC and Hit Points (objects.ts). What a lever or a loose object does is the GM's to describe. |
| Knocking out a Creature (Damage and Healing) | enforced | resolution/knock-out.ts offers a melee attack that would drop a creature to 0 the choice to leave it at 1 Hit Point and Unconscious for a Short Rest, ended early by healing or a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check. |
| Making an Attack (Combat) | enforced | resolution/attack.ts rolls the attack with its bonus, Advantage and Disadvantage against the target's Armor Class, and resolution/damage.ts rolls the damage on a hit, doubling the dice on a Critical Hit. |
| Marching Order (Exploration) | reference | The tokens' places on the map are the marching order; recording it any other way is the table's. |
| Melee Attacks (Combat) | enforced | resolution/attack.ts holds a melee attack to the attacker's reach, the Unarmed Strike deals its damage, grapples or shoves (resolution/builtins.ts), and movement-rules.ts offers an Opportunity Attack when a creature leaves an enemy's reach without Disengaging. |
| Mounted Combat (Combat) | enforced | mounts.ts mounts and dismounts for half the rider's Speed, gives a controlled mount its rider's Initiative and only the Dash, Disengage and Dodge actions, and asks the rider the DC 10 Dexterity save against falling off Prone when the mount is moved against its will or either is knocked Prone. Whether a mount is trained to accept a rider, or lets one ride, is the GM's. |
| Movement and Position (Combat) | enforced | movement-rules.ts charges each move against Speed, lets a creature split it around its action, charges Difficult Terrain, crawling, standing up, climbing and swimming, and lets it through another creature's space where the rules allow without ending there (space-entry.ts). Jumping is jumping.ts's. |
| Playing on a Grid (Combat) | enforced | The map's grid counts 5 feet a square; movement-rules.ts charges each square entered, diagonals included, and twice for Difficult Terrain (terrain.ts), and ranges count squares by the shortest route (movement-narration.ts). A large tree whose corner a diagonal would cross isn't on the map, so it is the GM's. |
| Prerequisites (Multiclassing) | enforced | The builder refuses a level in a new class without 13 in its primary ability and in every class already taken, read as the scores stand at that level (character-build.ts). |
| Proficiencies (Multiclassing) | enforced | A later class gives only its multiclass training and skills, never its saving throws (character-build.ts). |
| Ranged Attacks (Combat) | enforced | resolution/attack.ts gives a shot beyond normal range Disadvantage and resolution/economy.ts refuses one beyond long range, and a ranged attack with an able enemy within 5 feet that can see the attacker has Disadvantage. |
| Resistance and Vulnerability (Damage and Healing) | enforced | hit-points.ts halves damage of a type the creature resists and doubles one it is vulnerable to, once each per instance, after other modifiers. |
| Resting (Damage and Healing) | enforced | rests.ts runs Short Rests with Hit Point Dice spending and Long Rests restoring Hit Points, spent Hit Point Dice and uses, and long-rest.ts lets a party's Long Rest be interrupted (rest-interruptions.ts). |
| Roleplaying (Social Interaction) | reference | How the characters talk and how an NPC reacts are the table's. |
| Saving Throw Proficiencies (Proficiency) | enforced | A saving throw proficiency adds the Proficiency Bonus to saves with that ability (saving-throws.ts). |
| Saving Throws (D20 Tests) | enforced | saving-throws.ts rolls a save with its ability, proficiency, Advantage and Disadvantage against the effect's DC, and applies what a success or failure leaves. |
| Saving Throws and Damage (Damage and Healing) | enforced | saving-throws.ts and resolution/pending.ts deal a save's damage in full on a failure and half on a success where the effect says so. |
| Skill Proficiencies (Proficiency) | enforced | A skill proficiency adds the Proficiency Bonus to checks with that skill (ability-checks.ts). |
| Spellcasting (Multiclassing) | enforced | The classes share one spell slot table, Paladin and Ranger levels counting half, each class holds to its own highest spell level, and Pact Magic keeps its own slots (spellcasting.ts). |
| Starting at Higher Levels (Create Your Character) | enforced | The builder makes a character at any level with the same steps (character-build.ts). The bonus feats past level 20 and any extra starting equipment or magic items are the GM's to give. |
| Step 1: Choose Class (Create Your Character) | enforced | The builder offers each class with its features, proficiencies and starting equipment (character-build.ts, builder-offers.ts). |
| Step 2: Character Origin (Create Your Character) | enforced | The builder applies the background's ability increases, proficiencies, Origin feat and equipment, the species' traits and size, and the languages picked (character-build.ts). |
| Step 3: Ability Scores (Create Your Character) | enforced | The builder takes the Standard Array, point buy or rolled scores, and applies the background's increases with the 20 cap (character-build.ts). |
| Step 4: Alignment (Create Your Character) | reference | The sheet records the alignment the player picks; playing it is the table's. |
| Step 5: Character Creation Details (Create Your Character) | enforced | The sheet works out the saving throws, skills, Passive Perception, Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, Initiative, Armor Class, attacks and spellcasting numbers from the build (character-build.ts, ability-checks.ts). The character's description and personality are the player's. |
| Temporary Hit Points (Damage and Healing) | enforced | hit-points.ts takes damage from Temporary Hit Points first, a new grant keeps the higher of the two (resolution/heal.ts), and a Long Rest clears them. |
| The Bonus Doesn't Stack (Proficiency) | enforced | The Proficiency Bonus is added once to a roll, and Expertise doubles it once (ability-checks.ts). |
| The Order of Combat (Combat) | enforced | encounter.ts rolls Initiative, with Disadvantage for a surprised creature, orders the turns and runs the rounds; resolution/economy.ts holds each creature to its movement, one action and one Bonus Action on its turn and one Reaction a round. Placing the tokens before the encounter is the GM's. |
| Travel (Exploration) | enforced | While the GM passes time on the road with a pace, travel.ts gives each traveller the pace's Advantage or Disadvantage on Perception, Survival and Stealth checks, Passive Perception included. How far the group gets, mounts' faster hour and vehicles are the GM's, since overland travel isn't on the map. |
| Underwater Combat (Combat) | enforced | In an encounter the GM marks as underwater (encounter.ts), resolution/attack.ts gives a weapon's melee attack Disadvantage unless the attacker has a Swim Speed or the weapon deals Piercing damage, and a ranged weapon attack Disadvantage within normal range; resolution/economy.ts refuses one beyond it. hit-points.ts gives everything Resistance to Fire damage. An encounter only partly underwater is the GM's to mark. |
| Unseen Attackers and Targets (Combat) | guided | With dynamic vision on, resolution/attack.ts gives an attack against a creature the attacker can't see Disadvantage, and one by an attacker its target can't see Advantage (vision/rules.ts); a hidden attacker gives its position away when it attacks (resolution/release.ts). Attacking a square where an unseen creature is guessed to be is the GM's: a player can target only a creature it is shown. |
| Vision and Light (Exploration) | enforced | With dynamic vision on, the map's walls, doors, lights, light levels and each creature's senses decide what every creature sees (vision/sight.ts), and Lightly and Heavily Obscured areas apply their Disadvantage and blindness (vision/rules.ts). With it off, who sees what is the GM's. |
